2724inline void replace_substring(std::string& s, const std::string& f,
2725 const std::string& t)
2726{
2727 JSON_ASSERT(!f.empty());
2728 for (auto pos = s.find(f); // find first occurrence of f
2729 pos != std::string::npos; // make sure f was found
2730 s.replace(pos, f.size(), t), // replace with t, and
2731 pos = s.find(f, pos + t.size())) // find next occurrence of f
2732 {}
2733}
2734
2742inline std::string escape(std::string s)
2743{
2744 replace_substring(s, "~", "~0");
2745 replace_substring(s, "/", "~1");
2746 return s;
2747}
2748
2756static void unescape(std::string& s)
2757{
2758 replace_substring(s, "~1", "/");
2759 replace_substring(s, "~0", "~");
2760}

2807class exception : public std::exception
2808{
2809 public:
2811 const char* what() const noexcept override
2812 {
2813 return m.what();
2814 }
2815
2817 const int id; // NOLINT(cppcoreguidelines-non-private-member-variables-in-classes)
2818
2819 protected:
2820 JSON_HEDLEY_NON_NULL(3)
2821 exception(int id_, const char* what_arg) : id(id_), m(what_arg) {} // NOLINT(bugprone-throw-keyword-missing)
2822
2823 static std::string name(const std::string& ename, int id_)
2824 {
2825 return "[json.exception." + ename + "." + std::to_string(id_) + "] ";
2826 }
2827
2828 template<typename BasicJsonType>
2829 static std::string diagnostics(const BasicJsonType& leaf_element)
2830 {
2831#if JSON_DIAGNOSTICS
2832 std::vector<std::string> tokens;
2833 for (const auto* current = &leaf_element; current->m_parent != nullptr; current = current->m_parent)
2834 {
2835 switch (current->m_parent->type())
2836 {
2837 case value_t::array:
2838 {
2839 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < current->m_parent->m_value.array->size(); ++i)
2840 {
2841 if (&current->m_parent->m_value.array->operator[](i) == current)
2842 {
2843 tokens.emplace_back(std::to_string(i));
2844 break;
2845 }
2846 }
2847 break;
2848 }
2849
2850 case value_t::object:
2851 {
2852 for (const auto& element : *current->m_parent->m_value.object)
2853 {
2854 if (&element.second == current)
2855 {
2856 tokens.emplace_back(element.first.c_str());
2857 break;
2858 }
2859 }
2860 break;
2861 }
2862
2863 case value_t::null: // LCOV_EXCL_LINE
2864 case value_t::string: // LCOV_EXCL_LINE
2865 case value_t::boolean: // LCOV_EXCL_LINE
2866 case value_t::number_integer: // LCOV_EXCL_LINE
2867 case value_t::number_unsigned: // LCOV_EXCL_LINE
2868 case value_t::number_float: // LCOV_EXCL_LINE
2869 case value_t::binary: // LCOV_EXCL_LINE
2870 case value_t::discarded: // LCOV_EXCL_LINE
2871 default: // LCOV_EXCL_LINE
2872 break; // LCOV_EXCL_LINE
2873 }
2874 }
2875
2876 if (tokens.empty())
2877 {
2878 return "";
2879 }
2880
2881 return "(" + std::accumulate(tokens.rbegin(), tokens.rend(), std::string{},
2882 [](const std::string & a, const std::string & b)
2883 {
2884 return a + "/" + detail::escape(b);
2885 }) + ") ";
2886#else
2887 static_cast<void>(leaf_element);
2888 return "";
2889#endif
2890 }
2891
2892 private:
2894 std::runtime_error m;
2895};
2896
2899class parse_error : public exception
2900{
2901 public:
2911 template<typename BasicJsonType>
2912 static parse_error create(int id_, const position_t& pos, const std::string& what_arg, const BasicJsonType& context)
2913 {
2914 std::string w = exception::name("parse_error", id_) + "parse error" +
2915 position_string(pos) + ": " + exception::diagnostics(context) + what_arg;
2916 return {id_, pos.chars_read_total, w.c_str()};
2917 }
2918
2919 template<typename BasicJsonType>
2920 static parse_error create(int id_, std::size_t byte_, const std::string& what_arg, const BasicJsonType& context)
2921 {
2922 std::string w = exception::name("parse_error", id_) + "parse error" +
2923 (byte_ != 0 ? (" at byte " + std::to_string(byte_)) : "") +
2924 ": " + exception::diagnostics(context) + what_arg;
2925 return {id_, byte_, w.c_str()};
2926 }
2927
2937 const std::size_t byte;
2938
2939 private:
2940 parse_error(int id_, std::size_t byte_, const char* what_arg)
2941 : exception(id_, what_arg), byte(byte_) {}
2942
2943 static std::string position_string(const position_t& pos)
2944 {
2945 return " at line " + std::to_string(pos.lines_read + 1) +
2946 ", column " + std::to_string(pos.chars_read_current_line);
2947 }
2948};

3061// integer_sequence
3062//
3063// Class template representing a compile-time integer sequence. An instantiation
3064// of `integer_sequence<T, Ints...>` has a sequence of integers encoded in its
3065// type through its template arguments (which is a common need when
3066// working with C++11 variadic templates). `absl::integer_sequence` is designed
3067// to be a drop-in replacement for C++14's `std::integer_sequence`.
3068//
3069// Example:
3070//
3071// template< class T, T... Ints >
3072// void user_function(integer_sequence<T, Ints...>);
3073//
3074// int main()
3075// {
3076// // user_function's `T` will be deduced to `int` and `Ints...`
3077// // will be deduced to `0, 1, 2, 3, 4`.
3078// user_function(make_integer_sequence<int, 5>());
3079// }
3080template <typename T, T... Ints>
3081struct integer_sequence
3082{
3083 using value_type = T;
3084 static constexpr std::size_t size() noexcept
3085 {
3086 return sizeof...(Ints);
3087 }
3088};
3089
3090// index_sequence
3091//
3092// A helper template for an `integer_sequence` of `size_t`,
3093// `absl::index_sequence` is designed to be a drop-in replacement for C++14's
3094// `std::index_sequence`.
3095template <size_t... Ints>
3096using index_sequence = integer_sequence<size_t, Ints...>;
3097
3098namespace utility_internal
3099{
3100
3101template <typename Seq, size_t SeqSize, size_t Rem>
3102struct Extend;
3103
3104// Note that SeqSize == sizeof...(Ints). It's passed explicitly for efficiency.
3105template <typename T, T... Ints, size_t SeqSize>
3106struct Extend<integer_sequence<T, Ints...>, SeqSize, 0>
3107{
3108 using type = integer_sequence < T, Ints..., (Ints + SeqSize)... >;
3109};
3110
3111template <typename T, T... Ints, size_t SeqSize>
3112struct Extend<integer_sequence<T, Ints...>, SeqSize, 1>
3113{
3114 using type = integer_sequence < T, Ints..., (Ints + SeqSize)..., 2 * SeqSize >;
3115};
3116
3117// Recursion helper for 'make_integer_sequence<T, N>'.
3118// 'Gen<T, N>::type' is an alias for 'integer_sequence<T, 0, 1, ... N-1>'.
3119template <typename T, size_t N>
3120struct Gen
3121{
3122 using type =
3123 typename Extend < typename Gen < T, N / 2 >::type, N / 2, N % 2 >::type;
3124};
3125
3126template <typename T>
3127struct Gen<T, 0>
3128{
3129 using type = integer_sequence<T>;
3130};
3131
3132} // namespace utility_internal

3136// make_integer_sequence
3137//
3138// This template alias is equivalent to
3139// `integer_sequence<int, 0, 1, ..., N-1>`, and is designed to be a drop-in
3140// replacement for C++14's `std::make_integer_sequence`.
3141template <typename T, T N>
3142using make_integer_sequence = typename utility_internal::Gen<T, N>::type;
3143
3144// make_index_sequence
3145//
3146// This template alias is equivalent to `index_sequence<0, 1, ..., N-1>`,
3147// and is designed to be a drop-in replacement for C++14's
3148// `std::make_index_sequence`.
3149template <size_t N>
3150using make_index_sequence = make_integer_sequence<size_t, N>;

3152// index_sequence_for

3154// Converts a typename pack into an index sequence of the same length, and
3155// is designed to be a drop-in replacement for C++14's
3156// `std::index_sequence_for()`
3157template <typename... Ts>
3158using index_sequence_for = make_index_sequence<sizeof...(Ts)>;

3370// Every trait in this file expects a non CV-qualified type.

3374// In this case, T has to be properly CV-qualified to constraint the function arguments

3429// trait checking if JSONSerializer<T>::from_json(json const&, udt&) exists
3430template<typename BasicJsonType, typename T, typename = void>
3431struct has_from_json : std::false_type {};
3432
3433// trait checking if j.get<T> is valid
3434// use this trait instead of std::is_constructible or std::is_convertible,
3435// both rely on, or make use of implicit conversions, and thus fail when T
3436// has several constructors/operator= (see https://github.com/nlohmann/json/issues/958)
3437template <typename BasicJsonType, typename T>
3438struct is_getable
3439{
3440 static constexpr bool value = is_detected<get_template_function, const BasicJsonType&, T>::value;
3441};
3442
3443template<typename BasicJsonType, typename T>
3444struct has_from_json < BasicJsonType, T, enable_if_t < !is_basic_json<T>::value >>
3445{
3446 using serializer = typename BasicJsonType::template json_serializer<T, void>;
3447
3448 static constexpr bool value =
3449 is_detected_exact<void, from_json_function, serializer,
3450 const BasicJsonType&, T&>::value;
3451};
3452
3453// This trait checks if JSONSerializer<T>::from_json(json const&) exists
3454// this overload is used for non-default-constructible user-defined-types
3455template<typename BasicJsonType, typename T, typename = void>
3456struct has_non_default_from_json : std::false_type {};
3457
3458template<typename BasicJsonType, typename T>
3459struct has_non_default_from_json < BasicJsonType, T, enable_if_t < !is_basic_json<T>::value >>
3460{
3461 using serializer = typename BasicJsonType::template json_serializer<T, void>;
3462
3463 static constexpr bool value =
3464 is_detected_exact<T, from_json_function, serializer,
3465 const BasicJsonType&>::value;
3466};
3467
3468// This trait checks if BasicJsonType::json_serializer<T>::to_json exists
3469// Do not evaluate the trait when T is a basic_json type, to avoid template instantiation infinite recursion.
3470template<typename BasicJsonType, typename T, typename = void>
3471struct has_to_json : std::false_type {};
3472
3473template<typename BasicJsonType, typename T>
3474struct has_to_json < BasicJsonType, T, enable_if_t < !is_basic_json<T>::value >>
3475{
3476 using serializer = typename BasicJsonType::template json_serializer<T, void>;
3477
3478 static constexpr bool value =
3479 is_detected_exact<void, to_json_function, serializer, BasicJsonType&,
3480 T>::value;
3481};

3493: std::conditional<bool(B1::value), conjunction<Bn...>, B1>::type {};

3513struct is_default_constructible<std::tuple<Ts...>>
3514 : conjunction<is_default_constructible<Ts>...> {};

3516template <typename... Ts>

3518 : conjunction<is_default_constructible<Ts>...> {};

3537template<typename T, typename = void>
3538struct is_iterator_traits : std::false_type {};

3540template<typename T>
3541struct is_iterator_traits<iterator_traits<T>>
3542{
3543 private:
3544 using traits = iterator_traits<T>;
3545
3546 public:
3547 static constexpr auto value =
3548 is_detected<value_type_t, traits>::value &&
3549 is_detected<difference_type_t, traits>::value &&
3550 is_detected<pointer_t, traits>::value &&
3551 is_detected<iterator_category_t, traits>::value &&
3552 is_detected<reference_t, traits>::value;
3553};

3555template<typename T>
3556struct is_range
3557{
3558 private:
3559 using t_ref = typename std::add_lvalue_reference<T>::type;
3560
3561 using iterator = detected_t<result_of_begin, t_ref>;
3562 using sentinel = detected_t<result_of_end, t_ref>;
3563
3564 // to be 100% correct, it should use https://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp/iterator/input_or_output_iterator
3565 // and https://en.cppreference.com/w/cpp/iterator/sentinel_for
3566 // but reimplementing these would be too much work, as a lot of other concepts are used underneath
3567 static constexpr auto is_iterator_begin =
3568 is_iterator_traits<iterator_traits<iterator>>::value;
3569
3570 public:
3571 static constexpr bool value = !std::is_same<iterator, nonesuch>::value && !std::is_same<sentinel, nonesuch>::value && is_iterator_begin;
3572};

3590template<typename BasicJsonType, typename CompatibleObjectType,
3591 typename = void>
3592struct is_compatible_object_type_impl : std::false_type {};
3593
3594template<typename BasicJsonType, typename CompatibleObjectType>
3595struct is_compatible_object_type_impl <
3596 BasicJsonType, CompatibleObjectType,
3597 enable_if_t < is_detected<mapped_type_t, CompatibleObjectType>::value&&
3598 is_detected<key_type_t, CompatibleObjectType>::value >>
3599{
3600 using object_t = typename BasicJsonType::object_t;
3601
3602 // macOS's is_constructible does not play well with nonesuch...
3603 static constexpr bool value =
3604 is_constructible<typename object_t::key_type,
3605 typename CompatibleObjectType::key_type>::value &&
3606 is_constructible<typename object_t::mapped_type,
3607 typename CompatibleObjectType::mapped_type>::value;
3608};
3609
3610template<typename BasicJsonType, typename CompatibleObjectType>
3611struct is_compatible_object_type
3612 : is_compatible_object_type_impl<BasicJsonType, CompatibleObjectType> {};

3614template<typename BasicJsonType, typename ConstructibleObjectType,
3615 typename = void>
3616struct is_constructible_object_type_impl : std::false_type {};
3617
3618template<typename BasicJsonType, typename ConstructibleObjectType>
3619struct is_constructible_object_type_impl <
3620 BasicJsonType, ConstructibleObjectType,
3621 enable_if_t < is_detected<mapped_type_t, ConstructibleObjectType>::value&&
3622 is_detected<key_type_t, ConstructibleObjectType>::value >>
3623{
3624 using object_t = typename BasicJsonType::object_t;
3625
3626 static constexpr bool value =
3627 (is_default_constructible<ConstructibleObjectType>::value &&
3628 (std::is_move_assignable<ConstructibleObjectType>::value ||
3629 std::is_copy_assignable<ConstructibleObjectType>::value) &&
3630 (is_constructible<typename ConstructibleObjectType::key_type,
3631 typename object_t::key_type>::value &&
3632 std::is_same <
3633 typename object_t::mapped_type,
3634 typename ConstructibleObjectType::mapped_type >::value)) ||
3635 (has_from_json<BasicJsonType,
3636 typename ConstructibleObjectType::mapped_type>::value ||
3637 has_non_default_from_json <
3638 BasicJsonType,
3639 typename ConstructibleObjectType::mapped_type >::value);
3640};

3642template<typename BasicJsonType, typename ConstructibleObjectType>
3643struct is_constructible_object_type
3644 : is_constructible_object_type_impl<BasicJsonType,
3645 ConstructibleObjectType> {};

3694template<typename BasicJsonType, typename ConstructibleArrayType>

3698 typename BasicJsonType::value_type>::value&&
3699 !is_compatible_string_type<BasicJsonType, ConstructibleArrayType>::value&&
3700 is_default_constructible<ConstructibleArrayType>::value&&
3701(std::is_move_assignable<ConstructibleArrayType>::value ||
3702 std::is_copy_assignable<ConstructibleArrayType>::value)&&
3703is_detected<iterator_t, ConstructibleArrayType>::value&&

3707// c.f. https://github.com/nlohmann/json/pull/3073

3709 is_complete_type <
3710 detected_t<range_value_t, ConstructibleArrayType >>::value >>

3716 typename BasicJsonType::array_t::value_type>::value ||
3717 has_from_json<BasicJsonType,
3718 value_type>::value ||
3719 has_non_default_from_json <
3720 BasicJsonType,
3721 value_type >::value;

3832template<typename BasicJsonType>
3833void from_json(const BasicJsonType& j, typename std::nullptr_t& n)
3834{
3835 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!j.is_null()))
3836 {
3837 JSON_THROW(type_error::create(302, "type must be null, but is " + std::string(j.type_name()), j));
3838 }
3839 n = nullptr;
3840}
3841
3842// overloads for basic_json template parameters
3843template < typename BasicJsonType, typename ArithmeticType,
3844 enable_if_t < std::is_arithmetic<ArithmeticType>::value&&
3845 !std::is_same<ArithmeticType, typename BasicJsonType::boolean_t>::value,
3846 int > = 0 >
3847void get_arithmetic_value(const BasicJsonType& j, ArithmeticType& val)
3848{
3849 switch (static_cast<value_t>(j))
3850 {
3851 case value_t::number_unsigned:
3852 {
3853 val = static_cast<ArithmeticType>(*j.template get_ptr<const typename BasicJsonType::number_unsigned_t*>());
3854 break;
3855 }
3856 case value_t::number_integer:
3857 {
3858 val = static_cast<ArithmeticType>(*j.template get_ptr<const typename BasicJsonType::number_integer_t*>());
3859 break;
3860 }
3861 case value_t::number_float:
3862 {
3863 val = static_cast<ArithmeticType>(*j.template get_ptr<const typename BasicJsonType::number_float_t*>());
3864 break;
3865 }
3866
3867 case value_t::null:
3868 case value_t::object:
3869 case value_t::array:
3870 case value_t::string:
3871 case value_t::boolean:
3872 case value_t::binary:
3873 case value_t::discarded:
3874 default:
3875 JSON_THROW(type_error::create(302, "type must be number, but is " + std::string(j.type_name()), j));
3876 }
3877}
3878
3879template<typename BasicJsonType>
3880void from_json(const BasicJsonType& j, typename BasicJsonType::boolean_t& b)
3881{
3882 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!j.is_boolean()))
3883 {
3884 JSON_THROW(type_error::create(302, "type must be boolean, but is " + std::string(j.type_name()), j));
3885 }
3886 b = *j.template get_ptr<const typename BasicJsonType::boolean_t*>();
3887}
3888
3889template<typename BasicJsonType>
3890void from_json(const BasicJsonType& j, typename BasicJsonType::string_t& s)
3891{
3892 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!j.is_string()))
3893 {
3894 JSON_THROW(type_error::create(302, "type must be string, but is " + std::string(j.type_name()), j));
3895 }
3896 s = *j.template get_ptr<const typename BasicJsonType::string_t*>();
3897}

3899template <
3900 typename BasicJsonType, typename ConstructibleStringType,
3901 enable_if_t <
3902 is_constructible_string_type<BasicJsonType, ConstructibleStringType>::value&&
3903 !std::is_same<typename BasicJsonType::string_t,
3904 ConstructibleStringType>::value,

4009-> decltype(

4020 {

4100template<typename BasicJsonType, typename ConstructibleObjectType,
4101 enable_if_t<is_constructible_object_type<BasicJsonType, ConstructibleObjectType>::value, int> = 0>
4102void from_json(const BasicJsonType& j, ConstructibleObjectType& obj)
4103{
4104 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!j.is_object()))
4105 {
4106 JSON_THROW(type_error::create(302, "type must be object, but is " + std::string(j.type_name()), j));
4107 }
4108
4109 ConstructibleObjectType ret;
4110 const auto* inner_object = j.template get_ptr<const typename BasicJsonType::object_t*>();
4111 using value_type = typename ConstructibleObjectType::value_type;
4112 std::transform(
4113 inner_object->begin(), inner_object->end(),
4114 std::inserter(ret, ret.begin()),
4115 [](typename BasicJsonType::object_t::value_type const & p)
4116 {
4117 return value_type(p.first, p.second.template get<typename ConstructibleObjectType::mapped_type>());
4118 });
4119 obj = std::move(ret);
4120}

4122// overload for arithmetic types, not chosen for basic_json template arguments
4123// (BooleanType, etc..); note: Is it really necessary to provide explicit
4124// overloads for boolean_t etc. in case of a custom BooleanType which is not
4125// an arithmetic type?
4126template < typename BasicJsonType, typename ArithmeticType,
4127 enable_if_t <
4128 std::is_arithmetic<ArithmeticType>::value&&
4129 !std::is_same<ArithmeticType, typename BasicJsonType::number_unsigned_t>::value&&
4130 !std::is_same<ArithmeticType, typename BasicJsonType::number_integer_t>::value&&
4131 !std::is_same<ArithmeticType, typename BasicJsonType::number_float_t>::value&&
4132 !std::is_same<ArithmeticType, typename BasicJsonType::boolean_t>::value,
4133 int > = 0 >
4134void from_json(const BasicJsonType& j, ArithmeticType& val)
4135{
4136 switch (static_cast<value_t>(j))
4137 {
4138 case value_t::number_unsigned:
4139 {
4140 val = static_cast<ArithmeticType>(*j.template get_ptr<const typename BasicJsonType::number_unsigned_t*>());
4141 break;
4142 }
4143 case value_t::number_integer:
4144 {
4145 val = static_cast<ArithmeticType>(*j.template get_ptr<const typename BasicJsonType::number_integer_t*>());
4146 break;
4147 }
4148 case value_t::number_float:
4149 {
4150 val = static_cast<ArithmeticType>(*j.template get_ptr<const typename BasicJsonType::number_float_t*>());
4151 break;
4152 }
4153 case value_t::boolean:
4154 {
4155 val = static_cast<ArithmeticType>(*j.template get_ptr<const typename BasicJsonType::boolean_t*>());
4156 break;
4157 }
4158
4159 case value_t::null:
4160 case value_t::object:
4161 case value_t::array:
4162 case value_t::string:
4163 case value_t::binary:
4164 case value_t::discarded:
4165 default:
4166 JSON_THROW(type_error::create(302, "type must be number, but is " + std::string(j.type_name()), j));
4167 }
4168}

4213template < typename BasicJsonType, typename Key, typename Value, typename Compare, typename Allocator,
4214 typename = enable_if_t < !std::is_constructible <
4215 typename BasicJsonType::string_t, Key >::value >>
4216void from_json(const BasicJsonType& j, std::map<Key, Value, Compare, Allocator>& m)
4217{
4218 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!j.is_array()))
4219 {
4220 JSON_THROW(type_error::create(302, "type must be array, but is " + std::string(j.type_name()), j));
4221 }
4222 m.clear();
4223 for (const auto& p : j)
4224 {
4225 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!p.is_array()))
4226 {
4227 JSON_THROW(type_error::create(302, "type must be array, but is " + std::string(p.type_name()), j));
4228 }
4229 m.emplace(p.at(0).template get<Key>(), p.at(1).template get<Value>());
4230 }
4231}

4265struct from_json_fn
4266{
4267 template<typename BasicJsonType, typename T>
4268 auto operator()(const BasicJsonType& j, T&& val) const
4269 noexcept(noexcept(from_json(j, std::forward<T>(val))))
4270 -> decltype(from_json(j, std::forward<T>(val)))
4271 {
4272 return from_json(j, std::forward<T>(val));
4273 }
4274};

4318template<typename string_type>
4319void int_to_string( string_type& target, std::size_t value )
4320{
4321 // For ADL
4322 using std::to_string;
4323 target = to_string(value);
4324}
4325template<typename IteratorType> class iteration_proxy_value
4326{
4327 public:
4328 using difference_type = std::ptrdiff_t;
4329 using value_type = iteration_proxy_value;
4330 using pointer = value_type * ;
4331 using reference = value_type & ;
4332 using iterator_category = std::input_iterator_tag;
4333 using string_type = typename std::remove_cv< typename std::remove_reference<decltype( std::declval<IteratorType>().key() ) >::type >::type;
4334
4335 private:
4337 IteratorType anchor;
4339 std::size_t array_index = 0;
4341 mutable std::size_t array_index_last = 0;
4343 mutable string_type array_index_str = "0";
4345 const string_type empty_str{};
4346
4347 public:
4348 explicit iteration_proxy_value(IteratorType it) noexcept
4349 : anchor(std::move(it))
4350 {}
4351
4353 iteration_proxy_value& operator*()
4354 {
4355 return *this;
4356 }
4357
4359 iteration_proxy_value& operator++()
4360 {
4361 ++anchor;
4362 ++array_index;
4363
4364 return *this;
4365 }
4366
4368 bool operator==(const iteration_proxy_value& o) const
4369 {
4370 return anchor == o.anchor;
4371 }
4372
4374 bool operator!=(const iteration_proxy_value& o) const
4375 {
4376 return anchor != o.anchor;
4377 }
4378
4380 const string_type& key() const
4381 {
4382 JSON_ASSERT(anchor.m_object != nullptr);
4383
4384 switch (anchor.m_object->type())
4385 {
4386 // use integer array index as key
4387 case value_t::array:
4388 {
4389 if (array_index != array_index_last)
4390 {
4391 int_to_string( array_index_str, array_index );
4392 array_index_last = array_index;
4393 }
4394 return array_index_str;
4395 }
4396
4397 // use key from the object
4398 case value_t::object:
4399 return anchor.key();
4400
4401 // use an empty key for all primitive types
4402 case value_t::null:
4403 case value_t::string:
4404 case value_t::boolean:
4405 case value_t::number_integer:
4406 case value_t::number_unsigned:
4407 case value_t::number_float:
4408 case value_t::binary:
4409 case value_t::discarded:
4410 default:
4411 return empty_str;
4412 }
4413 }
4414
4416 typename IteratorType::reference value() const
4417 {
4418 return anchor.value();
4419 }
4420};
4421
4423template<typename IteratorType> class iteration_proxy
4424{
4425 private:
4427 typename IteratorType::reference container;
4428
4429 public:
4431 explicit iteration_proxy(typename IteratorType::reference cont) noexcept
4432 : container(cont) {}
4433
4435 iteration_proxy_value<IteratorType> begin() noexcept
4436 {
4437 return iteration_proxy_value<IteratorType>(container.begin());
4438 }
4439
4441 iteration_proxy_value<IteratorType> end() noexcept
4442 {
4443 return iteration_proxy_value<IteratorType>(container.end());
4444 }
4445};
4446// Structured Bindings Support
4447// For further reference see https://blog.tartanllama.xyz/structured-bindings/
4448// And see https://github.com/nlohmann/json/pull/1391
4449template<std::size_t N, typename IteratorType, enable_if_t<N == 0, int> = 0>
4450auto get(const nlohmann::detail::iteration_proxy_value<IteratorType>& i) -> decltype(i.key())
4451{
4452 return i.key();
4453}

4457template<std::size_t N, typename IteratorType, enable_if_t<N == 1, int> = 0>
4458auto get(const nlohmann::detail::iteration_proxy_value<IteratorType>& i) -> decltype(i.value())
4459{
4460 return i.value();
4461}

4524 * j.m_value.destroy(j.m_type) to avoid a memory leak in case j contains an
4525 * allocated value (e.g., a string). See bug issue
4526 * https://github.com/nlohmann/json/issues/2865 for more information.
4527 */
4528
4529template<value_t> struct external_constructor;
4530
4531template<>
4532struct external_constructor<value_t::boolean>
4533{
4534 template<typename BasicJsonType>
4535 static void construct(BasicJsonType& j, typename BasicJsonType::boolean_t b) noexcept
4536 {
4537 j.m_value.destroy(j.m_type);
4538 j.m_type = value_t::boolean;
4539 j.m_value = b;
4540 j.assert_invariant();
4541 }
4542};
4543
4544template<>
4545struct external_constructor<value_t::string>
4546{
4547 template<typename BasicJsonType>
4548 static void construct(BasicJsonType& j, const typename BasicJsonType::string_t& s)
4549 {
4550 j.m_value.destroy(j.m_type);
4551 j.m_type = value_t::string;
4552 j.m_value = s;
4553 j.assert_invariant();
4554 }
4555
4556 template<typename BasicJsonType>
4557 static void construct(BasicJsonType& j, typename BasicJsonType::string_t&& s)
4558 {
4559 j.m_value.destroy(j.m_type);
4560 j.m_type = value_t::string;
4561 j.m_value = std::move(s);
4562 j.assert_invariant();
4563 }
4564
4565 template < typename BasicJsonType, typename CompatibleStringType,
4566 enable_if_t < !std::is_same<CompatibleStringType, typename BasicJsonType::string_t>::value,
4567 int > = 0 >
4568 static void construct(BasicJsonType& j, const CompatibleStringType& str)
4569 {
4570 j.m_value.destroy(j.m_type);
4571 j.m_type = value_t::string;
4572 j.m_value.string = j.template create<typename BasicJsonType::string_t>(str);
4573 j.assert_invariant();
4574 }
4575};

4638template<>
4639struct external_constructor<value_t::array>
4640{
4641 template<typename BasicJsonType>
4642 static void construct(BasicJsonType& j, const typename BasicJsonType::array_t& arr)
4643 {
4644 j.m_value.destroy(j.m_type);
4645 j.m_type = value_t::array;
4646 j.m_value = arr;
4647 j.set_parents();
4648 j.assert_invariant();
4649 }
4650
4651 template<typename BasicJsonType>
4652 static void construct(BasicJsonType& j, typename BasicJsonType::array_t&& arr)
4653 {
4654 j.m_value.destroy(j.m_type);
4655 j.m_type = value_t::array;
4656 j.m_value = std::move(arr);
4657 j.set_parents();
4658 j.assert_invariant();
4659 }
4660
4661 template < typename BasicJsonType, typename CompatibleArrayType,
4662 enable_if_t < !std::is_same<CompatibleArrayType, typename BasicJsonType::array_t>::value,
4663 int > = 0 >
4664 static void construct(BasicJsonType& j, const CompatibleArrayType& arr)
4665 {
4666 using std::begin;
4667 using std::end;
4668
4669 j.m_value.destroy(j.m_type);
4670 j.m_type = value_t::array;
4671 j.m_value.array = j.template create<typename BasicJsonType::array_t>(begin(arr), end(arr));
4672 j.set_parents();
4673 j.assert_invariant();
4674 }
4675
4676 template<typename BasicJsonType>
4677 static void construct(BasicJsonType& j, const std::vector<bool>& arr)
4678 {
4679 j.m_value.destroy(j.m_type);
4680 j.m_type = value_t::array;
4681 j.m_value = value_t::array;
4682 j.m_value.array->reserve(arr.size());
4683 for (const bool x : arr)
4684 {
4685 j.m_value.array->push_back(x);
4686 j.set_parent(j.m_value.array->back());
4687 }
4688 j.assert_invariant();
4689 }
4690
4691 template<typename BasicJsonType, typename T,
4692 enable_if_t<std::is_convertible<T, BasicJsonType>::value, int> = 0>
4693 static void construct(BasicJsonType& j, const std::valarray<T>& arr)
4694 {
4695 j.m_value.destroy(j.m_type);
4696 j.m_type = value_t::array;
4697 j.m_value = value_t::array;
4698 j.m_value.array->resize(arr.size());
4699 if (arr.size() > 0)
4700 {
4701 std::copy(std::begin(arr), std::end(arr), j.m_value.array->begin());
4702 }
4703 j.set_parents();
4704 j.assert_invariant();
4705 }
4706};

4894struct to_json_fn
4895{
4896 template<typename BasicJsonType, typename T>
4897 auto operator()(BasicJsonType& j, T&& val) const noexcept(noexcept(to_json(j, std::forward<T>(val))))
4898 -> decltype(to_json(j, std::forward<T>(val)), void())
4899 {
4900 return to_json(j, std::forward<T>(val));
4901 }
4902};

4967
4970template<typename BinaryType>
4971class byte_container_with_subtype : public BinaryType
4972{
4973 public:
4974 using container_type = BinaryType;
4975 using subtype_type = std::uint64_t;
4976
4978 byte_container_with_subtype() noexcept(noexcept(container_type()))
4979 : container_type()
4980 {}
4981
4983 byte_container_with_subtype(const container_type& b) noexcept(noexcept(container_type(b)))
4984 : container_type(b)
4985 {}
4986
4988 byte_container_with_subtype(container_type&& b) noexcept(noexcept(container_type(std::move(b))))
4989 : container_type(std::move(b))
4990 {}
4991
4993 byte_container_with_subtype(const container_type& b, subtype_type subtype_) noexcept(noexcept(container_type(b)))
4994 : container_type(b)
4995 , m_subtype(subtype_)
4996 , m_has_subtype(true)
4997 {}
4998
5000 byte_container_with_subtype(container_type&& b, subtype_type subtype_) noexcept(noexcept(container_type(std::move(b))))
5001 : container_type(std::move(b))
5002 , m_subtype(subtype_)
5003 , m_has_subtype(true)
5004 {}
5005
5006 bool operator==(const byte_container_with_subtype& rhs) const
5007 {
5008 return std::tie(static_cast<const BinaryType&>(*this), m_subtype, m_has_subtype) ==
5009 std::tie(static_cast<const BinaryType&>(rhs), rhs.m_subtype, rhs.m_has_subtype);
5010 }
5011
5012 bool operator!=(const byte_container_with_subtype& rhs) const
5013 {
5014 return !(rhs == *this);
5015 }
5016
5019 void set_subtype(subtype_type subtype_) noexcept
5020 {
5021 m_subtype = subtype_;
5022 m_has_subtype = true;
5023 }
5024
5027 constexpr subtype_type subtype() const noexcept
5028 {
5029 return m_has_subtype ? m_subtype : static_cast<subtype_type>(-1);
5030 }
5031
5034 constexpr bool has_subtype() const noexcept
5035 {
5036 return m_has_subtype;
5037 }
5038
5041 void clear_subtype() noexcept
5042 {
5043 m_subtype = 0;
5044 m_has_subtype = false;
5045 }
5046
5047 private:
5048 subtype_type m_subtype = 0;
5049 bool m_has_subtype = false;
5050};

5077// boost::hash_combine
5078inline std::size_t combine(std::size_t seed, std::size_t h) noexcept
5079{
5080 seed ^= h + 0x9e3779b9 + (seed << 6U) + (seed >> 2U);
5081 return seed;
5082}
5083
5095template<typename BasicJsonType>
5096std::size_t hash(const BasicJsonType& j)
5097{
5098 using string_t = typename BasicJsonType::string_t;
5099 using number_integer_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_integer_t;
5100 using number_unsigned_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_unsigned_t;
5101 using number_float_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_float_t;
5102
5103 const auto type = static_cast<std::size_t>(j.type());
5104 switch (j.type())
5105 {
5106 case BasicJsonType::value_t::null:
5107 case BasicJsonType::value_t::discarded:
5108 {
5109 return combine(type, 0);
5110 }
5111
5112 case BasicJsonType::value_t::object:
5113 {
5114 auto seed = combine(type, j.size());
5115 for (const auto& element : j.items())
5116 {
5117 const auto h = std::hash<string_t> {}(element.key());
5118 seed = combine(seed, h);
5119 seed = combine(seed, hash(element.value()));
5120 }
5121 return seed;
5122 }
5123
5124 case BasicJsonType::value_t::array:
5125 {
5126 auto seed = combine(type, j.size());
5127 for (const auto& element : j)
5128 {
5129 seed = combine(seed, hash(element));
5130 }
5131 return seed;
5132 }
5133
5134 case BasicJsonType::value_t::string:
5135 {
5136 const auto h = std::hash<string_t> {}(j.template get_ref<const string_t&>());
5137 return combine(type, h);
5138 }
5139
5140 case BasicJsonType::value_t::boolean:
5141 {
5142 const auto h = std::hash<bool> {}(j.template get<bool>());
5143 return combine(type, h);
5144 }
5145
5146 case BasicJsonType::value_t::number_integer:
5147 {
5148 const auto h = std::hash<number_integer_t> {}(j.template get<number_integer_t>());
5149 return combine(type, h);
5150 }
5151
5152 case BasicJsonType::value_t::number_unsigned:
5153 {
5154 const auto h = std::hash<number_unsigned_t> {}(j.template get<number_unsigned_t>());
5155 return combine(type, h);
5156 }
5157
5158 case BasicJsonType::value_t::number_float:
5159 {
5160 const auto h = std::hash<number_float_t> {}(j.template get<number_float_t>());
5161 return combine(type, h);
5162 }
5163
5164 case BasicJsonType::value_t::binary:
5165 {
5166 auto seed = combine(type, j.get_binary().size());
5167 const auto h = std::hash<bool> {}(j.get_binary().has_subtype());
5168 seed = combine(seed, h);
5169 seed = combine(seed, static_cast<std::size_t>(j.get_binary().subtype()));
5170 for (const auto byte : j.get_binary())
5171 {
5172 seed = combine(seed, std::hash<std::uint8_t> {}(byte));
5173 }
5174 return seed;
5175 }
5176
5177 default: // LCOV_EXCL_LINE
5178 JSON_ASSERT(false); // NOLINT(cert-dcl03-c,hicpp-static-assert,misc-static-assert) LCOV_EXCL_LINE
5179 return 0; // LCOV_EXCL_LINE
5180 }
5181}

5243class file_input_adapter
5244{
5245 public:
5246 using char_type = char;
5247
5248 JSON_HEDLEY_NON_NULL(2)
5249 explicit file_input_adapter(std::FILE* f) noexcept
5250 : m_file(f)
5251 {}
5252
5253 // make class move-only
5254 file_input_adapter(const file_input_adapter&) = delete;
5255 file_input_adapter(file_input_adapter&&) noexcept = default;
5256 file_input_adapter& operator=(const file_input_adapter&) = delete;
5257 file_input_adapter& operator=(file_input_adapter&&) = delete;
5258 ~file_input_adapter() = default;
5259
5260 std::char_traits<char>::int_type get_character() noexcept
5261 {
5262 return std::fgetc(m_file);
5263 }
5264
5265 private:
5267 std::FILE* m_file;

5280class input_stream_adapter
5281{
5282 public:
5283 using char_type = char;
5284
5285 ~input_stream_adapter()
5286 {
5287 // clear stream flags; we use underlying streambuf I/O, do not
5288 // maintain ifstream flags, except eof
5289 if (is != nullptr)
5290 {
5291 is->clear(is->rdstate() & std::ios::eofbit);
5292 }
5293 }
5294
5295 explicit input_stream_adapter(std::istream& i)
5296 : is(&i), sb(i.rdbuf())
5297 {}
5298
5299 // delete because of pointer members
5300 input_stream_adapter(const input_stream_adapter&) = delete;
5301 input_stream_adapter& operator=(input_stream_adapter&) = delete;
5302 input_stream_adapter& operator=(input_stream_adapter&&) = delete;
5303
5304 input_stream_adapter(input_stream_adapter&& rhs) noexcept
5305 : is(rhs.is), sb(rhs.sb)
5306 {
5307 rhs.is = nullptr;
5308 rhs.sb = nullptr;
5309 }
5310
5311 // std::istream/std::streambuf use std::char_traits<char>::to_int_type, to
5312 // ensure that std::char_traits<char>::eof() and the character 0xFF do not
5313 // end up as the same value, e.g. 0xFFFFFFFF.
5314 std::char_traits<char>::int_type get_character()
5315 {
5316 auto res = sb->sbumpc();
5317 // set eof manually, as we don't use the istream interface.
5318 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(res == std::char_traits<char>::eof()))
5319 {
5320 is->clear(is->rdstate() | std::ios::eofbit);
5321 }
5322 return res;
5323 }
5324
5325 private:
5327 std::istream* is = nullptr;
5328 std::streambuf* sb = nullptr;
5329};
5330#endif // JSON_NO_IO

5332// General-purpose iterator-based adapter. It might not be as fast as
5333// theoretically possible for some containers, but it is extremely versatile.
5334template<typename IteratorType>
5335class iterator_input_adapter
5336{
5337 public:
5338 using char_type = typename std::iterator_traits<IteratorType>::value_type;
5339
5340 iterator_input_adapter(IteratorType first, IteratorType last)
5341 : current(std::move(first)), end(std::move(last))
5342 {}
5343
5344 typename std::char_traits<char_type>::int_type get_character()
5345 {
5346 if (JSON_HEDLEY_LIKELY(current != end))
5347 {
5348 auto result = std::char_traits<char_type>::to_int_type(*current);
5349 std::advance(current, 1);
5350 return result;
5351 }
5352
5353 return std::char_traits<char_type>::eof();
5354 }
5355
5356 private:
5357 IteratorType current;
5358 IteratorType end;
5359
5360 template<typename BaseInputAdapter, size_t T>
5361 friend struct wide_string_input_helper;
5362
5363 bool empty() const
5364 {
5365 return current == end;
5366 }
5367};
5368
5369
5370template<typename BaseInputAdapter, size_t T>
5371struct wide_string_input_helper;
5372
5373template<typename BaseInputAdapter>
5374struct wide_string_input_helper<BaseInputAdapter, 4>
5375{
5376 // UTF-32
5377 static void fill_buffer(BaseInputAdapter& input,
5378 std::array<std::char_traits<char>::int_type, 4>& utf8_bytes,
5379 size_t& utf8_bytes_index,
5380 size_t& utf8_bytes_filled)
5381 {
5382 utf8_bytes_index = 0;
5383
5384 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(input.empty()))
5385 {
5386 utf8_bytes[0] = std::char_traits<char>::eof();
5387 utf8_bytes_filled = 1;
5388 }
5389 else
5390 {
5391 // get the current character
5392 const auto wc = input.get_character();
5393
5394 // UTF-32 to UTF-8 encoding
5395 if (wc < 0x80)
5396 {
5397 utf8_bytes[0] = static_cast<std::char_traits<char>::int_type>(wc);
5398 utf8_bytes_filled = 1;
5399 }
5400 else if (wc <= 0x7FF)
5401 {
5402 utf8_bytes[0] = static_cast<std::char_traits<char>::int_type>(0xC0u | ((static_cast<unsigned int>(wc) >> 6u) & 0x1Fu));
5403 utf8_bytes[1] = static_cast<std::char_traits<char>::int_type>(0x80u | (static_cast<unsigned int>(wc) & 0x3Fu));
5404 utf8_bytes_filled = 2;
5405 }
5406 else if (wc <= 0xFFFF)
5407 {
5408 utf8_bytes[0] = static_cast<std::char_traits<char>::int_type>(0xE0u | ((static_cast<unsigned int>(wc) >> 12u) & 0x0Fu));
5409 utf8_bytes[1] = static_cast<std::char_traits<char>::int_type>(0x80u | ((static_cast<unsigned int>(wc) >> 6u) & 0x3Fu));
5410 utf8_bytes[2] = static_cast<std::char_traits<char>::int_type>(0x80u | (static_cast<unsigned int>(wc) & 0x3Fu));
5411 utf8_bytes_filled = 3;
5412 }
5413 else if (wc <= 0x10FFFF)
5414 {
5415 utf8_bytes[0] = static_cast<std::char_traits<char>::int_type>(0xF0u | ((static_cast<unsigned int>(wc) >> 18u) & 0x07u));
5416 utf8_bytes[1] = static_cast<std::char_traits<char>::int_type>(0x80u | ((static_cast<unsigned int>(wc) >> 12u) & 0x3Fu));
5417 utf8_bytes[2] = static_cast<std::char_traits<char>::int_type>(0x80u | ((static_cast<unsigned int>(wc) >> 6u) & 0x3Fu));
5418 utf8_bytes[3] = static_cast<std::char_traits<char>::int_type>(0x80u | (static_cast<unsigned int>(wc) & 0x3Fu));
5419 utf8_bytes_filled = 4;
5420 }
5421 else
5422 {
5423 // unknown character
5424 utf8_bytes[0] = static_cast<std::char_traits<char>::int_type>(wc);
5425 utf8_bytes_filled = 1;
5426 }
5427 }
5428 }
5429};
5430
5431template<typename BaseInputAdapter>
5432struct wide_string_input_helper<BaseInputAdapter, 2>
5433{
5434 // UTF-16
5435 static void fill_buffer(BaseInputAdapter& input,
5436 std::array<std::char_traits<char>::int_type, 4>& utf8_bytes,
5437 size_t& utf8_bytes_index,
5438 size_t& utf8_bytes_filled)
5439 {
5440 utf8_bytes_index = 0;
5441
5442 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(input.empty()))
5443 {
5444 utf8_bytes[0] = std::char_traits<char>::eof();
5445 utf8_bytes_filled = 1;
5446 }
5447 else
5448 {
5449 // get the current character
5450 const auto wc = input.get_character();
5451
5452 // UTF-16 to UTF-8 encoding
5453 if (wc < 0x80)
5454 {
5455 utf8_bytes[0] = static_cast<std::char_traits<char>::int_type>(wc);
5456 utf8_bytes_filled = 1;
5457 }
5458 else if (wc <= 0x7FF)
5459 {
5460 utf8_bytes[0] = static_cast<std::char_traits<char>::int_type>(0xC0u | ((static_cast<unsigned int>(wc) >> 6u)));
5461 utf8_bytes[1] = static_cast<std::char_traits<char>::int_type>(0x80u | (static_cast<unsigned int>(wc) & 0x3Fu));
5462 utf8_bytes_filled = 2;
5463 }
5464 else if (0xD800 > wc || wc >= 0xE000)
5465 {
5466 utf8_bytes[0] = static_cast<std::char_traits<char>::int_type>(0xE0u | ((static_cast<unsigned int>(wc) >> 12u)));
5467 utf8_bytes[1] = static_cast<std::char_traits<char>::int_type>(0x80u | ((static_cast<unsigned int>(wc) >> 6u) & 0x3Fu));
5468 utf8_bytes[2] = static_cast<std::char_traits<char>::int_type>(0x80u | (static_cast<unsigned int>(wc) & 0x3Fu));
5469 utf8_bytes_filled = 3;
5470 }
5471 else
5472 {
5473 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!input.empty()))
5474 {
5475 const auto wc2 = static_cast<unsigned int>(input.get_character());
5476 const auto charcode = 0x10000u + (((static_cast<unsigned int>(wc) & 0x3FFu) << 10u) | (wc2 & 0x3FFu));
5477 utf8_bytes[0] = static_cast<std::char_traits<char>::int_type>(0xF0u | (charcode >> 18u));
5478 utf8_bytes[1] = static_cast<std::char_traits<char>::int_type>(0x80u | ((charcode >> 12u) & 0x3Fu));
5479 utf8_bytes[2] = static_cast<std::char_traits<char>::int_type>(0x80u | ((charcode >> 6u) & 0x3Fu));
5480 utf8_bytes[3] = static_cast<std::char_traits<char>::int_type>(0x80u | (charcode & 0x3Fu));
5481 utf8_bytes_filled = 4;
5482 }
5483 else
5484 {
5485 utf8_bytes[0] = static_cast<std::char_traits<char>::int_type>(wc);
5486 utf8_bytes_filled = 1;
5487 }
5488 }
5489 }
5490 }
5491};
5492
5493// Wraps another input apdater to convert wide character types into individual bytes.
5494template<typename BaseInputAdapter, typename WideCharType>
5495class wide_string_input_adapter
5496{
5497 public:
5498 using char_type = char;
5499
5500 wide_string_input_adapter(BaseInputAdapter base)
5501 : base_adapter(base) {}
5502
5503 typename std::char_traits<char>::int_type get_character() noexcept
5504 {
5505 // check if buffer needs to be filled
5506 if (utf8_bytes_index == utf8_bytes_filled)
5507 {
5508 fill_buffer<sizeof(WideCharType)>();
5509
5510 JSON_ASSERT(utf8_bytes_filled > 0);
5511 JSON_ASSERT(utf8_bytes_index == 0);
5512 }
5513
5514 // use buffer
5515 JSON_ASSERT(utf8_bytes_filled > 0);
5516 JSON_ASSERT(utf8_bytes_index < utf8_bytes_filled);
5517 return utf8_bytes[utf8_bytes_index++];
5518 }
5519
5520 private:
5521 BaseInputAdapter base_adapter;
5522
5523 template<size_t T>
5524 void fill_buffer()
5525 {
5526 wide_string_input_helper<BaseInputAdapter, T>::fill_buffer(base_adapter, utf8_bytes, utf8_bytes_index, utf8_bytes_filled);
5527 }
5528
5530 std::array<std::char_traits<char>::int_type, 4> utf8_bytes = {{0, 0, 0, 0}};
5531
5533 std::size_t utf8_bytes_index = 0;
5535 std::size_t utf8_bytes_filled = 0;
5536};

5539template<typename IteratorType, typename Enable = void>
5540struct iterator_input_adapter_factory
5541{
5542 using iterator_type = IteratorType;
5543 using char_type = typename std::iterator_traits<iterator_type>::value_type;
5544 using adapter_type = iterator_input_adapter<iterator_type>;
5545
5546 static adapter_type create(IteratorType first, IteratorType last)
5547 {
5548 return adapter_type(std::move(first), std::move(last));
5549 }
5550};
5551
5552template<typename T>
5553struct is_iterator_of_multibyte
5554{
5555 using value_type = typename std::iterator_traits<T>::value_type;
5556 enum
5557 {
5558 value = sizeof(value_type) > 1
5559 };
5560};
5561
5562template<typename IteratorType>
5563struct iterator_input_adapter_factory<IteratorType, enable_if_t<is_iterator_of_multibyte<IteratorType>::value>>
5564{
5565 using iterator_type = IteratorType;
5566 using char_type = typename std::iterator_traits<iterator_type>::value_type;
5567 using base_adapter_type = iterator_input_adapter<iterator_type>;
5568 using adapter_type = wide_string_input_adapter<base_adapter_type, char_type>;
5569
5570 static adapter_type create(IteratorType first, IteratorType last)
5571 {
5572 return adapter_type(base_adapter_type(std::move(first), std::move(last)));
5573 }
5574};
5575
5576// General purpose iterator-based input
5577template<typename IteratorType>
5578typename iterator_input_adapter_factory<IteratorType>::adapter_type input_adapter(IteratorType first, IteratorType last)
5579{
5580 using factory_type = iterator_input_adapter_factory<IteratorType>;
5581 return factory_type::create(first, last);
5582}

5635using contiguous_bytes_input_adapter = decltype(input_adapter(std::declval<const char*>(), std::declval<const char*>()));
5636
5637// Null-delimited strings, and the like.
5638template < typename CharT,
5639 typename std::enable_if <
5640 std::is_pointer<CharT>::value&&
5641 !std::is_array<CharT>::value&&
5642 std::is_integral<typename std::remove_pointer<CharT>::type>::value&&
5643 sizeof(typename std::remove_pointer<CharT>::type) == 1,
5644 int >::type = 0 >
5645contiguous_bytes_input_adapter input_adapter(CharT b)
5646{
5647 auto length = std::strlen(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(b));
5648 const auto* ptr = reinterpret_cast<const char*>(b);
5649 return input_adapter(ptr, ptr + length);
5650}
5651
5652template<typename T, std::size_t N>
5653auto input_adapter(T (&array)[N]) -> decltype(input_adapter(array, array + N)) // NOLINT(cppcoreguidelines-avoid-c-arrays,hicpp-avoid-c-arrays,modernize-avoid-c-arrays)
5654{
5655 return input_adapter(array, array + N);
5656}

5658// This class only handles inputs of input_buffer_adapter type.
5659// It's required so that expressions like {ptr, len} can be implicitly cast
5660// to the correct adapter.
5661class span_input_adapter
5662{
5663 public:
5664 template < typename CharT,
5665 typename std::enable_if <
5666 std::is_pointer<CharT>::value&&
5667 std::is_integral<typename std::remove_pointer<CharT>::type>::value&&
5668 sizeof(typename std::remove_pointer<CharT>::type) == 1,
5669 int >::type = 0 >
5670 span_input_adapter(CharT b, std::size_t l)
5671 : ia(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(b), reinterpret_cast<const char*>(b) + l) {}
5672
5673 template<class IteratorType,
5674 typename std::enable_if<
5675 std::is_same<typename iterator_traits<IteratorType>::iterator_category, std::random_access_iterator_tag>::value,
5676 int>::type = 0>
5677 span_input_adapter(IteratorType first, IteratorType last)
5678 : ia(input_adapter(first, last)) {}
5679
5680 contiguous_bytes_input_adapter&& get()
5681 {
5682 return std::move(ia); // NOLINT(hicpp-move-const-arg,performance-move-const-arg)
5683 }
5684
5685 private:
5686 contiguous_bytes_input_adapter ia;
5687};

5717{

5719 using number_unsigned_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_unsigned_t;
5720 using number_float_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_float_t;
5721 using string_t = typename BasicJsonType::string_t;
5722 using binary_t = typename BasicJsonType::binary_t;
5723
5728 virtual bool null() = 0;
5729
5735 virtual bool boolean(bool val) = 0;
5736
5742 virtual bool number_integer(number_integer_t val) = 0;
5743
5749 virtual bool number_unsigned(number_unsigned_t val) = 0;
5750
5757 virtual bool number_float(number_float_t val, const string_t& s) = 0;
5758
5765 virtual bool string(string_t& val) = 0;
5766
5773 virtual bool binary(binary_t& val) = 0;
5774
5781 virtual bool start_object(std::size_t elements) = 0;

5789 virtual bool key(string_t& val) = 0;

5795 virtual bool end_object() = 0;
5796
5803 virtual bool start_array(std::size_t elements) = 0;
5804
5809 virtual bool end_array() = 0;
5810
5818 virtual bool parse_error(std::size_t position,
5819 const std::string& last_token,
5820 const detail::exception& ex) = 0;
5821
5822 json_sax() = default;
5823 json_sax(const json_sax&) = default;
5824 json_sax(json_sax&&) noexcept = default;
5825 json_sax& operator=(const json_sax&) = default;
5826 json_sax& operator=(json_sax&&) noexcept = default;
5827 virtual ~json_sax() = default;
5828};

5846template<typename BasicJsonType>
5847class json_sax_dom_parser
5848{
5849 public:
5850 using number_integer_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_integer_t;
5851 using number_unsigned_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_unsigned_t;
5852 using number_float_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_float_t;
5853 using string_t = typename BasicJsonType::string_t;
5854 using binary_t = typename BasicJsonType::binary_t;
5855
5861 explicit json_sax_dom_parser(BasicJsonType& r, const bool allow_exceptions_ = true)
5862 : root(r), allow_exceptions(allow_exceptions_)
5863 {}
5864
5865 // make class move-only
5866 json_sax_dom_parser(const json_sax_dom_parser&) = delete;
5867 json_sax_dom_parser(json_sax_dom_parser&&) = default; // NOLINT(hicpp-noexcept-move,performance-noexcept-move-constructor)
5868 json_sax_dom_parser& operator=(const json_sax_dom_parser&) = delete;
5869 json_sax_dom_parser& operator=(json_sax_dom_parser&&) = default; // NOLINT(hicpp-noexcept-move,performance-noexcept-move-constructor)
5870 ~json_sax_dom_parser() = default;
5871
5872 bool null()
5873 {
5874 handle_value(nullptr);
5875 return true;
5876 }
5877
5878 bool boolean(bool val)
5879 {
5880 handle_value(val);
5881 return true;
5882 }
5883
5884 bool number_integer(number_integer_t val)
5885 {
5886 handle_value(val);
5887 return true;
5888 }
5889
5890 bool number_unsigned(number_unsigned_t val)
5891 {
5892 handle_value(val);
5893 return true;
5894 }
5895
5896 bool number_float(number_float_t val, const string_t& /*unused*/)
5897 {
5898 handle_value(val);
5899 return true;
5900 }
5901
5902 bool string(string_t& val)
5903 {
5904 handle_value(val);
5905 return true;
5906 }
5907
5908 bool binary(binary_t& val)
5909 {
5910 handle_value(std::move(val));
5911 return true;
5912 }
5913
5914 bool start_object(std::size_t len)
5915 {
5916 ref_stack.push_back(handle_value(BasicJsonType::value_t::object));
5917
5918 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(len != static_cast<std::size_t>(-1) && len > ref_stack.back()->max_size()))
5919 {
5920 JSON_THROW(out_of_range::create(408, "excessive object size: " + std::to_string(len), *ref_stack.back()));
5921 }
5922
5923 return true;
5924 }
5925
5926 bool key(string_t& val)
5927 {
5928 // add null at given key and store the reference for later
5929 object_element = &(ref_stack.back()->m_value.object->operator[](val));
5930 return true;
5931 }
5932
5933 bool end_object()
5934 {
5935 ref_stack.back()->set_parents();
5936 ref_stack.pop_back();
5937 return true;
5938 }
5939
5940 bool start_array(std::size_t len)
5941 {
5942 ref_stack.push_back(handle_value(BasicJsonType::value_t::array));
5943
5944 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(len != static_cast<std::size_t>(-1) && len > ref_stack.back()->max_size()))
5945 {
5946 JSON_THROW(out_of_range::create(408, "excessive array size: " + std::to_string(len), *ref_stack.back()));
5947 }
5948
5949 return true;
5950 }
5951
5952 bool end_array()
5953 {
5954 ref_stack.back()->set_parents();
5955 ref_stack.pop_back();
5956 return true;
5957 }
5958
5959 template<class Exception>
5960 bool parse_error(std::size_t /*unused*/, const std::string& /*unused*/,
5961 const Exception& ex)
5962 {
5963 errored = true;
5964 static_cast<void>(ex);
5965 if (allow_exceptions)
5966 {
5967 JSON_THROW(ex);
5968 }
5969 return false;
5970 }
5971
5972 constexpr bool is_errored() const
5973 {
5974 return errored;
5975 }
5976
5977 private:
5984 template<typename Value>
5985 JSON_HEDLEY_RETURNS_NON_NULL
5986 BasicJsonType* handle_value(Value&& v)
5987 {
5988 if (ref_stack.empty())
5989 {
5990 root = BasicJsonType(std::forward<Value>(v));
5991 return &root;
5992 }
5993
5994 JSON_ASSERT(ref_stack.back()->is_array() || ref_stack.back()->is_object());
5995
5996 if (ref_stack.back()->is_array())
5997 {
5998 ref_stack.back()->m_value.array->emplace_back(std::forward<Value>(v));
5999 return &(ref_stack.back()->m_value.array->back());
6000 }
6001
6002 JSON_ASSERT(ref_stack.back()->is_object());
6003 JSON_ASSERT(object_element);
6004 *object_element = BasicJsonType(std::forward<Value>(v));
6005 return object_element;
6006 }
6007
6009 BasicJsonType& root;
6011 std::vector<BasicJsonType*> ref_stack {};
6013 BasicJsonType* object_element = nullptr;
6015 bool errored = false;
6017 const bool allow_exceptions = true;
6018};

6020template<typename BasicJsonType>
6021class json_sax_dom_callback_parser
6022{
6023 public:
6024 using number_integer_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_integer_t;
6025 using number_unsigned_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_unsigned_t;
6026 using number_float_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_float_t;
6027 using string_t = typename BasicJsonType::string_t;
6028 using binary_t = typename BasicJsonType::binary_t;
6029 using parser_callback_t = typename BasicJsonType::parser_callback_t;
6030 using parse_event_t = typename BasicJsonType::parse_event_t;
6031
6032 json_sax_dom_callback_parser(BasicJsonType& r,
6033 const parser_callback_t cb,
6034 const bool allow_exceptions_ = true)
6035 : root(r), callback(cb), allow_exceptions(allow_exceptions_)
6036 {
6037 keep_stack.push_back(true);
6038 }
6039
6040 // make class move-only
6041 json_sax_dom_callback_parser(const json_sax_dom_callback_parser&) = delete;
6042 json_sax_dom_callback_parser(json_sax_dom_callback_parser&&) = default; // NOLINT(hicpp-noexcept-move,performance-noexcept-move-constructor)
6043 json_sax_dom_callback_parser& operator=(const json_sax_dom_callback_parser&) = delete;
6044 json_sax_dom_callback_parser& operator=(json_sax_dom_callback_parser&&) = default; // NOLINT(hicpp-noexcept-move,performance-noexcept-move-constructor)
6045 ~json_sax_dom_callback_parser() = default;
6046
6047 bool null()
6048 {
6049 handle_value(nullptr);
6050 return true;
6051 }
6052
6053 bool boolean(bool val)
6054 {
6055 handle_value(val);
6056 return true;
6057 }
6058
6059 bool number_integer(number_integer_t val)
6060 {
6061 handle_value(val);
6062 return true;
6063 }
6064
6065 bool number_unsigned(number_unsigned_t val)
6066 {
6067 handle_value(val);
6068 return true;
6069 }
6070
6071 bool number_float(number_float_t val, const string_t& /*unused*/)
6072 {
6073 handle_value(val);
6074 return true;
6075 }
6076
6077 bool string(string_t& val)
6078 {
6079 handle_value(val);
6080 return true;
6081 }
6082
6083 bool binary(binary_t& val)
6084 {
6085 handle_value(std::move(val));
6086 return true;
6087 }
6088
6089 bool start_object(std::size_t len)
6090 {
6091 // check callback for object start
6092 const bool keep = callback(static_cast<int>(ref_stack.size()), parse_event_t::object_start, discarded);
6093 keep_stack.push_back(keep);
6094
6095 auto val = handle_value(BasicJsonType::value_t::object, true);
6096 ref_stack.push_back(val.second);
6097
6098 // check object limit
6099 if (ref_stack.back() && JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(len != static_cast<std::size_t>(-1) && len > ref_stack.back()->max_size()))
6100 {
6101 JSON_THROW(out_of_range::create(408, "excessive object size: " + std::to_string(len), *ref_stack.back()));
6102 }
6103
6104 return true;
6105 }
6106
6107 bool key(string_t& val)
6108 {
6109 BasicJsonType k = BasicJsonType(val);
6110
6111 // check callback for key
6112 const bool keep = callback(static_cast<int>(ref_stack.size()), parse_event_t::key, k);
6113 key_keep_stack.push_back(keep);
6114
6115 // add discarded value at given key and store the reference for later
6116 if (keep && ref_stack.back())
6117 {
6118 object_element = &(ref_stack.back()->m_value.object->operator[](val) = discarded);
6119 }
6120
6121 return true;
6122 }
6123
6124 bool end_object()
6125 {
6126 if (ref_stack.back())
6127 {
6128 if (!callback(static_cast<int>(ref_stack.size()) - 1, parse_event_t::object_end, *ref_stack.back()))
6129 {
6130 // discard object
6131 *ref_stack.back() = discarded;
6132 }
6133 else
6134 {
6135 ref_stack.back()->set_parents();
6136 }
6137 }
6138
6139 JSON_ASSERT(!ref_stack.empty());
6140 JSON_ASSERT(!keep_stack.empty());
6141 ref_stack.pop_back();
6142 keep_stack.pop_back();
6143
6144 if (!ref_stack.empty() && ref_stack.back() && ref_stack.back()->is_structured())
6145 {
6146 // remove discarded value
6147 for (auto it = ref_stack.back()->begin(); it != ref_stack.back()->end(); ++it)
6148 {
6149 if (it->is_discarded())
6150 {
6151 ref_stack.back()->erase(it);
6152 break;
6153 }
6154 }
6155 }
6156
6157 return true;
6158 }
6159
6160 bool start_array(std::size_t len)
6161 {
6162 const bool keep = callback(static_cast<int>(ref_stack.size()), parse_event_t::array_start, discarded);
6163 keep_stack.push_back(keep);
6164
6165 auto val = handle_value(BasicJsonType::value_t::array, true);
6166 ref_stack.push_back(val.second);
6167
6168 // check array limit
6169 if (ref_stack.back() && JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(len != static_cast<std::size_t>(-1) && len > ref_stack.back()->max_size()))
6170 {
6171 JSON_THROW(out_of_range::create(408, "excessive array size: " + std::to_string(len), *ref_stack.back()));
6172 }
6173
6174 return true;
6175 }
6176
6177 bool end_array()
6178 {
6179 bool keep = true;
6180
6181 if (ref_stack.back())
6182 {
6183 keep = callback(static_cast<int>(ref_stack.size()) - 1, parse_event_t::array_end, *ref_stack.back());
6184 if (keep)
6185 {
6186 ref_stack.back()->set_parents();
6187 }
6188 else
6189 {
6190 // discard array
6191 *ref_stack.back() = discarded;
6192 }
6193 }
6194
6195 JSON_ASSERT(!ref_stack.empty());
6196 JSON_ASSERT(!keep_stack.empty());
6197 ref_stack.pop_back();
6198 keep_stack.pop_back();
6199
6200 // remove discarded value
6201 if (!keep && !ref_stack.empty() && ref_stack.back()->is_array())
6202 {
6203 ref_stack.back()->m_value.array->pop_back();
6204 }
6205
6206 return true;
6207 }
6208
6209 template<class Exception>
6210 bool parse_error(std::size_t /*unused*/, const std::string& /*unused*/,
6211 const Exception& ex)
6212 {
6213 errored = true;
6214 static_cast<void>(ex);
6215 if (allow_exceptions)
6216 {
6217 JSON_THROW(ex);
6218 }
6219 return false;
6220 }
6221
6222 constexpr bool is_errored() const
6223 {
6224 return errored;
6225 }
6226
6227 private:
6243 template<typename Value>
6244 std::pair<bool, BasicJsonType*> handle_value(Value&& v, const bool skip_callback = false)
6245 {
6246 JSON_ASSERT(!keep_stack.empty());
6247
6248 // do not handle this value if we know it would be added to a discarded
6249 // container
6250 if (!keep_stack.back())
6251 {
6252 return {false, nullptr};
6253 }
6254
6255 // create value
6256 auto value = BasicJsonType(std::forward<Value>(v));
6257
6258 // check callback
6259 const bool keep = skip_callback || callback(static_cast<int>(ref_stack.size()), parse_event_t::value, value);
6260
6261 // do not handle this value if we just learnt it shall be discarded
6262 if (!keep)
6263 {
6264 return {false, nullptr};
6265 }
6266
6267 if (ref_stack.empty())
6268 {
6269 root = std::move(value);
6270 return {true, &root};
6271 }
6272
6273 // skip this value if we already decided to skip the parent
6274 // (https://github.com/nlohmann/json/issues/971#issuecomment-413678360)
6275 if (!ref_stack.back())
6276 {
6277 return {false, nullptr};
6278 }
6279
6280 // we now only expect arrays and objects
6281 JSON_ASSERT(ref_stack.back()->is_array() || ref_stack.back()->is_object());
6282
6283 // array
6284 if (ref_stack.back()->is_array())
6285 {
6286 ref_stack.back()->m_value.array->emplace_back(std::move(value));
6287 return {true, &(ref_stack.back()->m_value.array->back())};
6288 }
6289
6290 // object
6291 JSON_ASSERT(ref_stack.back()->is_object());
6292 // check if we should store an element for the current key
6293 JSON_ASSERT(!key_keep_stack.empty());
6294 const bool store_element = key_keep_stack.back();
6295 key_keep_stack.pop_back();
6296
6297 if (!store_element)
6298 {
6299 return {false, nullptr};
6300 }
6301
6302 JSON_ASSERT(object_element);
6303 *object_element = std::move(value);
6304 return {true, object_element};
6305 }
6306
6308 BasicJsonType& root;
6310 std::vector<BasicJsonType*> ref_stack {};
6312 std::vector<bool> keep_stack {};
6314 std::vector<bool> key_keep_stack {};
6316 BasicJsonType* object_element = nullptr;
6318 bool errored = false;
6320 const parser_callback_t callback = nullptr;
6322 const bool allow_exceptions = true;
6324 BasicJsonType discarded = BasicJsonType::value_t::discarded;
6325};

6434template<typename BasicJsonType>
6435class lexer_base
6436{
6437 public:
6439 enum class token_type
6440 {
6441 uninitialized,
6442 literal_true,
6443 literal_false,
6444 literal_null,
6445 value_string,
6446 value_unsigned,
6447 value_integer,
6448 value_float,
6449 begin_array,
6450 begin_object,
6451 end_array,
6452 end_object,
6453 name_separator,
6454 value_separator,
6455 parse_error,
6456 end_of_input,
6457 literal_or_value
6458 };
6459
6461 JSON_HEDLEY_RETURNS_NON_NULL
6462 JSON_HEDLEY_CONST
6463 static const char* token_type_name(const token_type t) noexcept
6464 {
6465 switch (t)
6466 {
6467 case token_type::uninitialized:
6468 return "<uninitialized>";
6469 case token_type::literal_true:
6470 return "true literal";
6471 case token_type::literal_false:
6472 return "false literal";
6473 case token_type::literal_null:
6474 return "null literal";
6475 case token_type::value_string:
6476 return "string literal";
6477 case token_type::value_unsigned:
6478 case token_type::value_integer:
6479 case token_type::value_float:
6480 return "number literal";
6481 case token_type::begin_array:
6482 return "'['";
6483 case token_type::begin_object:
6484 return "'{'";
6485 case token_type::end_array:
6486 return "']'";
6487 case token_type::end_object:
6488 return "'}'";
6489 case token_type::name_separator:
6490 return "':'";
6491 case token_type::value_separator:
6492 return "','";
6493 case token_type::parse_error:
6494 return "<parse error>";
6495 case token_type::end_of_input:
6496 return "end of input";
6497 case token_type::literal_or_value:
6498 return "'[', '{', or a literal";
6499 // LCOV_EXCL_START
6500 default: // catch non-enum values
6501 return "unknown token";
6502 // LCOV_EXCL_STOP
6503 }
6504 }
6505};
6511template<typename BasicJsonType, typename InputAdapterType>
6512class lexer : public lexer_base<BasicJsonType>
6513{
6514 using number_integer_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_integer_t;
6515 using number_unsigned_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_unsigned_t;
6516 using number_float_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_float_t;
6517 using string_t = typename BasicJsonType::string_t;
6518 using char_type = typename InputAdapterType::char_type;
6519 using char_int_type = typename std::char_traits<char_type>::int_type;
6520
6521 public:
6522 using token_type = typename lexer_base<BasicJsonType>::token_type;
6523
6524 explicit lexer(InputAdapterType&& adapter, bool ignore_comments_ = false) noexcept
6525 : ia(std::move(adapter))
6526 , ignore_comments(ignore_comments_)
6527 , decimal_point_char(static_cast<char_int_type>(get_decimal_point()))
6528 {}
6529
6530 // delete because of pointer members
6531 lexer(const lexer&) = delete;
6532 lexer(lexer&&) = default; // NOLINT(hicpp-noexcept-move,performance-noexcept-move-constructor)
6533 lexer& operator=(lexer&) = delete;
6534 lexer& operator=(lexer&&) = default; // NOLINT(hicpp-noexcept-move,performance-noexcept-move-constructor)
6535 ~lexer() = default;
6536
6537 private:
6539 // locales
6541
6543 JSON_HEDLEY_PURE
6544 static char get_decimal_point() noexcept
6545 {
6546 const auto* loc = localeconv();
6547 JSON_ASSERT(loc != nullptr);
6548 return (loc->decimal_point == nullptr) ? '.' : *(loc->decimal_point);
6549 }
6550
6552 // scan functions
6554
6570 int get_codepoint()
6571 {
6572 // this function only makes sense after reading `\u`
6573 JSON_ASSERT(current == 'u');
6574 int codepoint = 0;
6575
6576 const auto factors = { 12u, 8u, 4u, 0u };
6577 for (const auto factor : factors)
6578 {
6579 get();
6580
6581 if (current >= '0' && current <= '9')
6582 {
6583 codepoint += static_cast<int>((static_cast<unsigned int>(current) - 0x30u) << factor);
6584 }
6585 else if (current >= 'A' && current <= 'F')
6586 {
6587 codepoint += static_cast<int>((static_cast<unsigned int>(current) - 0x37u) << factor);
6588 }
6589 else if (current >= 'a' && current <= 'f')
6590 {
6591 codepoint += static_cast<int>((static_cast<unsigned int>(current) - 0x57u) << factor);
6592 }
6593 else
6594 {
6595 return -1;
6596 }
6597 }
6598
6599 JSON_ASSERT(0x0000 <= codepoint && codepoint <= 0xFFFF);
6600 return codepoint;
6601 }
6602
6618 bool next_byte_in_range(std::initializer_list<char_int_type> ranges)
6619 {
6620 JSON_ASSERT(ranges.size() == 2 || ranges.size() == 4 || ranges.size() == 6);
6621 add(current);
6622
6623 for (auto range = ranges.begin(); range != ranges.end(); ++range)
6624 {
6625 get();
6626 if (JSON_HEDLEY_LIKELY(*range <= current && current <= *(++range)))
6627 {
6628 add(current);
6629 }
6630 else
6631 {
6632 error_message = "invalid string: ill-formed UTF-8 byte";
6633 return false;
6634 }
6635 }
6636
6637 return true;
6638 }
6639
6655 token_type scan_string()
6656 {
6657 // reset token_buffer (ignore opening quote)
6658 reset();
6659
6660 // we entered the function by reading an open quote
6661 JSON_ASSERT(current == '\"');
6662
6663 while (true)
6664 {
6665 // get next character
6666 switch (get())
6667 {
6668 // end of file while parsing string
6669 case std::char_traits<char_type>::eof():
6670 {
6671 error_message = "invalid string: missing closing quote";
6672 return token_type::parse_error;
6673 }
6674
6675 // closing quote
6676 case '\"':
6677 {
6678 return token_type::value_string;
6679 }
6680
6681 // escapes
6682 case '\\':
6683 {
6684 switch (get())
6685 {
6686 // quotation mark
6687 case '\"':
6688 add('\"');
6689 break;
6690 // reverse solidus
6691 case '\\':
6692 add('\\');
6693 break;
6694 // solidus
6695 case '/':
6696 add('/');
6697 break;
6698 // backspace
6699 case 'b':
6700 add('\b');
6701 break;
6702 // form feed
6703 case 'f':
6704 add('\f');
6705 break;
6706 // line feed
6707 case 'n':
6708 add('\n');
6709 break;
6710 // carriage return
6711 case 'r':
6712 add('\r');
6713 break;
6714 // tab
6715 case 't':
6716 add('\t');
6717 break;
6718
6719 // unicode escapes
6720 case 'u':
6721 {
6722 const int codepoint1 = get_codepoint();
6723 int codepoint = codepoint1; // start with codepoint1
6724
6725 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(codepoint1 == -1))
6726 {
6727 error_message = "invalid string: '\\u' must be followed by 4 hex digits";
6728 return token_type::parse_error;
6729 }
6730
6731 // check if code point is a high surrogate
6732 if (0xD800 <= codepoint1 && codepoint1 <= 0xDBFF)
6733 {
6734 // expect next \uxxxx entry
6735 if (JSON_HEDLEY_LIKELY(get() == '\\' && get() == 'u'))
6736 {
6737 const int codepoint2 = get_codepoint();
6738
6739 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(codepoint2 == -1))
6740 {
6741 error_message = "invalid string: '\\u' must be followed by 4 hex digits";
6742 return token_type::parse_error;
6743 }
6744
6745 // check if codepoint2 is a low surrogate
6746 if (JSON_HEDLEY_LIKELY(0xDC00 <= codepoint2 && codepoint2 <= 0xDFFF))
6747 {
6748 // overwrite codepoint
6749 codepoint = static_cast<int>(
6750 // high surrogate occupies the most significant 22 bits
6751 (static_cast<unsigned int>(codepoint1) << 10u)
6752 // low surrogate occupies the least significant 15 bits
6753 + static_cast<unsigned int>(codepoint2)
6754 // there is still the 0xD800, 0xDC00 and 0x10000 noise
6755 // in the result, so we have to subtract with:
6756 // (0xD800 << 10) + DC00 - 0x10000 = 0x35FDC00
6757 - 0x35FDC00u);
6758 }
6759 else
6760 {
6761 error_message = "invalid string: surrogate U+D800..U+DBFF must be followed by U+DC00..U+DFFF";
6762 return token_type::parse_error;
6763 }
6764 }
6765 else
6766 {
6767 error_message = "invalid string: surrogate U+D800..U+DBFF must be followed by U+DC00..U+DFFF";
6768 return token_type::parse_error;
6769 }
6770 }
6771 else
6772 {
6773 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(0xDC00 <= codepoint1 && codepoint1 <= 0xDFFF))
6774 {
6775 error_message = "invalid string: surrogate U+DC00..U+DFFF must follow U+D800..U+DBFF";
6776 return token_type::parse_error;
6777 }
6778 }
6779
6780 // result of the above calculation yields a proper codepoint
6781 JSON_ASSERT(0x00 <= codepoint && codepoint <= 0x10FFFF);
6782
6783 // translate codepoint into bytes
6784 if (codepoint < 0x80)
6785 {
6786 // 1-byte characters: 0xxxxxxx (ASCII)
6787 add(static_cast<char_int_type>(codepoint));
6788 }
6789 else if (codepoint <= 0x7FF)
6790 {
6791 // 2-byte characters: 110xxxxx 10xxxxxx
6792 add(static_cast<char_int_type>(0xC0u | (static_cast<unsigned int>(codepoint) >> 6u)));
6793 add(static_cast<char_int_type>(0x80u | (static_cast<unsigned int>(codepoint) & 0x3Fu)));
6794 }
6795 else if (codepoint <= 0xFFFF)
6796 {
6797 // 3-byte characters: 1110xxxx 10xxxxxx 10xxxxxx
6798 add(static_cast<char_int_type>(0xE0u | (static_cast<unsigned int>(codepoint) >> 12u)));
6799 add(static_cast<char_int_type>(0x80u | ((static_cast<unsigned int>(codepoint) >> 6u) & 0x3Fu)));

7245 bool scan_comment()
7246 {
7247 switch (get())
7248 {
7249 // single-line comments skip input until a newline or EOF is read
7250 case '/':
7251 {
7252 while (true)
7253 {
7254 switch (get())
7255 {
7256 case '\n':
7257 case '\r':
7258 case std::char_traits<char_type>::eof():
7259 case '\0':
7260 return true;
7261
7262 default:
7263 break;
7264 }
7265 }
7266 }
7267
7268 // multi-line comments skip input until */ is read
7269 case '*':
7270 {
7271 while (true)
7272 {
7273 switch (get())
7274 {
7275 case std::char_traits<char_type>::eof():
7276 case '\0':
7277 {
7278 error_message = "invalid comment; missing closing '*/'";
7279 return false;
7280 }
7281
7282 case '*':
7283 {
7284 switch (get())
7285 {
7286 case '/':
7287 return true;
7288
7289 default:
7290 {
7291 unget();
7292 continue;
7293 }
7294 }
7295 }
7296
7297 default:
7298 continue;
7299 }
7300 }
7301 }
7302
7303 // unexpected character after reading '/'
7304 default:
7305 {
7306 error_message = "invalid comment; expecting '/' or '*' after '/'";
7307 return false;
7308 }
7309 }
7310 }

7370 token_type scan_number() // lgtm [cpp/use-of-goto]
7371 {
7372 // reset token_buffer to store the number's bytes
7373 reset();
7374
7375 // the type of the parsed number; initially set to unsigned; will be
7376 // changed if minus sign, decimal point or exponent is read
7377 token_type number_type = token_type::value_unsigned;
7378
7379 // state (init): we just found out we need to scan a number
7380 switch (current)
7381 {
7382 case '-':
7383 {
7384 add(current);
7385 goto scan_number_minus;
7386 }
7387
7388 case '0':
7389 {
7390 add(current);
7391 goto scan_number_zero;
7392 }
7393
7394 case '1':
7395 case '2':
7396 case '3':
7397 case '4':
7398 case '5':
7399 case '6':
7400 case '7':
7401 case '8':
7402 case '9':
7403 {
7404 add(current);
7405 goto scan_number_any1;
7406 }
7407
7408 // all other characters are rejected outside scan_number()
7409 default: // LCOV_EXCL_LINE
7410 JSON_ASSERT(false); // NOLINT(cert-dcl03-c,hicpp-static-assert,misc-static-assert) LCOV_EXCL_LINE
7411 }
7412
7413scan_number_minus:
7414 // state: we just parsed a leading minus sign
7415 number_type = token_type::value_integer;
7416 switch (get())
7417 {
7418 case '0':
7419 {
7420 add(current);
7421 goto scan_number_zero;
7422 }
7423
7424 case '1':
7425 case '2':
7426 case '3':
7427 case '4':
7428 case '5':
7429 case '6':
7430 case '7':
7431 case '8':
7432 case '9':
7433 {
7434 add(current);

7436 }

7439 {
7440 error_message = "invalid number; expected digit after '-'";

7442 }
7443 }

7445scan_number_zero:

7448 {
7449 case '.':
7450 {
7451 add(decimal_point_char);

7453 }
7454
7455 case 'e':
7456 case 'E':
7457 {
7458 add(current);

7473 case '3':
7474 case '4':

7643scan_number_done:

7666 }

7676 {
7677 value_integer = static_cast<number_integer_t>(x);
7678 if (value_integer == x)
7679 {
7680 return token_type::value_integer;
7681 }
7682 }
7683 }
7684
7685 // this code is reached if we parse a floating-point number or if an
7686 // integer conversion above failed
7687 strtof(value_float, token_buffer.data(), &endptr);
7688
7689 // we checked the number format before
7690 JSON_ASSERT(endptr == token_buffer.data() + token_buffer.size());
7691
7692 return token_type::value_float;
7693 }
7694
7700 JSON_HEDLEY_NON_NULL(2)
7701 token_type scan_literal(const char_type* literal_text, const std::size_t length,
7702 token_type return_type)
7703 {
7704 JSON_ASSERT(std::char_traits<char_type>::to_char_type(current) == literal_text[0]);
7705 for (std::size_t i = 1; i < length; ++i)
7706 {
7707 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(std::char_traits<char_type>::to_char_type(get()) != literal_text[i]))
7708 {
7709 error_message = "invalid literal";
7710 return token_type::parse_error;
7711 }
7712 }
7713 return return_type;
7714 }
7715
7717 // input management
7719
7721 void reset() noexcept
7722 {
7723 token_buffer.clear();
7724 token_string.clear();
7725 token_string.push_back(std::char_traits<char_type>::to_char_type(current));
7726 }
7727
7728 /*
7729 @brief get next character from the input
7730
7731 This function provides the interface to the used input adapter. It does
7732 not throw in case the input reached EOF, but returns a
7733 `std::char_traits<char>::eof()` in that case. Stores the scanned characters
7734 for use in error messages.
7735
7736 @return character read from the input
7737 */
7738 char_int_type get()
7739 {
7740 ++position.chars_read_total;
7741 ++position.chars_read_current_line;
7742
7743 if (next_unget)
7744 {
7745 // just reset the next_unget variable and work with current
7746 next_unget = false;
7747 }
7748 else
7749 {
7750 current = ia.get_character();
7751 }
7752
7753 if (JSON_HEDLEY_LIKELY(current != std::char_traits<char_type>::eof()))
7754 {
7755 token_string.push_back(std::char_traits<char_type>::to_char_type(current));
7756 }
7757
7758 if (current == '\n')
7759 {
7760 ++position.lines_read;
7761 position.chars_read_current_line = 0;
7762 }
7763
7764 return current;
7765 }
7766
7775 void unget()
7776 {
7777 next_unget = true;
7778
7779 --position.chars_read_total;
7780
7781 // in case we "unget" a newline, we have to also decrement the lines_read
7782 if (position.chars_read_current_line == 0)
7783 {
7784 if (position.lines_read > 0)
7785 {
7786 --position.lines_read;
7787 }
7788 }
7789 else
7790 {
7791 --position.chars_read_current_line;
7792 }
7793
7794 if (JSON_HEDLEY_LIKELY(current != std::char_traits<char_type>::eof()))
7795 {
7796 JSON_ASSERT(!token_string.empty());
7797 token_string.pop_back();
7798 }
7799 }
7800
7802 void add(char_int_type c)
7803 {
7804 token_buffer.push_back(static_cast<typename string_t::value_type>(c));
7805 }
7806
7807 public:
7809 // value getters
7811
7813 constexpr number_integer_t get_number_integer() const noexcept
7814 {
7815 return value_integer;
7816 }
7817
7819 constexpr number_unsigned_t get_number_unsigned() const noexcept
7820 {
7821 return value_unsigned;
7822 }
7823
7825 constexpr number_float_t get_number_float() const noexcept
7826 {
7827 return value_float;
7828 }
7829
7831 string_t& get_string()
7832 {
7833 return token_buffer;
7834 }
7835
7837 // diagnostics
7839
7841 constexpr position_t get_position() const noexcept
7842 {
7843 return position;
7844 }
7845
7849 std::string get_token_string() const
7850 {
7851 // escape control characters
7852 std::string result;
7853 for (const auto c : token_string)
7854 {
7855 if (static_cast<unsigned char>(c) <= '\x1F')
7856 {
7857 // escape control characters
7858 std::array<char, 9> cs{{}};
7859 static_cast<void>((std::snprintf)(cs.data(), cs.size(), "<U+%.4X>", static_cast<unsigned char>(c))); // NOLINT(cppcoreguidelines-pro-type-vararg,hicpp-vararg)
7860 result += cs.data();
7861 }
7862 else
7863 {
7864 // add character as is
7865 result.push_back(static_cast<std::string::value_type>(c));
7866 }
7867 }
7868
7869 return result;
7870 }
7871
7873 JSON_HEDLEY_RETURNS_NON_NULL
7874 constexpr const char* get_error_message() const noexcept
7875 {
7876 return error_message;
7877 }
7878
7880 // actual scanner
7882
7887 bool skip_bom()
7888 {
7889 if (get() == 0xEF)
7890 {
7891 // check if we completely parse the BOM
7892 return get() == 0xBB && get() == 0xBF;
7893 }
7894
7895 // the first character is not the beginning of the BOM; unget it to
7896 // process is later
7897 unget();
7898 return true;
7899 }
7900
7901 void skip_whitespace()
7902 {
7903 do
7904 {
7905 get();
7906 }
7907 while (current == ' ' || current == '\t' || current == '\n' || current == '\r');
7908 }
7909
7910 token_type scan()
7911 {
7912 // initially, skip the BOM
7913 if (position.chars_read_total == 0 && !skip_bom())
7914 {
7915 error_message = "invalid BOM; must be 0xEF 0xBB 0xBF if given";
7916 return token_type::parse_error;
7917 }
7918
7919 // read next character and ignore whitespace
7920 skip_whitespace();
7921
7922 // ignore comments
7923 while (ignore_comments && current == '/')
7924 {
7925 if (!scan_comment())
7926 {
7927 return token_type::parse_error;
7928 }
7929
7930 // skip following whitespace
7931 skip_whitespace();
7932 }
7933
7934 switch (current)
7935 {
7936 // structural characters
7937 case '[':
7938 return token_type::begin_array;
7939 case ']':
7940 return token_type::end_array;
7941 case '{':
7942 return token_type::begin_object;
7943 case '}':
7944 return token_type::end_object;
7945 case ':':
7946 return token_type::name_separator;
7947 case ',':
7948 return token_type::value_separator;
7949
7950 // literals
7951 case 't':
7952 {
7953 std::array<char_type, 4> true_literal = {{static_cast<char_type>('t'), static_cast<char_type>('r'), static_cast<char_type>('u'), static_cast<char_type>('e')}};
7954 return scan_literal(true_literal.data(), true_literal.size(), token_type::literal_true);
7955 }
7956 case 'f':
7957 {
7958 std::array<char_type, 5> false_literal = {{static_cast<char_type>('f'), static_cast<char_type>('a'), static_cast<char_type>('l'), static_cast<char_type>('s'), static_cast<char_type>('e')}};
7959 return scan_literal(false_literal.data(), false_literal.size(), token_type::literal_false);
7960 }
7961 case 'n':
7962 {
7963 std::array<char_type, 4> null_literal = {{static_cast<char_type>('n'), static_cast<char_type>('u'), static_cast<char_type>('l'), static_cast<char_type>('l')}};
7964 return scan_literal(null_literal.data(), null_literal.size(), token_type::literal_null);
7965 }
7966
7967 // string
7968 case '\"':
7969 return scan_string();
7970
7971 // number
7972 case '-':
7973 case '0':
7974 case '1':
7975 case '2':
7976 case '3':
7977 case '4':
7978 case '5':
7979 case '6':
7980 case '7':
7981 case '8':
7982 case '9':
7983 return scan_number();
7984
7985 // end of input (the null byte is needed when parsing from
7986 // string literals)
7987 case '\0':
7988 case std::char_traits<char_type>::eof():
7989 return token_type::end_of_input;
7990
7991 // error
7992 default:
7993 error_message = "invalid literal";
7994 return token_type::parse_error;
7995 }
7996 }
7997
7998 private:
8000 InputAdapterType ia;
8001
8003 const bool ignore_comments = false;
8004
8006 char_int_type current = std::char_traits<char_type>::eof();
8007
8009 bool next_unget = false;
8010
8012 position_t position {};
8013
8015 std::vector<char_type> token_string {};
8016
8018 string_t token_buffer {};
8019
8021 const char* error_message = "";
8022
8023 // number values
8024 number_integer_t value_integer = 0;
8025 number_unsigned_t value_unsigned = 0;
8026 number_float_t value_float = 0;
8027
8029 const char_int_type decimal_point_char = '.';
8030};

8032} // namespace nlohmann
