8052template<typename T>
8053using null_function_t = decltype(std::declval<T&>().null());
8054
8055template<typename T>
8056using boolean_function_t =
8057 decltype(std::declval<T&>().boolean(std::declval<bool>()));
8058
8059template<typename T, typename Integer>
8060using number_integer_function_t =
8061 decltype(std::declval<T&>().number_integer(std::declval<Integer>()));
8062
8063template<typename T, typename Unsigned>
8064using number_unsigned_function_t =
8065 decltype(std::declval<T&>().number_unsigned(std::declval<Unsigned>()));
8066
8067template<typename T, typename Float, typename String>
8068using number_float_function_t = decltype(std::declval<T&>().number_float(
8069 std::declval<Float>(), std::declval<const String&>()));
8070
8071template<typename T, typename String>
8072using string_function_t =
8073 decltype(std::declval<T&>().string(std::declval<String&>()));
8074
8075template<typename T, typename Binary>
8076using binary_function_t =
8077 decltype(std::declval<T&>().binary(std::declval<Binary&>()));
8078
8079template<typename T>
8080using start_object_function_t =
8081 decltype(std::declval<T&>().start_object(std::declval<std::size_t>()));
8082
8083template<typename T, typename String>
8084using key_function_t =
8085 decltype(std::declval<T&>().key(std::declval<String&>()));
8086
8087template<typename T>
8088using end_object_function_t = decltype(std::declval<T&>().end_object());
8089
8090template<typename T>
8091using start_array_function_t =
8092 decltype(std::declval<T&>().start_array(std::declval<std::size_t>()));
8093
8094template<typename T>
8095using end_array_function_t = decltype(std::declval<T&>().end_array());
8096
8097template<typename T, typename Exception>
8098using parse_error_function_t = decltype(std::declval<T&>().parse_error(
8099 std::declval<std::size_t>(), std::declval<const std::string&>(),
8100 std::declval<const Exception&>()));
8101
8102template<typename SAX, typename BasicJsonType>
8103struct is_sax
8104{
8105 private:
8106 static_assert(is_basic_json<BasicJsonType>::value,
8107 "BasicJsonType must be of type basic_json<...>");
8108
8109 using number_integer_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_integer_t;
8110 using number_unsigned_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_unsigned_t;
8111 using number_float_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_float_t;
8112 using string_t = typename BasicJsonType::string_t;
8113 using binary_t = typename BasicJsonType::binary_t;
8114 using exception_t = typename BasicJsonType::exception;
8115
8116 public:
8117 static constexpr bool value =
8118 is_detected_exact<bool, null_function_t, SAX>::value &&
8119 is_detected_exact<bool, boolean_function_t, SAX>::value &&
8120 is_detected_exact<bool, number_integer_function_t, SAX, number_integer_t>::value &&
8121 is_detected_exact<bool, number_unsigned_function_t, SAX, number_unsigned_t>::value &&
8122 is_detected_exact<bool, number_float_function_t, SAX, number_float_t, string_t>::value &&
8123 is_detected_exact<bool, string_function_t, SAX, string_t>::value &&
8124 is_detected_exact<bool, binary_function_t, SAX, binary_t>::value &&
8125 is_detected_exact<bool, start_object_function_t, SAX>::value &&
8126 is_detected_exact<bool, key_function_t, SAX, string_t>::value &&
8127 is_detected_exact<bool, end_object_function_t, SAX>::value &&
8128 is_detected_exact<bool, start_array_function_t, SAX>::value &&
8129 is_detected_exact<bool, end_array_function_t, SAX>::value &&
8130 is_detected_exact<bool, parse_error_function_t, SAX, exception_t>::value;
8131};
8132
8133template<typename SAX, typename BasicJsonType>
8134struct is_sax_static_asserts
8135{
8136 private:
8137 static_assert(is_basic_json<BasicJsonType>::value,
8138 "BasicJsonType must be of type basic_json<...>");
8139
8140 using number_integer_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_integer_t;
8141 using number_unsigned_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_unsigned_t;
8142 using number_float_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_float_t;
8143 using string_t = typename BasicJsonType::string_t;
8144 using binary_t = typename BasicJsonType::binary_t;
8145 using exception_t = typename BasicJsonType::exception;
8146
8147 public:
8148 static_assert(is_detected_exact<bool, null_function_t, SAX>::value,
8149 "Missing/invalid function: bool null()");
8150 static_assert(is_detected_exact<bool, boolean_function_t, SAX>::value,
8151 "Missing/invalid function: bool boolean(bool)");
8152 static_assert(is_detected_exact<bool, boolean_function_t, SAX>::value,
8153 "Missing/invalid function: bool boolean(bool)");
8154 static_assert(
8155 is_detected_exact<bool, number_integer_function_t, SAX,
8156 number_integer_t>::value,
8157 "Missing/invalid function: bool number_integer(number_integer_t)");
8158 static_assert(
8159 is_detected_exact<bool, number_unsigned_function_t, SAX,
8160 number_unsigned_t>::value,
8161 "Missing/invalid function: bool number_unsigned(number_unsigned_t)");
8162 static_assert(is_detected_exact<bool, number_float_function_t, SAX,
8163 number_float_t, string_t>::value,
8164 "Missing/invalid function: bool number_float(number_float_t, const string_t&)");
8165 static_assert(
8166 is_detected_exact<bool, string_function_t, SAX, string_t>::value,
8167 "Missing/invalid function: bool string(string_t&)");
8168 static_assert(
8169 is_detected_exact<bool, binary_function_t, SAX, binary_t>::value,
8170 "Missing/invalid function: bool binary(binary_t&)");
8171 static_assert(is_detected_exact<bool, start_object_function_t, SAX>::value,
8172 "Missing/invalid function: bool start_object(std::size_t)");
8173 static_assert(is_detected_exact<bool, key_function_t, SAX, string_t>::value,
8174 "Missing/invalid function: bool key(string_t&)");
8175 static_assert(is_detected_exact<bool, end_object_function_t, SAX>::value,
8176 "Missing/invalid function: bool end_object()");
8177 static_assert(is_detected_exact<bool, start_array_function_t, SAX>::value,
8178 "Missing/invalid function: bool start_array(std::size_t)");
8179 static_assert(is_detected_exact<bool, end_array_function_t, SAX>::value,
8180 "Missing/invalid function: bool end_array()");
8181 static_assert(
8182 is_detected_exact<bool, parse_error_function_t, SAX, exception_t>::value,
8183 "Missing/invalid function: bool parse_error(std::size_t, const "
8184 "std::string&, const exception&)");
8185};

8221// binary reader //
8223
8227template<typename BasicJsonType, typename InputAdapterType, typename SAX = json_sax_dom_parser<BasicJsonType>>
8228class binary_reader
8229{
8230 using number_integer_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_integer_t;
8231 using number_unsigned_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_unsigned_t;
8232 using number_float_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_float_t;
8233 using string_t = typename BasicJsonType::string_t;
8234 using binary_t = typename BasicJsonType::binary_t;
8235 using json_sax_t = SAX;
8236 using char_type = typename InputAdapterType::char_type;
8237 using char_int_type = typename std::char_traits<char_type>::int_type;
8238
8239 public:
8245 explicit binary_reader(InputAdapterType&& adapter) noexcept : ia(std::move(adapter))
8246 {
8247 (void)detail::is_sax_static_asserts<SAX, BasicJsonType> {};
8248 }
8249
8250 // make class move-only
8251 binary_reader(const binary_reader&) = delete;
8252 binary_reader(binary_reader&&) = default; // NOLINT(hicpp-noexcept-move,performance-noexcept-move-constructor)
8253 binary_reader& operator=(const binary_reader&) = delete;
8254 binary_reader& operator=(binary_reader&&) = default; // NOLINT(hicpp-noexcept-move,performance-noexcept-move-constructor)
8255 ~binary_reader() = default;
8256
8265 JSON_HEDLEY_NON_NULL(3)
8266 bool sax_parse(const input_format_t format,
8267 json_sax_t* sax_,
8268 const bool strict = true,
8269 const cbor_tag_handler_t tag_handler = cbor_tag_handler_t::error)
8270 {
8271 sax = sax_;
8272 bool result = false;
8273
8274 switch (format)
8275 {
8276 case input_format_t::bson:
8277 result = parse_bson_internal();
8278 break;
8279
8280 case input_format_t::cbor:
8281 result = parse_cbor_internal(true, tag_handler);
8282 break;
8283
8284 case input_format_t::msgpack:
8285 result = parse_msgpack_internal();
8286 break;
8287
8288 case input_format_t::ubjson:
8289 result = parse_ubjson_internal();
8290 break;
8291
8292 case input_format_t::json: // LCOV_EXCL_LINE
8293 default: // LCOV_EXCL_LINE
8294 JSON_ASSERT(false); // NOLINT(cert-dcl03-c,hicpp-static-assert,misc-static-assert) LCOV_EXCL_LINE
8295 }
8296
8297 // strict mode: next byte must be EOF
8298 if (result && strict)
8299 {
8300 if (format == input_format_t::ubjson)
8301 {
8302 get_ignore_noop();
8303 }
8304 else
8305 {
8306 get();
8307 }
8308
8309 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(current != std::char_traits<char_type>::eof()))
8310 {
8311 return sax->parse_error(chars_read, get_token_string(),
8312 parse_error::create(110, chars_read, exception_message(format, "expected end of input; last byte: 0x" + get_token_string(), "value"), BasicJsonType()));
8313 }
8314 }
8315
8316 return result;
8317 }
8318
8319 private:
8321 // BSON //
8323
8328 bool parse_bson_internal()
8329 {
8330 std::int32_t document_size{};
8331 get_number<std::int32_t, true>(input_format_t::bson, document_size);
8332
8333 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!sax->start_object(static_cast<std::size_t>(-1))))
8334 {
8335 return false;
8336 }
8337
8338 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!parse_bson_element_list(/*is_array*/false)))
8339 {
8340 return false;
8341 }
8342
8343 return sax->end_object();
8344 }
8345
8353 bool get_bson_cstr(string_t& result)
8354 {
8355 auto out = std::back_inserter(result);
8356 while (true)
8357 {
8358 get();
8359 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!unexpect_eof(input_format_t::bson, "cstring")))
8360 {
8361 return false;
8362 }
8363 if (current == 0x00)
8364 {
8365 return true;
8366 }
8367 *out++ = static_cast<typename string_t::value_type>(current);
8368 }
8369 }
8370
8382 template<typename NumberType>
8383 bool get_bson_string(const NumberType len, string_t& result)
8384 {
8385 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(len < 1))
8386 {
8387 auto last_token = get_token_string();
8388 return sax->parse_error(chars_read, last_token, parse_error::create(112, chars_read, exception_message(input_format_t::bson, "string length must be at least 1, is " + std::to_string(len), "string"), BasicJsonType()));
8389 }
8390
8391 return get_string(input_format_t::bson, len - static_cast<NumberType>(1), result) && get() != std::char_traits<char_type>::eof();
8392 }
8393
8403 template<typename NumberType>
8404 bool get_bson_binary(const NumberType len, binary_t& result)
8405 {
8406 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(len < 0))
8407 {
8408 auto last_token = get_token_string();
8409 return sax->parse_error(chars_read, last_token, parse_error::create(112, chars_read, exception_message(input_format_t::bson, "byte array length cannot be negative, is " + std::to_string(len), "binary"), BasicJsonType()));
8410 }
8411
8412 // All BSON binary values have a subtype
8413 std::uint8_t subtype{};
8414 get_number<std::uint8_t>(input_format_t::bson, subtype);
8415 result.set_subtype(subtype);
8416
8417 return get_binary(input_format_t::bson, len, result);
8418 }
8419
8430 bool parse_bson_element_internal(const char_int_type element_type,
8431 const std::size_t element_type_parse_position)
8432 {
8433 switch (element_type)
8434 {
8435 case 0x01: // double
8436 {
8437 double number{};
8438 return get_number<double, true>(input_format_t::bson, number) && sax->number_float(static_cast<number_float_t>(number), "");
8439 }
8440
8441 case 0x02: // string
8442 {
8443 std::int32_t len{};
8444 string_t value;
8445 return get_number<std::int32_t, true>(input_format_t::bson, len) && get_bson_string(len, value) && sax->string(value);
8446 }
8447
8448 case 0x03: // object
8449 {
8450 return parse_bson_internal();
8451 }
8452
8453 case 0x04: // array
8454 {
8455 return parse_bson_array();
8456 }
8457
8458 case 0x05: // binary
8459 {
8460 std::int32_t len{};
8461 binary_t value;
8462 return get_number<std::int32_t, true>(input_format_t::bson, len) && get_bson_binary(len, value) && sax->binary(value);
8463 }
8464
8465 case 0x08: // boolean
8466 {
8467 return sax->boolean(get() != 0);
8468 }
8469
8470 case 0x0A: // null
8471 {
8472 return sax->null();
8473 }
8474
8475 case 0x10: // int32
8476 {
8477 std::int32_t value{};
8478 return get_number<std::int32_t, true>(input_format_t::bson, value) && sax->number_integer(value);
8479 }
8480
8481 case 0x12: // int64
8482 {
8483 std::int64_t value{};
8484 return get_number<std::int64_t, true>(input_format_t::bson, value) && sax->number_integer(value);
8485 }
8486
8487 default: // anything else not supported (yet)
8488 {
8489 std::array<char, 3> cr{{}};
8490 static_cast<void>((std::snprintf)(cr.data(), cr.size(), "%.2hhX", static_cast<unsigned char>(element_type))); // NOLINT(cppcoreguidelines-pro-type-vararg,hicpp-vararg)
8491 return sax->parse_error(element_type_parse_position, std::string(cr.data()), parse_error::create(114, element_type_parse_position, "Unsupported BSON record type 0x" + std::string(cr.data()), BasicJsonType()));
8492 }
8493 }
8494 }
8495
8508 bool parse_bson_element_list(const bool is_array)
8509 {
8510 string_t key;
8511
8512 while (auto element_type = get())
8513 {
8514 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!unexpect_eof(input_format_t::bson, "element list")))
8515 {
8516 return false;
8517 }
8518
8519 const std::size_t element_type_parse_position = chars_read;
8520 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!get_bson_cstr(key)))
8521 {
8522 return false;
8523 }
8524
8525 if (!is_array && !sax->key(key))
8526 {
8527 return false;
8528 }
8529
8530 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!parse_bson_element_internal(element_type, element_type_parse_position)))
8531 {
8532 return false;
8533 }
8534
8535 // get_bson_cstr only appends
8536 key.clear();
8537 }
8538
8539 return true;
8540 }
8541
8546 bool parse_bson_array()
8547 {
8548 std::int32_t document_size{};
8549 get_number<std::int32_t, true>(input_format_t::bson, document_size);
8550
8551 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!sax->start_array(static_cast<std::size_t>(-1))))
8552 {
8553 return false;
8554 }
8555
8556 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!parse_bson_element_list(/*is_array*/true)))
8557 {
8558 return false;
8559 }
8560
8561 return sax->end_array();
8562 }

8576 bool parse_cbor_internal(const bool get_char,

8591 case 0x05:

8593 case 0x07:

8595 case 0x09:

8600 case 0x0E:

8602 case 0x10:
8603 case 0x11:
8604 case 0x12:
8605 case 0x13:
8606 case 0x14:
8607 case 0x15:
8608 case 0x16:
8609 case 0x17:

8630 case 0x1B: // Unsigned integer (eight-byte uint64_t follows)

8637 case 0x20:
8638 case 0x21:
8639 case 0x22:
8640 case 0x23:
8641 case 0x24:
8642 case 0x25:
8643 case 0x26:
8644 case 0x27:
8645 case 0x28:
8646 case 0x29:
8647 case 0x2A:
8648 case 0x2B:
8649 case 0x2C:

8652 case 0x2F:

8655 case 0x32:
8656 case 0x33:
8657 case 0x34:
8658 case 0x35:
8659 case 0x36:
8660 case 0x37:

8673 }

8689 case 0x40:
8690 case 0x41:

8693 case 0x44:

8727 case 0x63:

8729 case 0x65:
8730 case 0x66:
8731 case 0x67:

8760 case 0x81:
8761 case 0x82:
8762 case 0x83:
8763 case 0x84:
8764 case 0x85:
8765 case 0x86:
8766 case 0x87:
8767 case 0x88:
8768 case 0x89:
8769 case 0x8A:
8770 case 0x8B:
8771 case 0x8C:

8776 case 0x91:

8779 case 0x94:

8797 case 0x9A: // array (four-byte uint32_t for n follow)

8799 std::uint32_t len{};

8801 }

8803 case 0x9B: // array (eight-byte uint64_t for n follow)
8804 {

8811
8812 // map (0x00..0x17 pairs of data items follow)
8813 case 0xA0:
8814 case 0xA1:
8815 case 0xA2:
8816 case 0xA3:
8817 case 0xA4:
8818 case 0xA5:
8819 case 0xA6:
8820 case 0xA7:
8821 case 0xA8:
8822 case 0xA9:
8823 case 0xAA:
8824 case 0xAB:
8825 case 0xAC:
8826 case 0xAD:
8827 case 0xAE:
8828 case 0xAF:
8829 case 0xB0:
8830 case 0xB1:
8831 case 0xB2:
8832 case 0xB3:
8833 case 0xB4:
8834 case 0xB5:
8835 case 0xB6:
8836 case 0xB7:
8837 return get_cbor_object(static_cast<std::size_t>(static_cast<unsigned int>(current) & 0x1Fu), tag_handler);
8838
8839 case 0xB8: // map (one-byte uint8_t for n follows)
8840 {
8841 std::uint8_t len{};
8842 return get_number(input_format_t::cbor, len) && get_cbor_object(static_cast<std::size_t>(len), tag_handler);
8843 }

8845 case 0xB9: // map (two-byte uint16_t for n follow)
8846 {
8847 std::uint16_t len{};

8849 }

8851 case 0xBA: // map (four-byte uint32_t for n follow)

8853 std::uint32_t len{};

8855 }

8857 case 0xBB: // map (eight-byte uint64_t for n follow)
8858 {
8859 std::uint64_t len{};

8861 }
8862
8863 case 0xBF: // map (indefinite length)
8864 return get_cbor_object(static_cast<std::size_t>(-1), tag_handler);
8865
8866 case 0xC6: // tagged item
8867 case 0xC7:
8868 case 0xC8:
8869 case 0xC9:
8870 case 0xCA:
8871 case 0xCB:
8872 case 0xCC:
8873 case 0xCD:
8874 case 0xCE:
8875 case 0xCF:
8876 case 0xD0:
8877 case 0xD1:
8878 case 0xD2:
8879 case 0xD3:
8880 case 0xD4:
8881 case 0xD8: // tagged item (1 bytes follow)
8882 case 0xD9: // tagged item (2 bytes follow)
8883 case 0xDA: // tagged item (4 bytes follow)
8884 case 0xDB: // tagged item (8 bytes follow)
8885 {
8886 switch (tag_handler)
8887 {
8888 case cbor_tag_handler_t::error:
8889 {
8890 auto last_token = get_token_string();
8891 return sax->parse_error(chars_read, last_token, parse_error::create(112, chars_read, exception_message(input_format_t::cbor, "invalid byte: 0x" + last_token, "value"), BasicJsonType()));
8892 }
8893
8894 case cbor_tag_handler_t::ignore:
8895 {
8896 // ignore binary subtype
8897 switch (current)
8898 {
8899 case 0xD8:
8900 {
8901 std::uint8_t subtype_to_ignore{};
8902 get_number(input_format_t::cbor, subtype_to_ignore);
8903 break;
8904 }
8905 case 0xD9:
8906 {
8907 std::uint16_t subtype_to_ignore{};
8908 get_number(input_format_t::cbor, subtype_to_ignore);
8909 break;
8910 }
8911 case 0xDA:
8912 {
8913 std::uint32_t subtype_to_ignore{};
8914 get_number(input_format_t::cbor, subtype_to_ignore);
8915 break;
8916 }
8917 case 0xDB:
8918 {
8919 std::uint64_t subtype_to_ignore{};
8920 get_number(input_format_t::cbor, subtype_to_ignore);
8921 break;
8922 }
8923 default:
8924 break;
8925 }
8926 return parse_cbor_internal(true, tag_handler);
8927 }
8928
8929 case cbor_tag_handler_t::store:
8930 {
8931 binary_t b;
8932 // use binary subtype and store in binary container
8933 switch (current)
8934 {
8935 case 0xD8:
8936 {
8937 std::uint8_t subtype{};
8938 get_number(input_format_t::cbor, subtype);
8939 b.set_subtype(detail::conditional_static_cast<typename binary_t::subtype_type>(subtype));
8940 break;
8941 }
8942 case 0xD9:
8943 {
8944 std::uint16_t subtype{};
8945 get_number(input_format_t::cbor, subtype);
8946 b.set_subtype(detail::conditional_static_cast<typename binary_t::subtype_type>(subtype));
8947 break;
8948 }
8949 case 0xDA:
8950 {
8951 std::uint32_t subtype{};
8952 get_number(input_format_t::cbor, subtype);
8953 b.set_subtype(detail::conditional_static_cast<typename binary_t::subtype_type>(subtype));
8954 break;
8955 }
8956 case 0xDB:
8957 {
8958 std::uint64_t subtype{};
8959 get_number(input_format_t::cbor, subtype);
8960 b.set_subtype(detail::conditional_static_cast<typename binary_t::subtype_type>(subtype));
8961 break;
8962 }
8963 default:
8964 return parse_cbor_internal(true, tag_handler);
8965 }
8966 get();
8967 return get_cbor_binary(b) && sax->binary(b);
8968 }
8969
8970 default: // LCOV_EXCL_LINE
8971 JSON_ASSERT(false); // NOLINT(cert-dcl03-c,hicpp-static-assert,misc-static-assert) LCOV_EXCL_LINE
8972 return false; // LCOV_EXCL_LINE
8973 }
8974 }
8975
8976 case 0xF4: // false
8977 return sax->boolean(false);
8978
8979 case 0xF5: // true
8980 return sax->boolean(true);
8981
8982 case 0xF6: // null
8983 return sax->null();
8984
8985 case 0xF9: // Half-Precision Float (two-byte IEEE 754)
8986 {
8987 const auto byte1_raw = get();
8988 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!unexpect_eof(input_format_t::cbor, "number")))
8989 {
8990 return false;
8991 }
8992 const auto byte2_raw = get();
8993 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!unexpect_eof(input_format_t::cbor, "number")))
8994 {
8995 return false;
8996 }
8997
8998 const auto byte1 = static_cast<unsigned char>(byte1_raw);
8999 const auto byte2 = static_cast<unsigned char>(byte2_raw);
9000
9001 // code from RFC 7049, Appendix D, Figure 3:
9002 // As half-precision floating-point numbers were only added
9003 // to IEEE 754 in 2008, today's programming platforms often
9004 // still only have limited support for them. It is very
9005 // easy to include at least decoding support for them even
9006 // without such support. An example of a small decoder for
9007 // half-precision floating-point numbers in the C language
9008 // is shown in Fig. 3.
9009 const auto half = static_cast<unsigned int>((byte1 << 8u) + byte2);
9010 const double val = [&half]
9011 {
9012 const int exp = (half >> 10u) & 0x1Fu;
9013 const unsigned int mant = half & 0x3FFu;
9014 JSON_ASSERT(0 <= exp&& exp <= 32);
9015 JSON_ASSERT(mant <= 1024);
9016 switch (exp)
9017 {
9018 case 0:
9019 return std::ldexp(mant, -24);
9020 case 31:
9021 return (mant == 0)
9022 ? std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity()
9023 : std::numeric_limits<double>::quiet_NaN();
9024 default:
9025 return std::ldexp(mant + 1024, exp - 25);
9026 }
9027 }();
9028 return sax->number_float((half & 0x8000u) != 0
9029 ? static_cast<number_float_t>(-val)
9030 : static_cast<number_float_t>(val), "");
9031 }
9032
9033 case 0xFA: // Single-Precision Float (four-byte IEEE 754)
9034 {
9035 float number{};
9036 return get_number(input_format_t::cbor, number) && sax->number_float(static_cast<number_float_t>(number), "");
9037 }
9038
9039 case 0xFB: // Double-Precision Float (eight-byte IEEE 754)
9040 {
9041 double number{};
9042 return get_number(input_format_t::cbor, number) && sax->number_float(static_cast<number_float_t>(number), "");
9043 }
9044
9045 default: // anything else (0xFF is handled inside the other types)
9046 {
9047 auto last_token = get_token_string();
9048 return sax->parse_error(chars_read, last_token, parse_error::create(112, chars_read, exception_message(input_format_t::cbor, "invalid byte: 0x" + last_token, "value"), BasicJsonType()));
9049 }
9050 }
9051 }
9052
9064 bool get_cbor_string(string_t& result)
9065 {
9066 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!unexpect_eof(input_format_t::cbor, "string")))
9067 {
9068 return false;
9069 }
9070
9071 switch (current)
9072 {
9073 // UTF-8 string (0x00..0x17 bytes follow)
9074 case 0x60:
9075 case 0x61:
9076 case 0x62:
9077 case 0x63:
9078 case 0x64:
9079 case 0x65:
9080 case 0x66:
9081 case 0x67:
9082 case 0x68:
9083 case 0x69:
9084 case 0x6A:
9085 case 0x6B:
9086 case 0x6C:
9087 case 0x6D:
9088 case 0x6E:
9089 case 0x6F:
9090 case 0x70:
9091 case 0x71:
9092 case 0x72:
9093 case 0x73:
9094 case 0x74:
9095 case 0x75:
9096 case 0x76:
9097 case 0x77:
9098 {
9099 return get_string(input_format_t::cbor, static_cast<unsigned int>(current) & 0x1Fu, result);
9100 }
9101
9102 case 0x78: // UTF-8 string (one-byte uint8_t for n follows)
9103 {
9104 std::uint8_t len{};
9105 return get_number(input_format_t::cbor, len) && get_string(input_format_t::cbor, len, result);
9106 }
9107
9108 case 0x79: // UTF-8 string (two-byte uint16_t for n follow)
9109 {
9110 std::uint16_t len{};
9111 return get_number(input_format_t::cbor, len) && get_string(input_format_t::cbor, len, result);
9112 }
9113
9114 case 0x7A: // UTF-8 string (four-byte uint32_t for n follow)
9115 {
9116 std::uint32_t len{};
9117 return get_number(input_format_t::cbor, len) && get_string(input_format_t::cbor, len, result);
9118 }
9119
9120 case 0x7B: // UTF-8 string (eight-byte uint64_t for n follow)
9121 {
9122 std::uint64_t len{};
9123 return get_number(input_format_t::cbor, len) && get_string(input_format_t::cbor, len, result);
9124 }
9125
9126 case 0x7F: // UTF-8 string (indefinite length)
9127 {
9128 while (get() != 0xFF)
9129 {
9130 string_t chunk;
9131 if (!get_cbor_string(chunk))
9132 {
9133 return false;
9134 }
9135 result.append(chunk);
9136 }
9137 return true;
9138 }
9139
9140 default:
9141 {
9142 auto last_token = get_token_string();
9143 return sax->parse_error(chars_read, last_token, parse_error::create(113, chars_read, exception_message(input_format_t::cbor, "expected length specification (0x60-0x7B) or indefinite string type (0x7F); last byte: 0x" + last_token, "string"), BasicJsonType()));
9144 }
9145 }
9146 }

9199 std::uint8_t len{};
9200 return get_number(input_format_t::cbor, len) &&
9201 get_binary(input_format_t::cbor, len, result);
9202 }
9203
9204 case 0x59: // Binary data (two-byte uint16_t for n follow)
9205 {
9206 std::uint16_t len{};
9207 return get_number(input_format_t::cbor, len) &&
9208 get_binary(input_format_t::cbor, len, result);
9209 }
9210
9211 case 0x5A: // Binary data (four-byte uint32_t for n follow)
9212 {
9213 std::uint32_t len{};
9214 return get_number(input_format_t::cbor, len) &&
9215 get_binary(input_format_t::cbor, len, result);
9216 }
9217
9218 case 0x5B: // Binary data (eight-byte uint64_t for n follow)
9219 {
9220 std::uint64_t len{};
9221 return get_number(input_format_t::cbor, len) &&
9222 get_binary(input_format_t::cbor, len, result);
9223 }
9224
9225 case 0x5F: // Binary data (indefinite length)
9226 {
9227 while (get() != 0xFF)
9228 {
9229 binary_t chunk;
9230 if (!get_cbor_binary(chunk))
9231 {
9232 return false;
9233 }
9234 result.insert(result.end(), chunk.begin(), chunk.end());
9235 }
9236 return true;
9237 }
9238
9239 default:
9240 {
9241 auto last_token = get_token_string();
9242 return sax->parse_error(chars_read, last_token, parse_error::create(113, chars_read, exception_message(input_format_t::cbor, "expected length specification (0x40-0x5B) or indefinite binary array type (0x5F); last byte: 0x" + last_token, "binary"), BasicJsonType()));
9243 }
9244 }
9245 }
9246
9253 bool get_cbor_array(const std::size_t len,
9254 const cbor_tag_handler_t tag_handler)
9255 {
9256 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!sax->start_array(len)))
9257 {
9258 return false;
9259 }
9260
9261 if (len != static_cast<std::size_t>(-1))
9262 {
9263 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < len; ++i)
9264 {
9265 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!parse_cbor_internal(true, tag_handler)))
9266 {
9267 return false;
9268 }
9269 }
9270 }
9271 else
9272 {
9273 while (get() != 0xFF)
9274 {
9275 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!parse_cbor_internal(false, tag_handler)))
9276 {
9277 return false;
9278 }
9279 }
9280 }
9281
9282 return sax->end_array();
9283 }
9284
9291 bool get_cbor_object(const std::size_t len,
9292 const cbor_tag_handler_t tag_handler)
9293 {
9294 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!sax->start_object(len)))
9295 {
9296 return false;
9297 }
9298
9299 if (len != 0)
9300 {
9301 string_t key;
9302 if (len != static_cast<std::size_t>(-1))
9303 {
9304 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < len; ++i)
9305 {
9306 get();
9307 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!get_cbor_string(key) || !sax->key(key)))
9308 {
9309 return false;
9310 }
9311
9312 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!parse_cbor_internal(true, tag_handler)))
9313 {
9314 return false;
9315 }
9316 key.clear();
9317 }
9318 }
9319 else
9320 {
9321 while (get() != 0xFF)
9322 {
9323 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!get_cbor_string(key) || !sax->key(key)))
9324 {
9325 return false;
9326 }
9327
9328 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!parse_cbor_internal(true, tag_handler)))
9329 {
9330 return false;
9331 }
9332 key.clear();
9333 }
9334 }
9335 }
9336
9337 return sax->end_object();
9338 }

9809 bool get_msgpack_binary(binary_t& result)
9810 {
9811 // helper function to set the subtype
9812 auto assign_and_return_true = [&result](std::int8_t subtype)
9813 {
9814 result.set_subtype(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(subtype));
9815 return true;
9816 };
9817
9818 switch (current)
9819 {
9820 case 0xC4: // bin 8
9821 {
9822 std::uint8_t len{};
9823 return get_number(input_format_t::msgpack, len) &&
9824 get_binary(input_format_t::msgpack, len, result);
9825 }
9826
9827 case 0xC5: // bin 16
9828 {
9829 std::uint16_t len{};

9831 get_binary(input_format_t::msgpack, len, result);
9832 }
9833
9834 case 0xC6: // bin 32
9835 {
9836 std::uint32_t len{};
9837 return get_number(input_format_t::msgpack, len) &&
9838 get_binary(input_format_t::msgpack, len, result);
9839 }
9840
9841 case 0xC7: // ext 8
9842 {
9843 std::uint8_t len{};
9844 std::int8_t subtype{};
9845 return get_number(input_format_t::msgpack, len) &&
9846 get_number(input_format_t::msgpack, subtype) &&
9847 get_binary(input_format_t::msgpack, len, result) &&
9848 assign_and_return_true(subtype);
9849 }
9850
9851 case 0xC8: // ext 16
9852 {
9853 std::uint16_t len{};
9854 std::int8_t subtype{};
9855 return get_number(input_format_t::msgpack, len) &&
9856 get_number(input_format_t::msgpack, subtype) &&
9857 get_binary(input_format_t::msgpack, len, result) &&
9858 assign_and_return_true(subtype);
9859 }
9860
9861 case 0xC9: // ext 32
9862 {
9863 std::uint32_t len{};
9864 std::int8_t subtype{};
9865 return get_number(input_format_t::msgpack, len) &&
9866 get_number(input_format_t::msgpack, subtype) &&
9867 get_binary(input_format_t::msgpack, len, result) &&
9868 assign_and_return_true(subtype);
9869 }
9870
9871 case 0xD4: // fixext 1
9872 {
9873 std::int8_t subtype{};
9874 return get_number(input_format_t::msgpack, subtype) &&
9875 get_binary(input_format_t::msgpack, 1, result) &&
9876 assign_and_return_true(subtype);
9877 }
9878
9879 case 0xD5: // fixext 2
9880 {
9881 std::int8_t subtype{};
9882 return get_number(input_format_t::msgpack, subtype) &&
9883 get_binary(input_format_t::msgpack, 2, result) &&
9884 assign_and_return_true(subtype);
9885 }
9886
9887 case 0xD6: // fixext 4
9888 {
9889 std::int8_t subtype{};
9890 return get_number(input_format_t::msgpack, subtype) &&
9891 get_binary(input_format_t::msgpack, 4, result) &&
9892 assign_and_return_true(subtype);
9893 }
9894
9895 case 0xD7: // fixext 8
9896 {
9897 std::int8_t subtype{};
9898 return get_number(input_format_t::msgpack, subtype) &&
9899 get_binary(input_format_t::msgpack, 8, result) &&
9900 assign_and_return_true(subtype);
9901 }
9902
9903 case 0xD8: // fixext 16
9904 {
9905 std::int8_t subtype{};
9906 return get_number(input_format_t::msgpack, subtype) &&
9907 get_binary(input_format_t::msgpack, 16, result) &&
9908 assign_and_return_true(subtype);
9909 }
9910
9911 default: // LCOV_EXCL_LINE
9912 return false; // LCOV_EXCL_LINE
9913 }

9920 bool get_msgpack_array(const std::size_t len)
9921 {
9922 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!sax->start_array(len)))
9923 {

9925 }
9926
9927 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < len; ++i)
9928 {
9929 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!parse_msgpack_internal()))

9931 return false;

9948
9949 string_t key;

9998 bool get_ubjson_string(string_t& result, const bool get_char = true)
9999 {
10000 if (get_char)
10001 {
10002 get(); // TODO(niels): may we ignore N here?
10003 }
10004
10005 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!unexpect_eof(input_format_t::ubjson, "value")))
10006 {
10007 return false;
10008 }
10009
10010 switch (current)
10011 {
10012 case 'U':
10013 {
10014 std::uint8_t len{};
10015 return get_number(input_format_t::ubjson, len) && get_string(input_format_t::ubjson, len, result);
10016 }
10017
10018 case 'i':
10019 {
10020 std::int8_t len{};
10021 return get_number(input_format_t::ubjson, len) && get_string(input_format_t::ubjson, len, result);
10022 }
10023
10024 case 'I':
10025 {
10026 std::int16_t len{};
10027 return get_number(input_format_t::ubjson, len) && get_string(input_format_t::ubjson, len, result);
10028 }
10029
10030 case 'l':
10031 {
10032 std::int32_t len{};
10033 return get_number(input_format_t::ubjson, len) && get_string(input_format_t::ubjson, len, result);
10034 }
10035
10036 case 'L':
10037 {
10038 std::int64_t len{};
10039 return get_number(input_format_t::ubjson, len) && get_string(input_format_t::ubjson, len, result);
10040 }
10041
10042 default:
10043 auto last_token = get_token_string();
10044 return sax->parse_error(chars_read, last_token, parse_error::create(113, chars_read, exception_message(input_format_t::ubjson, "expected length type specification (U, i, I, l, L); last byte: 0x" + last_token, "string"), BasicJsonType()));
10045 }
10046 }
10047
10052 bool get_ubjson_size_value(std::size_t& result)
10053 {
10054 switch (get_ignore_noop())
10055 {
10056 case 'U':
10057 {
10058 std::uint8_t number{};
10059 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!get_number(input_format_t::ubjson, number)))
10060 {
10061 return false;
10062 }
10063 result = static_cast<std::size_t>(number);
10064 return true;
10065 }
10066
10067 case 'i':
10068 {
10069 std::int8_t number{};
10070 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!get_number(input_format_t::ubjson, number)))
10071 {
10072 return false;
10073 }
10074 result = static_cast<std::size_t>(number); // NOLINT(bugprone-signed-char-misuse,cert-str34-c): number is not a char
10075 return true;
10076 }
10077
10078 case 'I':
10079 {
10080 std::int16_t number{};
10081 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!get_number(input_format_t::ubjson, number)))
10082 {
10083 return false;
10084 }
10085 result = static_cast<std::size_t>(number);
10086 return true;
10087 }
10088
10089 case 'l':
10090 {
10091 std::int32_t number{};
10092 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!get_number(input_format_t::ubjson, number)))
10093 {
10094 return false;
10095 }
10096 result = static_cast<std::size_t>(number);
10097 return true;
10098 }
10099
10100 case 'L':
10101 {
10102 std::int64_t number{};
10103 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!get_number(input_format_t::ubjson, number)))
10104 {
10105 return false;
10106 }
10107 result = static_cast<std::size_t>(number);
10108 return true;
10109 }
10110
10111 default:
10112 {
10113 auto last_token = get_token_string();
10114 return sax->parse_error(chars_read, last_token, parse_error::create(113, chars_read, exception_message(input_format_t::ubjson, "expected length type specification (U, i, I, l, L) after '#'; last byte: 0x" + last_token, "size"), BasicJsonType()));
10115 }
10116 }
10117 }
10118
10129 bool get_ubjson_size_type(std::pair<std::size_t, char_int_type>& result)
10130 {
10131 result.first = string_t::npos; // size
10132 result.second = 0; // type
10133
10134 get_ignore_noop();
10135
10136 if (current == '$')
10137 {
10138 result.second = get(); // must not ignore 'N', because 'N' maybe the type
10139 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!unexpect_eof(input_format_t::ubjson, "type")))
10140 {
10141 return false;
10142 }
10143
10144 get_ignore_noop();
10145 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(current != '#'))
10146 {
10147 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!unexpect_eof(input_format_t::ubjson, "value")))
10148 {
10149 return false;
10150 }
10151 auto last_token = get_token_string();
10152 return sax->parse_error(chars_read, last_token, parse_error::create(112, chars_read, exception_message(input_format_t::ubjson, "expected '#' after type information; last byte: 0x" + last_token, "size"), BasicJsonType()));
10153 }
10154
10155 return get_ubjson_size_value(result.first);
10156 }
10157
10158 if (current == '#')
10159 {
10160 return get_ubjson_size_value(result.first);
10161 }
10162
10163 return true;
10164 }
10165
10170 bool get_ubjson_value(const char_int_type prefix)
10171 {
10172 switch (prefix)
10173 {
10174 case std::char_traits<char_type>::eof(): // EOF
10175 return unexpect_eof(input_format_t::ubjson, "value");
10176
10177 case 'T': // true
10178 return sax->boolean(true);
10179 case 'F': // false
10180 return sax->boolean(false);
10181
10182 case 'Z': // null
10183 return sax->null();
10184
10185 case 'U':
10186 {
10187 std::uint8_t number{};
10188 return get_number(input_format_t::ubjson, number) && sax->number_unsigned(number);
10189 }
10190
10191 case 'i':
10192 {
10193 std::int8_t number{};
10194 return get_number(input_format_t::ubjson, number) && sax->number_integer(number);
10195 }
10196
10197 case 'I':
10198 {
10199 std::int16_t number{};
10200 return get_number(input_format_t::ubjson, number) && sax->number_integer(number);
10201 }
10202
10203 case 'l':
10204 {
10205 std::int32_t number{};
10206 return get_number(input_format_t::ubjson, number) && sax->number_integer(number);
10207 }
10208
10209 case 'L':
10210 {
10211 std::int64_t number{};
10212 return get_number(input_format_t::ubjson, number) && sax->number_integer(number);
10213 }
10214
10215 case 'd':
10216 {
10217 float number{};
10218 return get_number(input_format_t::ubjson, number) && sax->number_float(static_cast<number_float_t>(number), "");
10219 }
10220
10221 case 'D':
10222 {
10223 double number{};
10224 return get_number(input_format_t::ubjson, number) && sax->number_float(static_cast<number_float_t>(number), "");
10225 }
10226
10227 case 'H':
10228 {
10229 return get_ubjson_high_precision_number();
10230 }
10231
10232 case 'C': // char
10233 {
10234 get();
10235 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!unexpect_eof(input_format_t::ubjson, "char")))
10236 {
10237 return false;
10238 }
10239 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(current > 127))
10240 {
10241 auto last_token = get_token_string();
10242 return sax->parse_error(chars_read, last_token, parse_error::create(113, chars_read, exception_message(input_format_t::ubjson, "byte after 'C' must be in range 0x00..0x7F; last byte: 0x" + last_token, "char"), BasicJsonType()));
10243 }
10244 string_t s(1, static_cast<typename string_t::value_type>(current));
10245 return sax->string(s);
10246 }
10247
10248 case 'S': // string
10249 {
10250 string_t s;
10251 return get_ubjson_string(s) && sax->string(s);
10252 }
10253
10254 case '[': // array
10255 return get_ubjson_array();
10256
10257 case '{': // object
10258 return get_ubjson_object();
10259
10260 default: // anything else
10261 {
10262 auto last_token = get_token_string();
10263 return sax->parse_error(chars_read, last_token, parse_error::create(112, chars_read, exception_message(input_format_t::ubjson, "invalid byte: 0x" + last_token, "value"), BasicJsonType()));
10264 }
10265 }
10266 }
10267
10271 bool get_ubjson_array()
10272 {
10273 std::pair<std::size_t, char_int_type> size_and_type;
10274 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!get_ubjson_size_type(size_and_type)))
10275 {
10276 return false;
10277 }
10278
10279 if (size_and_type.first != string_t::npos)
10280 {
10281 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!sax->start_array(size_and_type.first)))
10282 {
10283 return false;
10284 }
10285
10286 if (size_and_type.second != 0)
10287 {
10288 if (size_and_type.second != 'N')
10289 {
10290 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < size_and_type.first; ++i)
10291 {
10292 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!get_ubjson_value(size_and_type.second)))
10293 {
10294 return false;
10295 }
10296 }
10297 }
10298 }
10299 else
10300 {
10301 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < size_and_type.first; ++i)
10302 {
10303 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!parse_ubjson_internal()))
10304 {
10305 return false;
10306 }
10307 }
10308 }
10309 }
10310 else
10311 {
10312 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!sax->start_array(static_cast<std::size_t>(-1))))
10313 {
10314 return false;
10315 }
10316
10317 while (current != ']')
10318 {
10319 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!parse_ubjson_internal(false)))
10320 {
10321 return false;
10322 }
10323 get_ignore_noop();
10324 }
10325 }
10326
10327 return sax->end_array();
10328 }
10329
10333 bool get_ubjson_object()
10334 {
10335 std::pair<std::size_t, char_int_type> size_and_type;
10336 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!get_ubjson_size_type(size_and_type)))
10337 {
10338 return false;
10339 }
10340
10341 string_t key;
10342 if (size_and_type.first != string_t::npos)
10343 {
10344 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!sax->start_object(size_and_type.first)))
10345 {
10346 return false;
10347 }
10348
10349 if (size_and_type.second != 0)
10350 {
10351 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < size_and_type.first; ++i)
10352 {
10353 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!get_ubjson_string(key) || !sax->key(key)))
10354 {
10355 return false;
10356 }
10357 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!get_ubjson_value(size_and_type.second)))
10358 {
10359 return false;
10360 }
10361 key.clear();
10362 }
10363 }
10364 else
10365 {
10366 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < size_and_type.first; ++i)
10367 {
10368 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!get_ubjson_string(key) || !sax->key(key)))
10369 {
10370 return false;
10371 }
10372 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!parse_ubjson_internal()))
10373 {
10374 return false;
10375 }
10376 key.clear();
10377 }
10378 }
10379 }
10380 else
10381 {
10382 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!sax->start_object(static_cast<std::size_t>(-1))))
10383 {
10384 return false;
10385 }
10386
10387 while (current != '}')
10388 {
10389 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!get_ubjson_string(key, false) || !sax->key(key)))
10390 {
10391 return false;
10392 }
10393 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!parse_ubjson_internal()))
10394 {
10395 return false;
10396 }
10397 get_ignore_noop();
10398 key.clear();
10399 }
10400 }
10401
10402 return sax->end_object();
10403 }
10404
10405 // Note, no reader for UBJSON binary types is implemented because they do
10406 // not exist
10407
10408 bool get_ubjson_high_precision_number()
10409 {
10410 // get size of following number string
10411 std::size_t size{};
10412 auto res = get_ubjson_size_value(size);
10413 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!res))
10414 {
10415 return res;
10416 }
10417
10418 // get number string
10419 std::vector<char> number_vector;
10420 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < size; ++i)
10421 {
10422 get();
10423 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!unexpect_eof(input_format_t::ubjson, "number")))
10424 {
10425 return false;
10426 }
10427 number_vector.push_back(static_cast<char>(current));
10428 }
10429
10430 // parse number string
10431 using ia_type = decltype(detail::input_adapter(number_vector));
10432 auto number_lexer = detail::lexer<BasicJsonType, ia_type>(detail::input_adapter(number_vector), false);
10433 const auto result_number = number_lexer.scan();
10434 const auto number_string = number_lexer.get_token_string();
10435 const auto result_remainder = number_lexer.scan();
10436
10437 using token_type = typename detail::lexer_base<BasicJsonType>::token_type;
10438
10439 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(result_remainder != token_type::end_of_input))
10440 {
10441 return sax->parse_error(chars_read, number_string, parse_error::create(115, chars_read, exception_message(input_format_t::ubjson, "invalid number text: " + number_lexer.get_token_string(), "high-precision number"), BasicJsonType()));
10442 }
10443
10444 switch (result_number)
10445 {
10446 case token_type::value_integer:
10447 return sax->number_integer(number_lexer.get_number_integer());
10448 case token_type::value_unsigned:
10449 return sax->number_unsigned(number_lexer.get_number_unsigned());
10450 case token_type::value_float:
10451 return sax->number_float(number_lexer.get_number_float(), std::move(number_string));
10452 case token_type::uninitialized:
10453 case token_type::literal_true:
10454 case token_type::literal_false:
10455 case token_type::literal_null:
10456 case token_type::value_string:
10457 case token_type::begin_array:
10458 case token_type::begin_object:
10459 case token_type::end_array:
10460 case token_type::end_object:
10461 case token_type::name_separator:
10462 case token_type::value_separator:
10463 case token_type::parse_error:
10464 case token_type::end_of_input:
10465 case token_type::literal_or_value:
10466 default:
10467 return sax->parse_error(chars_read, number_string, parse_error::create(115, chars_read, exception_message(input_format_t::ubjson, "invalid number text: " + number_lexer.get_token_string(), "high-precision number"), BasicJsonType()));
10468 }
10469 }
10470
10472 // Utility functions //
10474
10484 char_int_type get()
10485 {
10486 ++chars_read;
10487 return current = ia.get_character();
10488 }
10489
10493 char_int_type get_ignore_noop()
10494 {
10495 do
10496 {
10497 get();
10498 }
10499 while (current == 'N');
10500
10501 return current;
10502 }
10503
10504 /*
10505 @brief read a number from the input
10506
10507 @tparam NumberType the type of the number
10508 @param[in] format the current format (for diagnostics)
10509 @param[out] result number of type @a NumberType
10510
10511 @return whether conversion completed
10512
10513 @note This function needs to respect the system's endianness, because
10514 bytes in CBOR, MessagePack, and UBJSON are stored in network order
10515 (big endian) and therefore need reordering on little endian systems.
10516 */
10517 template<typename NumberType, bool InputIsLittleEndian = false>
10518 bool get_number(const input_format_t format, NumberType& result)
10519 {
10520 // step 1: read input into array with system's byte order
10521 std::array<std::uint8_t, sizeof(NumberType)> vec{};
10522 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < sizeof(NumberType); ++i)
10523 {
10524 get();
10525 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!unexpect_eof(format, "number")))
10526 {
10527 return false;
10528 }
10529
10530 // reverse byte order prior to conversion if necessary
10531 if (is_little_endian != InputIsLittleEndian)
10532 {
10533 vec[sizeof(NumberType) - i - 1] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(current);
10534 }
10535 else
10536 {
10537 vec[i] = static_cast<std::uint8_t>(current); // LCOV_EXCL_LINE
10538 }
10539 }
10540
10541 // step 2: convert array into number of type T and return
10542 std::memcpy(&result, vec.data(), sizeof(NumberType));
10543 return true;
10544 }
10545
10560 template<typename NumberType>
10561 bool get_string(const input_format_t format,
10562 const NumberType len,
10563 string_t& result)
10564 {
10565 bool success = true;
10566 for (NumberType i = 0; i < len; i++)
10567 {
10568 get();
10569 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!unexpect_eof(format, "string")))
10570 {
10571 success = false;
10572 break;
10573 }
10574 result.push_back(static_cast<typename string_t::value_type>(current));
10575 }
10576 return success;
10577 }
10578
10593 template<typename NumberType>
10594 bool get_binary(const input_format_t format,
10595 const NumberType len,
10596 binary_t& result)
10597 {
10598 bool success = true;
10599 for (NumberType i = 0; i < len; i++)
10600 {
10601 get();
10602 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!unexpect_eof(format, "binary")))
10603 {
10604 success = false;
10605 break;
10606 }
10607 result.push_back(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(current));
10608 }
10609 return success;
10610 }
10611
10617 JSON_HEDLEY_NON_NULL(3)
10618 bool unexpect_eof(const input_format_t format, const char* context) const
10619 {
10620 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(current == std::char_traits<char_type>::eof()))
10621 {
10622 return sax->parse_error(chars_read, "<end of file>",
10623 parse_error::create(110, chars_read, exception_message(format, "unexpected end of input", context), BasicJsonType()));
10624 }
10625 return true;
10626 }
10627
10631 std::string get_token_string() const
10632 {
10633 std::array<char, 3> cr{{}};
10634 static_cast<void>((std::snprintf)(cr.data(), cr.size(), "%.2hhX", static_cast<unsigned char>(current))); // NOLINT(cppcoreguidelines-pro-type-vararg,hicpp-vararg)
10635 return std::string{cr.data()};
10636 }
10637
10644 std::string exception_message(const input_format_t format,
10645 const std::string& detail,
10646 const std::string& context) const
10647 {
10648 std::string error_msg = "syntax error while parsing ";
10649
10650 switch (format)
10651 {
10652 case input_format_t::cbor:
10653 error_msg += "CBOR";
10654 break;
10655
10656 case input_format_t::msgpack:
10657 error_msg += "MessagePack";
10658 break;
10659
10660 case input_format_t::ubjson:
10661 error_msg += "UBJSON";
10662 break;
10663
10664 case input_format_t::bson:
10665 error_msg += "BSON";
10666 break;
10667
10668 case input_format_t::json: // LCOV_EXCL_LINE
10669 default: // LCOV_EXCL_LINE
10670 JSON_ASSERT(false); // NOLINT(cert-dcl03-c,hicpp-static-assert,misc-static-assert) LCOV_EXCL_LINE
10671 }
10672
10673 return error_msg + " " + context + ": " + detail;
10674 }
10675
10676 private:
10678 InputAdapterType ia;
10679
10681 char_int_type current = std::char_traits<char_type>::eof();
10682
10684 std::size_t chars_read = 0;
10685
10687 const bool is_little_endian = little_endianness();
10688
10690 json_sax_t* sax = nullptr;
10691};

10729// parser //
10731
10732enum class parse_event_t : std::uint8_t
10733{
10735 object_start,
10737 object_end,
10739 array_start,
10741 array_end,
10743 key,
10745 value
10746};
10747
10748template<typename BasicJsonType>
10749using parser_callback_t =
10750 std::function<bool(int /*depth*/, parse_event_t /*event*/, BasicJsonType& /*parsed*/)>;
10751
10757template<typename BasicJsonType, typename InputAdapterType>
10758class parser
10759{
10760 using number_integer_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_integer_t;
10761 using number_unsigned_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_unsigned_t;
10762 using number_float_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_float_t;
10763 using string_t = typename BasicJsonType::string_t;
10764 using lexer_t = lexer<BasicJsonType, InputAdapterType>;
10765 using token_type = typename lexer_t::token_type;
10766
10767 public:
10769 explicit parser(InputAdapterType&& adapter,
10770 const parser_callback_t<BasicJsonType> cb = nullptr,
10771 const bool allow_exceptions_ = true,
10772 const bool skip_comments = false)
10773 : callback(cb)
10774 , m_lexer(std::move(adapter), skip_comments)
10775 , allow_exceptions(allow_exceptions_)
10776 {
10777 // read first token
10778 get_token();
10779 }
10780
10791 void parse(const bool strict, BasicJsonType& result)
10792 {
10793 if (callback)
10794 {
10795 json_sax_dom_callback_parser<BasicJsonType> sdp(result, callback, allow_exceptions);
10796 sax_parse_internal(&sdp);
10797
10798 // in strict mode, input must be completely read
10799 if (strict && (get_token() != token_type::end_of_input))
10800 {
10801 sdp.parse_error(m_lexer.get_position(),
10802 m_lexer.get_token_string(),
10803 parse_error::create(101, m_lexer.get_position(),
10804 exception_message(token_type::end_of_input, "value"), BasicJsonType()));
10805 }
10806
10807 // in case of an error, return discarded value
10808 if (sdp.is_errored())
10809 {
10810 result = value_t::discarded;
10811 return;
10812 }
10813
10814 // set top-level value to null if it was discarded by the callback
10815 // function
10816 if (result.is_discarded())
10817 {
10818 result = nullptr;
10819 }
10820 }
10821 else
10822 {
10823 json_sax_dom_parser<BasicJsonType> sdp(result, allow_exceptions);
10824 sax_parse_internal(&sdp);
10825
10826 // in strict mode, input must be completely read
10827 if (strict && (get_token() != token_type::end_of_input))
10828 {
10829 sdp.parse_error(m_lexer.get_position(),
10830 m_lexer.get_token_string(),
10831 parse_error::create(101, m_lexer.get_position(), exception_message(token_type::end_of_input, "value"), BasicJsonType()));
10832 }
10833
10834 // in case of an error, return discarded value
10835 if (sdp.is_errored())
10836 {
10837 result = value_t::discarded;
10838 return;
10839 }
10840 }
10841
10842 result.assert_invariant();
10843 }
10844
10851 bool accept(const bool strict = true)
10852 {
10853 json_sax_acceptor<BasicJsonType> sax_acceptor;
10854 return sax_parse(&sax_acceptor, strict);
10855 }
10856
10857 template<typename SAX>
10858 JSON_HEDLEY_NON_NULL(2)
10859 bool sax_parse(SAX* sax, const bool strict = true)
10860 {
10861 (void)detail::is_sax_static_asserts<SAX, BasicJsonType> {};
10862 const bool result = sax_parse_internal(sax);
10863
10864 // strict mode: next byte must be EOF
10865 if (result && strict && (get_token() != token_type::end_of_input))
10866 {
10867 return sax->parse_error(m_lexer.get_position(),
10868 m_lexer.get_token_string(),
10869 parse_error::create(101, m_lexer.get_position(), exception_message(token_type::end_of_input, "value"), BasicJsonType()));
10870 }
10871
10872 return result;
10873 }
10874
10875 private:
10876 template<typename SAX>
10877 JSON_HEDLEY_NON_NULL(2)
10878 bool sax_parse_internal(SAX* sax)
10879 {
10880 // stack to remember the hierarchy of structured values we are parsing
10881 // true = array; false = object
10882 std::vector<bool> states;
10883 // value to avoid a goto (see comment where set to true)
10884 bool skip_to_state_evaluation = false;
10885
10886 while (true)
10887 {
10888 if (!skip_to_state_evaluation)
10889 {
10890 // invariant: get_token() was called before each iteration
10891 switch (last_token)
10892 {
10893 case token_type::begin_object:
10894 {
10895 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!sax->start_object(static_cast<std::size_t>(-1))))
10896 {
10897 return false;
10898 }
10899
10900 // closing } -> we are done
10901 if (get_token() == token_type::end_object)
10902 {
10903 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!sax->end_object()))
10904 {
10905 return false;
10906 }
10907 break;
10908 }
10909
10910 // parse key
10911 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(last_token != token_type::value_string))
10912 {
10913 return sax->parse_error(m_lexer.get_position(),
10914 m_lexer.get_token_string(),
10915 parse_error::create(101, m_lexer.get_position(), exception_message(token_type::value_string, "object key"), BasicJsonType()));
10916 }
10917 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!sax->key(m_lexer.get_string())))
10918 {
10919 return false;
10920 }
10921
10922 // parse separator (:)
10923 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(get_token() != token_type::name_separator))
10924 {
10925 return sax->parse_error(m_lexer.get_position(),
10926 m_lexer.get_token_string(),
10927 parse_error::create(101, m_lexer.get_position(), exception_message(token_type::name_separator, "object separator"), BasicJsonType()));
10928 }
10929
10930 // remember we are now inside an object
10931 states.push_back(false);
10932
10933 // parse values
10934 get_token();
10935 continue;
10936 }
10937
10938 case token_type::begin_array:
10939 {
10940 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!sax->start_array(static_cast<std::size_t>(-1))))
10941 {
10942 return false;
10943 }
10944
10945 // closing ] -> we are done
10946 if (get_token() == token_type::end_array)
10947 {
10948 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!sax->end_array()))
10949 {
10950 return false;
10951 }
10952 break;
10953 }
10954
10955 // remember we are now inside an array
10956 states.push_back(true);
10957
10958 // parse values (no need to call get_token)
10959 continue;
10960 }
10961
10962 case token_type::value_float:
10963 {
10964 const auto res = m_lexer.get_number_float();
10965
10966 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!std::isfinite(res)))
10967 {
10968 return sax->parse_error(m_lexer.get_position(),
10969 m_lexer.get_token_string(),
10970 out_of_range::create(406, "number overflow parsing '" + m_lexer.get_token_string() + "'", BasicJsonType()));
10971 }
10972
10973 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!sax->number_float(res, m_lexer.get_string())))
10974 {
10975 return false;
10976 }
10977
10978 break;
10979 }
10980
10981 case token_type::literal_false:
10982 {
10983 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!sax->boolean(false)))
10984 {
10985 return false;
10986 }
10987 break;
10988 }
10989
10990 case token_type::literal_null:
10991 {
10992 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!sax->null()))
10993 {
10994 return false;
10995 }
10996 break;
10997 }
10998
10999 case token_type::literal_true:
11000 {
11001 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!sax->boolean(true)))
11002 {
11003 return false;
11004 }
11005 break;
11006 }
11007
11008 case token_type::value_integer:
11009 {
11010 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!sax->number_integer(m_lexer.get_number_integer())))
11011 {
11012 return false;
11013 }
11014 break;
11015 }
11016
11017 case token_type::value_string:
11018 {
11019 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!sax->string(m_lexer.get_string())))
11020 {
11021 return false;
11022 }
11023 break;
11024 }
11025
11026 case token_type::value_unsigned:
11027 {
11028 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!sax->number_unsigned(m_lexer.get_number_unsigned())))
11029 {
11030 return false;
11031 }
11032 break;
11033 }
11034
11035 case token_type::parse_error:
11036 {
11037 // using "uninitialized" to avoid "expected" message
11038 return sax->parse_error(m_lexer.get_position(),
11039 m_lexer.get_token_string(),
11040 parse_error::create(101, m_lexer.get_position(), exception_message(token_type::uninitialized, "value"), BasicJsonType()));
11041 }
11042
11043 case token_type::uninitialized:
11044 case token_type::end_array:
11045 case token_type::end_object:
11046 case token_type::name_separator:
11047 case token_type::value_separator:
11048 case token_type::end_of_input:
11049 case token_type::literal_or_value:
11050 default: // the last token was unexpected
11051 {
11052 return sax->parse_error(m_lexer.get_position(),
11053 m_lexer.get_token_string(),
11054 parse_error::create(101, m_lexer.get_position(), exception_message(token_type::literal_or_value, "value"), BasicJsonType()));
11055 }
11056 }
11057 }
11058 else
11059 {
11060 skip_to_state_evaluation = false;
11061 }
11062
11063 // we reached this line after we successfully parsed a value
11064 if (states.empty())
11065 {
11066 // empty stack: we reached the end of the hierarchy: done
11067 return true;
11068 }
11069
11070 if (states.back()) // array
11071 {
11072 // comma -> next value
11073 if (get_token() == token_type::value_separator)
11074 {
11075 // parse a new value
11076 get_token();
11077 continue;
11078 }
11079
11080 // closing ]
11081 if (JSON_HEDLEY_LIKELY(last_token == token_type::end_array))
11082 {
11083 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!sax->end_array()))
11084 {
11085 return false;
11086 }
11087
11088 // We are done with this array. Before we can parse a
11089 // new value, we need to evaluate the new state first.
11090 // By setting skip_to_state_evaluation to false, we
11091 // are effectively jumping to the beginning of this if.
11092 JSON_ASSERT(!states.empty());
11093 states.pop_back();
11094 skip_to_state_evaluation = true;
11095 continue;
11096 }
11097
11098 return sax->parse_error(m_lexer.get_position(),
11099 m_lexer.get_token_string(),
11100 parse_error::create(101, m_lexer.get_position(), exception_message(token_type::end_array, "array"), BasicJsonType()));
11101 }
11102
11103 // states.back() is false -> object
11104
11105 // comma -> next value
11106 if (get_token() == token_type::value_separator)
11107 {
11108 // parse key
11109 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(get_token() != token_type::value_string))
11110 {
11111 return sax->parse_error(m_lexer.get_position(),
11112 m_lexer.get_token_string(),
11113 parse_error::create(101, m_lexer.get_position(), exception_message(token_type::value_string, "object key"), BasicJsonType()));
11114 }
11115
11116 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!sax->key(m_lexer.get_string())))
11117 {
11118 return false;
11119 }
11120
11121 // parse separator (:)
11122 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(get_token() != token_type::name_separator))
11123 {
11124 return sax->parse_error(m_lexer.get_position(),
11125 m_lexer.get_token_string(),
11126 parse_error::create(101, m_lexer.get_position(), exception_message(token_type::name_separator, "object separator"), BasicJsonType()));
11127 }
11128
11129 // parse values
11130 get_token();
11131 continue;
11132 }
11133
11134 // closing }
11135 if (JSON_HEDLEY_LIKELY(last_token == token_type::end_object))
11136 {
11137 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!sax->end_object()))
11138 {
11139 return false;
11140 }
11141
11142 // We are done with this object. Before we can parse a
11143 // new value, we need to evaluate the new state first.
11144 // By setting skip_to_state_evaluation to false, we
11145 // are effectively jumping to the beginning of this if.
11146 JSON_ASSERT(!states.empty());
11147 states.pop_back();
11148 skip_to_state_evaluation = true;
11149 continue;
11150 }
11151
11152 return sax->parse_error(m_lexer.get_position(),
11153 m_lexer.get_token_string(),
11154 parse_error::create(101, m_lexer.get_position(), exception_message(token_type::end_object, "object"), BasicJsonType()));
11155 }
11156 }
11157
11159 token_type get_token()
11160 {
11161 return last_token = m_lexer.scan();
11162 }
11163
11164 std::string exception_message(const token_type expected, const std::string& context)
11165 {
11166 std::string error_msg = "syntax error ";
11167
11168 if (!context.empty())
11169 {
11170 error_msg += "while parsing " + context + " ";
11171 }
11172
11173 error_msg += "- ";
11174
11175 if (last_token == token_type::parse_error)
11176 {
11177 error_msg += std::string(m_lexer.get_error_message()) + "; last read: '" +
11178 m_lexer.get_token_string() + "'";
11179 }
11180 else
11181 {
11182 error_msg += "unexpected " + std::string(lexer_t::token_type_name(last_token));
11183 }
11184
11185 if (expected != token_type::uninitialized)
11186 {
11187 error_msg += "; expected " + std::string(lexer_t::token_type_name(expected));
11188 }
11189
11190 return error_msg;
11191 }
11192
11193 private:
11195 const parser_callback_t<BasicJsonType> callback = nullptr;
11197 token_type last_token = token_type::uninitialized;
11199 lexer_t m_lexer;
11201 const bool allow_exceptions = true;
11202};

11213#include <cstddef> // ptrdiff_t
11214#include <limits> // numeric_limits
11215
11216// #include <nlohmann/detail/macro_scope.hpp>
11217
11218
11219namespace nlohmann
11220{
11221namespace detail
11222{
11223/*
11224@brief an iterator for primitive JSON types
11225
11226This class models an iterator for primitive JSON types (boolean, number,
11227string). It's only purpose is to allow the iterator/const_iterator classes
11228to "iterate" over primitive values. Internally, the iterator is modeled by
11229a `difference_type` variable. Value begin_value (`0`) models the begin,
11230end_value (`1`) models past the end.
11231*/
11232class primitive_iterator_t
11233{
11234 private:
11235 using difference_type = std::ptrdiff_t;
11236 static constexpr difference_type begin_value = 0;
11237 static constexpr difference_type end_value = begin_value + 1;
11238
11239 JSON_PRIVATE_UNLESS_TESTED:
11241 difference_type m_it = (std::numeric_limits<std::ptrdiff_t>::min)();
11242
11243 public:
11244 constexpr difference_type get_value() const noexcept
11245 {
11246 return m_it;
11247 }
11248
11250 void set_begin() noexcept
11251 {
11252 m_it = begin_value;
11253 }
11254
11256 void set_end() noexcept
11257 {
11258 m_it = end_value;
11259 }
11260
11262 constexpr bool is_begin() const noexcept
11263 {
11264 return m_it == begin_value;
11265 }
11266
11268 constexpr bool is_end() const noexcept
11269 {
11270 return m_it == end_value;
11271 }
11272
11273 friend constexpr bool operator==(primitive_iterator_t lhs, primitive_iterator_t rhs) noexcept
11274 {
11275 return lhs.m_it == rhs.m_it;
11276 }
11277
11278 friend constexpr bool operator<(primitive_iterator_t lhs, primitive_iterator_t rhs) noexcept
11279 {
11280 return lhs.m_it < rhs.m_it;
11281 }
11282
11283 primitive_iterator_t operator+(difference_type n) noexcept
11284 {
11285 auto result = *this;
11286 result += n;
11287 return result;
11288 }
11289
11290 friend constexpr difference_type operator-(primitive_iterator_t lhs, primitive_iterator_t rhs) noexcept
11291 {
11292 return lhs.m_it - rhs.m_it;
11293 }
11294
11295 primitive_iterator_t& operator++() noexcept
11296 {
11297 ++m_it;
11298 return *this;
11299 }
11300
11301 primitive_iterator_t const operator++(int) noexcept // NOLINT(readability-const-return-type)
11302 {
11303 auto result = *this;
11304 ++m_it;
11305 return result;
11306 }
11307
11308 primitive_iterator_t& operator--() noexcept
11309 {
11310 --m_it;
11311 return *this;
11312 }
11313
11314 primitive_iterator_t const operator--(int) noexcept // NOLINT(readability-const-return-type)
11315 {
11316 auto result = *this;
11317 --m_it;
11318 return result;
11319 }
11320
11321 primitive_iterator_t& operator+=(difference_type n) noexcept
11322 {
11323 m_it += n;
11324 return *this;
11325 }
11326
11327 primitive_iterator_t& operator-=(difference_type n) noexcept
11328 {
11329 m_it -= n;
11330 return *this;
11331 }
11332};
11333} // namespace detail
11334} // namespace nlohmann

11384// forward declare, to be able to friend it later on
11385template<typename IteratorType> class iteration_proxy;
11386template<typename IteratorType> class iteration_proxy_value;
11387
11404template<typename BasicJsonType>
11405class iter_impl // NOLINT(cppcoreguidelines-special-member-functions,hicpp-special-member-functions)
11406{
11408 using other_iter_impl = iter_impl<typename std::conditional<std::is_const<BasicJsonType>::value, typename std::remove_const<BasicJsonType>::type, const BasicJsonType>::type>;
11410 friend other_iter_impl;
11411 friend BasicJsonType;
11412 friend iteration_proxy<iter_impl>;
11413 friend iteration_proxy_value<iter_impl>;
11414
11415 using object_t = typename BasicJsonType::object_t;
11416 using array_t = typename BasicJsonType::array_t;
11417 // make sure BasicJsonType is basic_json or const basic_json
11418 static_assert(is_basic_json<typename std::remove_const<BasicJsonType>::type>::value,
11419 "iter_impl only accepts (const) basic_json");
11420
11421 public:
11422
11428 using iterator_category = std::bidirectional_iterator_tag;
11429
11431 using value_type = typename BasicJsonType::value_type;
11433 using difference_type = typename BasicJsonType::difference_type;
11435 using pointer = typename std::conditional<std::is_const<BasicJsonType>::value,
11436 typename BasicJsonType::const_pointer,
11437 typename BasicJsonType::pointer>::type;
11439 using reference =
11440 typename std::conditional<std::is_const<BasicJsonType>::value,
11441 typename BasicJsonType::const_reference,
11442 typename BasicJsonType::reference>::type;
11443
11444 iter_impl() = default;
11445 ~iter_impl() = default;
11446 iter_impl(iter_impl&&) noexcept = default;
11447 iter_impl& operator=(iter_impl&&) noexcept = default;
11448
11455 explicit iter_impl(pointer object) noexcept : m_object(object)
11456 {
11457 JSON_ASSERT(m_object != nullptr);
11458
11459 switch (m_object->m_type)
11460 {
11461 case value_t::object:
11462 {
11463 m_it.object_iterator = typename object_t::iterator();
11464 break;
11465 }
11466
11467 case value_t::array:
11468 {
11469 m_it.array_iterator = typename array_t::iterator();
11470 break;
11471 }
11472
11473 case value_t::null:
11474 case value_t::string:
11475 case value_t::boolean:
11476 case value_t::number_integer:
11477 case value_t::number_unsigned:
11478 case value_t::number_float:
11479 case value_t::binary:
11480 case value_t::discarded:
11481 default:
11482 {
11483 m_it.primitive_iterator = primitive_iterator_t();
11484 break;
11485 }
11486 }
11487 }
11488
11505 iter_impl(const iter_impl<const BasicJsonType>& other) noexcept
11506 : m_object(other.m_object), m_it(other.m_it)
11507 {}
11508
11515 iter_impl& operator=(const iter_impl<const BasicJsonType>& other) noexcept
11516 {
11517 if (&other != this)
11518 {
11519 m_object = other.m_object;
11520 m_it = other.m_it;
11521 }
11522 return *this;
11523 }
11524
11530 iter_impl(const iter_impl<typename std::remove_const<BasicJsonType>::type>& other) noexcept
11531 : m_object(other.m_object), m_it(other.m_it)
11532 {}
11533
11540 iter_impl& operator=(const iter_impl<typename std::remove_const<BasicJsonType>::type>& other) noexcept // NOLINT(cert-oop54-cpp)
11541 {
11542 m_object = other.m_object;
11543 m_it = other.m_it;
11544 return *this;
11545 }
11546
11547 JSON_PRIVATE_UNLESS_TESTED:
11552 void set_begin() noexcept
11553 {
11554 JSON_ASSERT(m_object != nullptr);
11555
11556 switch (m_object->m_type)
11557 {
11558 case value_t::object:
11559 {
11560 m_it.object_iterator = m_object->m_value.object->begin();
11561 break;
11562 }
11563
11564 case value_t::array:
11565 {
11566 m_it.array_iterator = m_object->m_value.array->begin();
11567 break;
11568 }
11569
11570 case value_t::null:
11571 {
11572 // set to end so begin()==end() is true: null is empty
11573 m_it.primitive_iterator.set_end();
11574 break;
11575 }
11576
11577 case value_t::string:
11578 case value_t::boolean:
11579 case value_t::number_integer:
11580 case value_t::number_unsigned:
11581 case value_t::number_float:
11582 case value_t::binary:
11583 case value_t::discarded:
11584 default:
11585 {
11586 m_it.primitive_iterator.set_begin();
11587 break;
11588 }
11589 }
11590 }
11591
11596 void set_end() noexcept
11597 {
11598 JSON_ASSERT(m_object != nullptr);
11599
11600 switch (m_object->m_type)
11601 {
11602 case value_t::object:
11603 {
11604 m_it.object_iterator = m_object->m_value.object->end();
11605 break;
11606 }
11607
11608 case value_t::array:
11609 {
11610 m_it.array_iterator = m_object->m_value.array->end();
11611 break;
11612 }
11613
11614 case value_t::null:
11615 case value_t::string:
11616 case value_t::boolean:
11617 case value_t::number_integer:
11618 case value_t::number_unsigned:
11619 case value_t::number_float:
11620 case value_t::binary:
11621 case value_t::discarded:
11622 default:
11623 {
11624 m_it.primitive_iterator.set_end();
11625 break;
11626 }
11627 }
11628 }
11629
11630 public:
11635 reference operator*() const
11636 {
11637 JSON_ASSERT(m_object != nullptr);
11638
11639 switch (m_object->m_type)
11640 {
11641 case value_t::object:
11642 {
11643 JSON_ASSERT(m_it.object_iterator != m_object->m_value.object->end());
11644 return m_it.object_iterator->second;
11645 }
11646
11647 case value_t::array:
11648 {
11649 JSON_ASSERT(m_it.array_iterator != m_object->m_value.array->end());
11650 return *m_it.array_iterator;
11651 }
11652
11653 case value_t::null:
11654 JSON_THROW(invalid_iterator::create(214, "cannot get value", *m_object));
11655
11656 case value_t::string:
11657 case value_t::boolean:
11658 case value_t::number_integer:
11659 case value_t::number_unsigned:
11660 case value_t::number_float:
11661 case value_t::binary:
11662 case value_t::discarded:
11663 default:

11666 {

11670 JSON_THROW(invalid_iterator::create(214, "cannot get value", *m_object));

11672 }
11673 }

11682

11684 {
11685 case value_t::object:
11686 {
11687 JSON_ASSERT(m_it.object_iterator != m_object->m_value.object->end());
11688 return &(m_it.object_iterator->second);
11689 }
11690
11691 case value_t::array:
11692 {
11693 JSON_ASSERT(m_it.array_iterator != m_object->m_value.array->end());
11694 return &*m_it.array_iterator;
11695 }
11696
11697 case value_t::null:
11698 case value_t::string:
11699 case value_t::boolean:
11700 case value_t::number_integer:
11701 case value_t::number_unsigned:
11702 case value_t::number_float:
11703 case value_t::binary:
11704 case value_t::discarded:
11705 default:
11706 {
11707 if (JSON_HEDLEY_LIKELY(m_it.primitive_iterator.is_begin()))
11708 {
11709 return m_object;
11710 }
11711
11712 JSON_THROW(invalid_iterator::create(214, "cannot get value", *m_object));
11713 }
11714 }
11715 }

11721 iter_impl const operator++(int) // NOLINT(readability-const-return-type)

11732 iter_impl& operator++()
11733 {
11734 JSON_ASSERT(m_object != nullptr);
11735
11736 switch (m_object->m_type)
11737 {
11738 case value_t::object:
11739 {
11740 std::advance(m_it.object_iterator, 1);
11741 break;
11742 }
11743
11744 case value_t::array:
11745 {
11746 std::advance(m_it.array_iterator, 1);
11747 break;

12142template<typename Base>
12143class json_reverse_iterator : public std::reverse_iterator<Base>
12144{
12145 public:
12146 using difference_type = std::ptrdiff_t;
12148 using base_iterator = std::reverse_iterator<Base>;
12150 using reference = typename Base::reference;
12151
12153 explicit json_reverse_iterator(const typename base_iterator::iterator_type& it) noexcept
12154 : base_iterator(it) {}
12155
12157 explicit json_reverse_iterator(const base_iterator& it) noexcept : base_iterator(it) {}
12158
12160 json_reverse_iterator const operator++(int) // NOLINT(readability-const-return-type)
12161 {
12162 return static_cast<json_reverse_iterator>(base_iterator::operator++(1));
12163 }
12164
12166 json_reverse_iterator& operator++()
12167 {
12168 return static_cast<json_reverse_iterator&>(base_iterator::operator++());
12169 }
12170
12172 json_reverse_iterator const operator--(int) // NOLINT(readability-const-return-type)
12173 {
12174 return static_cast<json_reverse_iterator>(base_iterator::operator--(1));
12175 }
12176
12178 json_reverse_iterator& operator--()
12179 {
12180 return static_cast<json_reverse_iterator&>(base_iterator::operator--());
12181 }
12182
12184 json_reverse_iterator& operator+=(difference_type i)
12185 {
12186 return static_cast<json_reverse_iterator&>(base_iterator::operator+=(i));
12187 }
12188
12190 json_reverse_iterator operator+(difference_type i) const
12191 {
12192 return static_cast<json_reverse_iterator>(base_iterator::operator+(i));
12193 }
12194
12196 json_reverse_iterator operator-(difference_type i) const
12197 {
12198 return static_cast<json_reverse_iterator>(base_iterator::operator-(i));
12199 }
12200
12202 difference_type operator-(const json_reverse_iterator& other) const
12203 {
12204 return base_iterator(*this) - base_iterator(other);
12205 }
12206
12208 reference operator[](difference_type n) const
12209 {
12210 return *(this->operator+(n));
12211 }
12212
12214 auto key() const -> decltype(std::declval<Base>().key())
12215 {
12216 auto it = --this->base();
12217 return it.key();
12218 }
12219
12221 reference value() const
12222 {
12223 auto it = --this->base();
12224 return it.operator * ();
12225 }
12226};

12228} // namespace nlohmann

12257template<typename BasicJsonType>
12258class json_pointer
12259{
12260 // allow basic_json to access private members
12261 NLOHMANN_BASIC_JSON_TPL_DECLARATION

12264 public:
12267 explicit json_pointer(const std::string& s = "")
12268 : reference_tokens(split(s))
12269 {}
12270
12273 std::string to_string() const
12274 {
12275 return std::accumulate(reference_tokens.begin(), reference_tokens.end(),
12276 std::string{},
12277 [](const std::string & a, const std::string & b)
12278 {
12279 return a + "/" + detail::escape(b);
12280 });
12281 }

12285 operator std::string() const
12286 {
12287 return to_string();
12288 }

12292 json_pointer& operator/=(const json_pointer& ptr)
12293 {

12295 ptr.reference_tokens.begin(),
12296 ptr.reference_tokens.end());

12298 }
12299
12302 json_pointer& operator/=(std::string token)
12303 {
12304 push_back(std::move(token));
12305 return *this;
12306 }
12307
12310 json_pointer& operator/=(std::size_t array_idx)
12311 {
12312 return *this /= std::to_string(array_idx);
12313 }

12318 const json_pointer& rhs)
12319 {

12321 }

12326 {

12328 }
12329
12332 friend json_pointer operator/(const json_pointer& lhs, std::size_t array_idx)
12333 {

12335 }

12339 json_pointer parent_pointer() const
12340 {
12341 if (empty())
12342 {
12343 return *this;
12344 }
12345
12346 json_pointer res = *this;
12347 res.pop_back();
12348 return res;
12349 }
12350
12353 void pop_back()
12354 {
12355 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(empty()))
12356 {
12357 JSON_THROW(detail::out_of_range::create(405, "JSON pointer has no parent", BasicJsonType()));
12358 }
12359
12360 reference_tokens.pop_back();
12361 }

12368 {

12370 }
12371
12372 return reference_tokens.back();
12373 }
12374
12377 void push_back(const std::string& token)
12378 {
12379 reference_tokens.push_back(token);
12380 }
12381
12384 void push_back(std::string&& token)
12385 {
12386 reference_tokens.push_back(std::move(token));
12387 }

12391 bool empty() const noexcept
12392 {
12393 return reference_tokens.empty();
12394 }

12396 private:
12407 static typename BasicJsonType::size_type array_index(const std::string& s)
12408 {
12409 using size_type = typename BasicJsonType::size_type;
12410
12411 // error condition (cf. RFC 6901, Sect. 4)
12412 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(s.size() > 1 && s[0] == '0'))
12413 {
12414 JSON_THROW(detail::parse_error::create(106, 0, "array index '" + s + "' must not begin with '0'", BasicJsonType()));
12415 }
12416
12417 // error condition (cf. RFC 6901, Sect. 4)
12418 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(s.size() > 1 && !(s[0] >= '1' && s[0] <= '9')))
12419 {
12420 JSON_THROW(detail::parse_error::create(109, 0, "array index '" + s + "' is not a number", BasicJsonType()));
12421 }
12422
12423 std::size_t processed_chars = 0;
12424 unsigned long long res = 0; // NOLINT(runtime/int)
12425 JSON_TRY
12426 {
12427 res = std::stoull(s, &processed_chars);
12428 }
12429 JSON_CATCH(std::out_of_range&)
12430 {
12431 JSON_THROW(detail::out_of_range::create(404, "unresolved reference token '" + s + "'", BasicJsonType()));
12432 }
12433
12434 // check if the string was completely read
12435 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(processed_chars != s.size()))
12436 {
12437 JSON_THROW(detail::out_of_range::create(404, "unresolved reference token '" + s + "'", BasicJsonType()));
12438 }
12439
12440 // only triggered on special platforms (like 32bit), see also
12441 // https://github.com/nlohmann/json/pull/2203
12442 if (res >= static_cast<unsigned long long>((std::numeric_limits<size_type>::max)())) // NOLINT(runtime/int)
12443 {
12444 JSON_THROW(detail::out_of_range::create(410, "array index " + s + " exceeds size_type", BasicJsonType())); // LCOV_EXCL_LINE
12445 }
12446
12447 return static_cast<size_type>(res);
12448 }
12449
12450 JSON_PRIVATE_UNLESS_TESTED:
12451 json_pointer top() const
12452 {
12453 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(empty()))
12454 {
12455 JSON_THROW(detail::out_of_range::create(405, "JSON pointer has no parent", BasicJsonType()));
12456 }
12457
12458 json_pointer result = *this;
12459 result.reference_tokens = {reference_tokens[0]};
12460 return result;
12461 }

12463 private:
12472 BasicJsonType& get_and_create(BasicJsonType& j) const
12473 {
12474 auto* result = &j;
12475
12476 // in case no reference tokens exist, return a reference to the JSON value
12477 // j which will be overwritten by a primitive value
12478 for (const auto& reference_token : reference_tokens)
12479 {
12480 switch (result->type())
12481 {
12482 case detail::value_t::null:
12483 {
12484 if (reference_token == "0")
12485 {
12486 // start a new array if reference token is 0
12487 result = &result->operator[](0);
12488 }
12489 else
12490 {
12491 // start a new object otherwise
12492 result = &result->operator[](reference_token);
12493 }
12494 break;
12495 }
12496
12497 case detail::value_t::object:
12498 {
12499 // create an entry in the object
12500 result = &result->operator[](reference_token);
12501 break;
12502 }
12503
12504 case detail::value_t::array:
12505 {
12506 // create an entry in the array
12507 result = &result->operator[](array_index(reference_token));
12508 break;
12509 }
12510
12511 /*
12512 The following code is only reached if there exists a reference
12513 token _and_ the current value is primitive. In this case, we have
12514 an error situation, because primitive values may only occur as
12515 single value; that is, with an empty list of reference tokens.
12516 */
12517 case detail::value_t::string:
12518 case detail::value_t::boolean:
12519 case detail::value_t::number_integer:
12520 case detail::value_t::number_unsigned:
12521 case detail::value_t::number_float:
12522 case detail::value_t::binary:
12523 case detail::value_t::discarded:
12524 default:
12525 JSON_THROW(detail::type_error::create(313, "invalid value to unflatten", j));
12526 }
12527 }
12528
12529 return *result;
12530 }
