12551 BasicJsonType& get_unchecked(BasicJsonType* ptr) const
12552 {
12553 for (const auto& reference_token : reference_tokens)
12554 {
12555 // convert null values to arrays or objects before continuing
12556 if (ptr->is_null())
12557 {
12558 // check if reference token is a number
12559 const bool nums =
12560 std::all_of(reference_token.begin(), reference_token.end(),
12561 [](const unsigned char x)
12562 {
12563 return std::isdigit(x);
12564 });
12565
12566 // change value to array for numbers or "-" or to object otherwise
12567 *ptr = (nums || reference_token == "-")
12568 ? detail::value_t::array
12569 : detail::value_t::object;
12570 }
12571
12572 switch (ptr->type())
12573 {
12574 case detail::value_t::object:
12575 {
12576 // use unchecked object access
12577 ptr = &ptr->operator[](reference_token);
12578 break;
12579 }
12580
12581 case detail::value_t::array:
12582 {
12583 if (reference_token == "-")
12584 {
12585 // explicitly treat "-" as index beyond the end
12586 ptr = &ptr->operator[](ptr->m_value.array->size());
12587 }
12588 else
12589 {
12590 // convert array index to number; unchecked access
12591 ptr = &ptr->operator[](array_index(reference_token));
12592 }
12593 break;
12594 }
12595
12596 case detail::value_t::null:
12597 case detail::value_t::string:
12598 case detail::value_t::boolean:
12599 case detail::value_t::number_integer:
12600 case detail::value_t::number_unsigned:
12601 case detail::value_t::number_float:
12602 case detail::value_t::binary:
12603 case detail::value_t::discarded:
12604 default:
12605 JSON_THROW(detail::out_of_range::create(404, "unresolved reference token '" + reference_token + "'", *ptr));
12606 }
12607 }
12608
12609 return *ptr;
12610 }

12618 BasicJsonType& get_checked(BasicJsonType* ptr) const
12619 {
12620 for (const auto& reference_token : reference_tokens)

12622 switch (ptr->type())
12623 {
12624 case detail::value_t::object:

12640
12641 // note: at performs range check
12642 ptr = &ptr->at(array_index(reference_token));
12643 break;
12644 }
12645
12646 case detail::value_t::null:
12647 case detail::value_t::string:
12648 case detail::value_t::boolean:
12649 case detail::value_t::number_integer:
12650 case detail::value_t::number_unsigned:
12651 case detail::value_t::number_float:
12652 case detail::value_t::binary:
12653 case detail::value_t::discarded:
12654 default:
12655 JSON_THROW(detail::out_of_range::create(404, "unresolved reference token '" + reference_token + "'", *ptr));
12656 }
12657 }
12658
12659 return *ptr;
12660 }

12708 case detail::value_t::discarded:
12709 default:
12710 JSON_THROW(detail::out_of_range::create(404, "unresolved reference token '" + reference_token + "'", *ptr));
12711 }
12712 }
12713
12714 return *ptr;
12715 }
12716
12723 const BasicJsonType& get_checked(const BasicJsonType* ptr) const
12724 {
12725 for (const auto& reference_token : reference_tokens)
12726 {
12727 switch (ptr->type())
12728 {
12729 case detail::value_t::object:
12730 {
12731 // note: at performs range check
12732 ptr = &ptr->at(reference_token);
12733 break;
12734 }
12735
12736 case detail::value_t::array:
12737 {
12738 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(reference_token == "-"))
12739 {
12740 // "-" always fails the range check
12741 JSON_THROW(detail::out_of_range::create(402,
12742 "array index '-' (" + std::to_string(ptr->m_value.array->size()) +
12743 ") is out of range", *ptr));
12744 }
12745
12746 // note: at performs range check
12747 ptr = &ptr->at(array_index(reference_token));
12748 break;
12749 }
12750
12751 case detail::value_t::null:
12752 case detail::value_t::string:
12753 case detail::value_t::boolean:
12754 case detail::value_t::number_integer:
12755 case detail::value_t::number_unsigned:
12756 case detail::value_t::number_float:
12757 case detail::value_t::binary:
12758 case detail::value_t::discarded:
12759 default:
12760 JSON_THROW(detail::out_of_range::create(404, "unresolved reference token '" + reference_token + "'", *ptr));
12761 }
12762 }
12763
12764 return *ptr;
12765 }
12766
12771 bool contains(const BasicJsonType* ptr) const
12772 {
12773 for (const auto& reference_token : reference_tokens)
12774 {
12775 switch (ptr->type())
12776 {
12777 case detail::value_t::object:
12778 {
12779 if (!ptr->contains(reference_token))
12780 {
12781 // we did not find the key in the object
12782 return false;
12783 }
12784
12785 ptr = &ptr->operator[](reference_token);
12786 break;
12787 }
12788
12789 case detail::value_t::array:
12790 {
12791 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(reference_token == "-"))
12792 {
12793 // "-" always fails the range check
12794 return false;
12795 }
12796 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(reference_token.size() == 1 && !("0" <= reference_token && reference_token <= "9")))
12797 {
12798 // invalid char
12799 return false;
12800 }
12801 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(reference_token.size() > 1))
12802 {
12803 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!('1' <= reference_token[0] && reference_token[0] <= '9')))
12804 {
12805 // first char should be between '1' and '9'
12806 return false;
12807 }
12808 for (std::size_t i = 1; i < reference_token.size(); i++)
12809 {
12810 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!('0' <= reference_token[i] && reference_token[i] <= '9')))
12811 {
12812 // other char should be between '0' and '9'
12813 return false;
12814 }
12815 }
12816 }
12817
12818 const auto idx = array_index(reference_token);
12819 if (idx >= ptr->size())
12820 {
12821 // index out of range
12822 return false;
12823 }
12824
12825 ptr = &ptr->operator[](idx);
12826 break;
12827 }
12828
12829 case detail::value_t::null:
12830 case detail::value_t::string:
12831 case detail::value_t::boolean:
12832 case detail::value_t::number_integer:
12833 case detail::value_t::number_unsigned:
12834 case detail::value_t::number_float:
12835 case detail::value_t::binary:
12836 case detail::value_t::discarded:
12837 default:
12838 {
12839 // we do not expect primitive values if there is still a
12840 // reference token to process
12841 return false;
12842 }
12843 }
12844 }
12845
12846 // no reference token left means we found a primitive value
12847 return true;
12848 }
12849
12859 static std::vector<std::string> split(const std::string& reference_string)
12860 {
12861 std::vector<std::string> result;
12862
12863 // special case: empty reference string -> no reference tokens
12864 if (reference_string.empty())
12865 {
12866 return result;
12867 }
12868
12869 // check if nonempty reference string begins with slash
12870 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(reference_string[0] != '/'))
12871 {
12872 JSON_THROW(detail::parse_error::create(107, 1, "JSON pointer must be empty or begin with '/' - was: '" + reference_string + "'", BasicJsonType()));
12873 }
12874
12875 // extract the reference tokens:
12876 // - slash: position of the last read slash (or end of string)
12877 // - start: position after the previous slash
12878 for (
12879 // search for the first slash after the first character
12880 std::size_t slash = reference_string.find_first_of('/', 1),
12881 // set the beginning of the first reference token
12882 start = 1;
12883 // we can stop if start == 0 (if slash == std::string::npos)
12884 start != 0;
12885 // set the beginning of the next reference token
12886 // (will eventually be 0 if slash == std::string::npos)
12887 start = (slash == std::string::npos) ? 0 : slash + 1,
12888 // find next slash
12889 slash = reference_string.find_first_of('/', start))
12890 {
12891 // use the text between the beginning of the reference token
12892 // (start) and the last slash (slash).
12893 auto reference_token = reference_string.substr(start, slash - start);
12894
12895 // check reference tokens are properly escaped
12896 for (std::size_t pos = reference_token.find_first_of('~');
12897 pos != std::string::npos;
12898 pos = reference_token.find_first_of('~', pos + 1))
12899 {
12900 JSON_ASSERT(reference_token[pos] == '~');
12901
12902 // ~ must be followed by 0 or 1
12903 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(pos == reference_token.size() - 1 ||
12904 (reference_token[pos + 1] != '0' &&
12905 reference_token[pos + 1] != '1')))
12906 {
12907 JSON_THROW(detail::parse_error::create(108, 0, "escape character '~' must be followed with '0' or '1'", BasicJsonType()));
12908 }
12909 }
12910
12911 // finally, store the reference token
12912 detail::unescape(reference_token);
12913 result.push_back(reference_token);
12914 }
12915
12916 return result;
12917 }
12918
12919 private:
12927 static void flatten(const std::string& reference_string,
12928 const BasicJsonType& value,
12929 BasicJsonType& result)
12930 {
12931 switch (value.type())
12932 {
12933 case detail::value_t::array:
12934 {
12935 if (value.m_value.array->empty())
12936 {
12937 // flatten empty array as null
12938 result[reference_string] = nullptr;
12939 }
12940 else
12941 {
12942 // iterate array and use index as reference string
12943 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < value.m_value.array->size(); ++i)
12944 {
12945 flatten(reference_string + "/" + std::to_string(i),
12946 value.m_value.array->operator[](i), result);
12947 }
12948 }
12949 break;
12950 }
12951
12952 case detail::value_t::object:
12953 {
12954 if (value.m_value.object->empty())
12955 {
12956 // flatten empty object as null
12957 result[reference_string] = nullptr;
12958 }
12959 else
12960 {
12961 // iterate object and use keys as reference string
12962 for (const auto& element : *value.m_value.object)
12963 {
12964 flatten(reference_string + "/" + detail::escape(element.first), element.second, result);
12965 }
12966 }
12967 break;
12968 }
12969
12970 case detail::value_t::null:
12971 case detail::value_t::string:
12972 case detail::value_t::boolean:
12973 case detail::value_t::number_integer:
12974 case detail::value_t::number_unsigned:
12975 case detail::value_t::number_float:
12976 case detail::value_t::binary:
12977 case detail::value_t::discarded:
12978 default:
12979 {
12980 // add primitive value with its reference string
12981 result[reference_string] = value;
12982 break;
12983 }
12984 }
12985 }
12986
12997 static BasicJsonType
12998 unflatten(const BasicJsonType& value)
12999 {
13000 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!value.is_object()))
13001 {
13002 JSON_THROW(detail::type_error::create(314, "only objects can be unflattened", value));
13003 }
13004
13005 BasicJsonType result;
13006
13007 // iterate the JSON object values
13008 for (const auto& element : *value.m_value.object)
13009 {
13010 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!element.second.is_primitive()))
13011 {
13012 JSON_THROW(detail::type_error::create(315, "values in object must be primitive", element.second));
13013 }
13014
13015 // assign value to reference pointed to by JSON pointer; Note that if
13016 // the JSON pointer is "" (i.e., points to the whole value), function
13017 // get_and_create returns a reference to result itself. An assignment
13018 // will then create a primitive value.
13019 json_pointer(element.first).get_and_create(result) = element.second;
13020 }
13021
13022 return result;
13023 }
13024
13036 friend bool operator==(json_pointer const& lhs,
13037 json_pointer const& rhs) noexcept
13038 {
13039 return lhs.reference_tokens == rhs.reference_tokens;
13040 }
13041
13053 friend bool operator!=(json_pointer const& lhs,
13054 json_pointer const& rhs) noexcept
13055 {
13056 return !(lhs == rhs);
13057 }
13058
13060 std::vector<std::string> reference_tokens;
13061};
13062} // namespace nlohmann

13070// #include <nlohmann/detail/meta/type_traits.hpp>
13071
13072
13073namespace nlohmann
13074{
13075namespace detail
13076{
13077template<typename BasicJsonType>
13078class json_ref
13079{
13080 public:
13081 using value_type = BasicJsonType;
13082
13083 json_ref(value_type&& value)
13084 : owned_value(std::move(value))
13085 {}
13086
13087 json_ref(const value_type& value)
13088 : value_ref(&value)
13089 {}
13090
13091 json_ref(std::initializer_list<json_ref> init)
13092 : owned_value(init)
13093 {}
13094
13095 template <
13096 class... Args,
13097 enable_if_t<std::is_constructible<value_type, Args...>::value, int> = 0 >
13098 json_ref(Args && ... args)
13099 : owned_value(std::forward<Args>(args)...)
13100 {}
13101
13102 // class should be movable only
13103 json_ref(json_ref&&) noexcept = default;
13104 json_ref(const json_ref&) = delete;
13105 json_ref& operator=(const json_ref&) = delete;
13106 json_ref& operator=(json_ref&&) = delete;
13107 ~json_ref() = default;
13108
13109 value_type moved_or_copied() const
13110 {
13111 if (value_ref == nullptr)
13112 {
13113 return std::move(owned_value);
13114 }
13115 return *value_ref;
13116 }
13117
13118 value_type const& operator*() const
13119 {
13120 return value_ref ? *value_ref : owned_value;
13121 }
13122
13123 value_type const* operator->() const
13124 {
13125 return &** this;
13126 }
13127
13128 private:
13129 mutable value_type owned_value = nullptr;
13130 value_type const* value_ref = nullptr;
13131};
13132} // namespace detail
13133} // namespace nlohmann

13182template<typename CharType> struct output_adapter_protocol
13183{
13184 virtual void write_character(CharType c) = 0;
13185 virtual void write_characters(const CharType* s, std::size_t length) = 0;
13186 virtual ~output_adapter_protocol() = default;
13187
13188 output_adapter_protocol() = default;
13189 output_adapter_protocol(const output_adapter_protocol&) = default;
13190 output_adapter_protocol(output_adapter_protocol&&) noexcept = default;
13191 output_adapter_protocol& operator=(const output_adapter_protocol&) = default;
13192 output_adapter_protocol& operator=(output_adapter_protocol&&) noexcept = default;
13193};
13194
13196template<typename CharType>
13197using output_adapter_t = std::shared_ptr<output_adapter_protocol<CharType>>;
13198
13200template<typename CharType, typename AllocatorType = std::allocator<CharType>>
13201class output_vector_adapter : public output_adapter_protocol<CharType>
13202{
13203 public:
13204 explicit output_vector_adapter(std::vector<CharType, AllocatorType>& vec) noexcept
13205 : v(vec)
13206 {}
13207
13208 void write_character(CharType c) override
13209 {
13210 v.push_back(c);
13211 }
13212
13213 JSON_HEDLEY_NON_NULL(2)
13214 void write_characters(const CharType* s, std::size_t length) override
13215 {
13216 std::copy(s, s + length, std::back_inserter(v));
13217 }
13218
13219 private:
13220 std::vector<CharType, AllocatorType>& v;
13221};
13222
13223#ifndef JSON_NO_IO
13225template<typename CharType>
13226class output_stream_adapter : public output_adapter_protocol<CharType>
13227{
13228 public:
13229 explicit output_stream_adapter(std::basic_ostream<CharType>& s) noexcept
13230 : stream(s)
13231 {}
13232
13233 void write_character(CharType c) override
13234 {
13235 stream.put(c);
13236 }
13237
13238 JSON_HEDLEY_NON_NULL(2)
13239 void write_characters(const CharType* s, std::size_t length) override
13240 {
13241 stream.write(s, static_cast<std::streamsize>(length));
13242 }
13243
13244 private:
13245 std::basic_ostream<CharType>& stream;
13246};
13247#endif // JSON_NO_IO
13248
13250template<typename CharType, typename StringType = std::basic_string<CharType>>
13251class output_string_adapter : public output_adapter_protocol<CharType>
13252{
13253 public:
13254 explicit output_string_adapter(StringType& s) noexcept
13255 : str(s)
13256 {}
13257
13258 void write_character(CharType c) override
13259 {
13260 str.push_back(c);
13261 }
13262
13263 JSON_HEDLEY_NON_NULL(2)
13264 void write_characters(const CharType* s, std::size_t length) override
13265 {
13266 str.append(s, length);
13267 }
13268
13269 private:
13270 StringType& str;
13271};
13272
13273template<typename CharType, typename StringType = std::basic_string<CharType>>
13274class output_adapter
13275{
13276 public:
13277 template<typename AllocatorType = std::allocator<CharType>>
13278 output_adapter(std::vector<CharType, AllocatorType>& vec)
13279 : oa(std::make_shared<output_vector_adapter<CharType, AllocatorType>>(vec)) {}
13280
13281#ifndef JSON_NO_IO
13282 output_adapter(std::basic_ostream<CharType>& s)
13283 : oa(std::make_shared<output_stream_adapter<CharType>>(s)) {}
13284#endif // JSON_NO_IO
13285
13286 output_adapter(StringType& s)
13287 : oa(std::make_shared<output_string_adapter<CharType, StringType>>(s)) {}
13288
13289 operator output_adapter_t<CharType>()
13290 {
13291 return oa;
13292 }
13293
13294 private:
13295 output_adapter_t<CharType> oa = nullptr;
13296};

13306// binary writer //
13308
13312template<typename BasicJsonType, typename CharType>
13313class binary_writer
13314{
13315 using string_t = typename BasicJsonType::string_t;
13316 using binary_t = typename BasicJsonType::binary_t;
13317 using number_float_t = typename BasicJsonType::number_float_t;
13318
13319 public:
13325 explicit binary_writer(output_adapter_t<CharType> adapter) : oa(std::move(adapter))
13326 {
13327 JSON_ASSERT(oa);
13328 }
13329
13334 void write_bson(const BasicJsonType& j)
13335 {
13336 switch (j.type())
13337 {
13338 case value_t::object:
13339 {
13340 write_bson_object(*j.m_value.object);
13341 break;
13342 }
13343
13344 case value_t::null:
13345 case value_t::array:
13346 case value_t::string:
13347 case value_t::boolean:
13348 case value_t::number_integer:
13349 case value_t::number_unsigned:
13350 case value_t::number_float:
13351 case value_t::binary:
13352 case value_t::discarded:
13353 default:
13354 {
13355 JSON_THROW(type_error::create(317, "to serialize to BSON, top-level type must be object, but is " + std::string(j.type_name()), j));
13356 }
13357 }
13358 }
13359
13363 void write_cbor(const BasicJsonType& j)
13364 {
13365 switch (j.type())
13366 {
13367 case value_t::null:
13368 {
13369 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0xF6));
13370 break;
13371 }
13372
13373 case value_t::boolean:
13374 {
13375 oa->write_character(j.m_value.boolean
13376 ? to_char_type(0xF5)
13377 : to_char_type(0xF4));
13378 break;
13379 }
13380
13381 case value_t::number_integer:
13382 {
13383 if (j.m_value.number_integer >= 0)
13384 {
13385 // CBOR does not differentiate between positive signed
13386 // integers and unsigned integers. Therefore, we used the
13387 // code from the value_t::number_unsigned case here.
13388 if (j.m_value.number_integer <= 0x17)
13389 {
13390 write_number(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(j.m_value.number_integer));
13391 }
13392 else if (j.m_value.number_integer <= (std::numeric_limits<std::uint8_t>::max)())
13393 {
13394 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0x18));
13395 write_number(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(j.m_value.number_integer));
13396 }
13397 else if (j.m_value.number_integer <= (std::numeric_limits<std::uint16_t>::max)())
13398 {
13399 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0x19));
13400 write_number(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(j.m_value.number_integer));
13401 }
13402 else if (j.m_value.number_integer <= (std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max)())
13403 {
13404 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0x1A));
13405 write_number(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(j.m_value.number_integer));
13406 }
13407 else
13408 {
13409 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0x1B));
13410 write_number(static_cast<std::uint64_t>(j.m_value.number_integer));
13411 }
13412 }
13413 else
13414 {
13415 // The conversions below encode the sign in the first
13416 // byte, and the value is converted to a positive number.
13417 const auto positive_number = -1 - j.m_value.number_integer;
13418 if (j.m_value.number_integer >= -24)
13419 {
13420 write_number(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(0x20 + positive_number));
13421 }
13422 else if (positive_number <= (std::numeric_limits<std::uint8_t>::max)())
13423 {
13424 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0x38));
13425 write_number(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(positive_number));
13426 }
13427 else if (positive_number <= (std::numeric_limits<std::uint16_t>::max)())
13428 {
13429 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0x39));
13430 write_number(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(positive_number));
13431 }
13432 else if (positive_number <= (std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max)())
13433 {
13434 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0x3A));
13435 write_number(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(positive_number));
13436 }
13437 else
13438 {
13439 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0x3B));
13440 write_number(static_cast<std::uint64_t>(positive_number));
13441 }
13442 }
13443 break;
13444 }
13445
13446 case value_t::number_unsigned:
13447 {
13448 if (j.m_value.number_unsigned <= 0x17)
13449 {
13450 write_number(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(j.m_value.number_unsigned));
13451 }
13452 else if (j.m_value.number_unsigned <= (std::numeric_limits<std::uint8_t>::max)())
13453 {
13454 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0x18));
13455 write_number(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(j.m_value.number_unsigned));
13456 }
13457 else if (j.m_value.number_unsigned <= (std::numeric_limits<std::uint16_t>::max)())
13458 {
13459 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0x19));
13460 write_number(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(j.m_value.number_unsigned));
13461 }
13462 else if (j.m_value.number_unsigned <= (std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max)())
13463 {
13464 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0x1A));
13465 write_number(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(j.m_value.number_unsigned));
13466 }
13467 else
13468 {
13469 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0x1B));
13470 write_number(static_cast<std::uint64_t>(j.m_value.number_unsigned));
13471 }
13472 break;
13473 }
13474
13475 case value_t::number_float:
13476 {
13477 if (std::isnan(j.m_value.number_float))
13478 {
13479 // NaN is 0xf97e00 in CBOR
13480 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0xF9));
13481 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0x7E));
13482 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0x00));
13483 }
13484 else if (std::isinf(j.m_value.number_float))
13485 {
13486 // Infinity is 0xf97c00, -Infinity is 0xf9fc00
13487 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0xf9));
13488 oa->write_character(j.m_value.number_float > 0 ? to_char_type(0x7C) : to_char_type(0xFC));
13489 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0x00));
13490 }
13491 else
13492 {
13493 write_compact_float(j.m_value.number_float, detail::input_format_t::cbor);
13494 }
13495 break;
13496 }
13497
13498 case value_t::string:
13499 {
13500 // step 1: write control byte and the string length
13501 const auto N = j.m_value.string->size();
13502 if (N <= 0x17)
13503 {
13504 write_number(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(0x60 + N));
13505 }
13506 else if (N <= (std::numeric_limits<std::uint8_t>::max)())
13507 {
13508 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0x78));
13509 write_number(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(N));
13510 }
13511 else if (N <= (std::numeric_limits<std::uint16_t>::max)())
13512 {
13513 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0x79));
13514 write_number(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(N));
13515 }
13516 else if (N <= (std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max)())
13517 {
13518 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0x7A));
13519 write_number(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(N));
13520 }
13521 // LCOV_EXCL_START
13522 else if (N <= (std::numeric_limits<std::uint64_t>::max)())
13523 {
13524 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0x7B));
13525 write_number(static_cast<std::uint64_t>(N));
13526 }
13527 // LCOV_EXCL_STOP
13528
13529 // step 2: write the string
13530 oa->write_characters(
13531 reinterpret_cast<const CharType*>(j.m_value.string->c_str()),
13532 j.m_value.string->size());
13533 break;
13534 }
13535
13536 case value_t::array:
13537 {
13538 // step 1: write control byte and the array size
13539 const auto N = j.m_value.array->size();
13540 if (N <= 0x17)
13541 {
13542 write_number(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(0x80 + N));
13543 }
13544 else if (N <= (std::numeric_limits<std::uint8_t>::max)())
13545 {
13546 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0x98));
13547 write_number(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(N));
13548 }
13549 else if (N <= (std::numeric_limits<std::uint16_t>::max)())
13550 {
13551 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0x99));
13552 write_number(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(N));
13553 }
13554 else if (N <= (std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max)())
13555 {
13556 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0x9A));
13557 write_number(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(N));
13558 }
13559 // LCOV_EXCL_START
13560 else if (N <= (std::numeric_limits<std::uint64_t>::max)())
13561 {
13562 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0x9B));
13563 write_number(static_cast<std::uint64_t>(N));
13564 }
13565 // LCOV_EXCL_STOP
13566
13567 // step 2: write each element
13568 for (const auto& el : *j.m_value.array)
13569 {
13570 write_cbor(el);
13571 }
13572 break;
13573 }
13574
13575 case value_t::binary:
13576 {
13577 if (j.m_value.binary->has_subtype())
13578 {
13579 if (j.m_value.binary->subtype() <= (std::numeric_limits<std::uint8_t>::max)())
13580 {
13581 write_number(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(0xd8));
13582 write_number(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(j.m_value.binary->subtype()));
13583 }
13584 else if (j.m_value.binary->subtype() <= (std::numeric_limits<std::uint16_t>::max)())
13585 {
13586 write_number(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(0xd9));
13587 write_number(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(j.m_value.binary->subtype()));
13588 }
13589 else if (j.m_value.binary->subtype() <= (std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max)())
13590 {
13591 write_number(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(0xda));
13592 write_number(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(j.m_value.binary->subtype()));
13593 }
13594 else if (j.m_value.binary->subtype() <= (std::numeric_limits<std::uint64_t>::max)())
13595 {
13596 write_number(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(0xdb));
13597 write_number(static_cast<std::uint64_t>(j.m_value.binary->subtype()));
13598 }
13599 }
13600
13601 // step 1: write control byte and the binary array size
13602 const auto N = j.m_value.binary->size();
13603 if (N <= 0x17)
13604 {
13605 write_number(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(0x40 + N));
13606 }
13607 else if (N <= (std::numeric_limits<std::uint8_t>::max)())
13608 {
13609 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0x58));
13610 write_number(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(N));
13611 }
13612 else if (N <= (std::numeric_limits<std::uint16_t>::max)())
13613 {
13614 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0x59));
13615 write_number(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(N));
13616 }
13617 else if (N <= (std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max)())
13618 {
13619 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0x5A));
13620 write_number(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(N));
13621 }
13622 // LCOV_EXCL_START
13623 else if (N <= (std::numeric_limits<std::uint64_t>::max)())
13624 {
13625 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0x5B));
13626 write_number(static_cast<std::uint64_t>(N));
13627 }
13628 // LCOV_EXCL_STOP
13629
13630 // step 2: write each element
13631 oa->write_characters(
13632 reinterpret_cast<const CharType*>(j.m_value.binary->data()),
13633 N);
13634
13635 break;
13636 }
13637
13638 case value_t::object:
13639 {
13640 // step 1: write control byte and the object size
13641 const auto N = j.m_value.object->size();
13642 if (N <= 0x17)
13643 {
13644 write_number(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(0xA0 + N));
13645 }
13646 else if (N <= (std::numeric_limits<std::uint8_t>::max)())
13647 {
13648 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0xB8));
13649 write_number(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(N));
13650 }
13651 else if (N <= (std::numeric_limits<std::uint16_t>::max)())
13652 {
13653 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0xB9));
13654 write_number(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(N));
13655 }
13656 else if (N <= (std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max)())
13657 {
13658 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0xBA));
13659 write_number(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(N));
13660 }
13661 // LCOV_EXCL_START
13662 else if (N <= (std::numeric_limits<std::uint64_t>::max)())
13663 {
13664 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0xBB));
13665 write_number(static_cast<std::uint64_t>(N));
13666 }
13667 // LCOV_EXCL_STOP
13668
13669 // step 2: write each element
13670 for (const auto& el : *j.m_value.object)
13671 {
13672 write_cbor(el.first);
13673 write_cbor(el.second);
13674 }
13675 break;
13676 }
13677
13678 case value_t::discarded:
13679 default:
13680 break;
13681 }
13682 }
13683
13687 void write_msgpack(const BasicJsonType& j)
13688 {
13689 switch (j.type())
13690 {
13691 case value_t::null: // nil
13692 {
13693 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0xC0));
13694 break;
13695 }
13696
13697 case value_t::boolean: // true and false
13698 {
13699 oa->write_character(j.m_value.boolean
13700 ? to_char_type(0xC3)
13701 : to_char_type(0xC2));
13702 break;
13703 }
13704
13705 case value_t::number_integer:
13706 {
13707 if (j.m_value.number_integer >= 0)
13708 {
13709 // MessagePack does not differentiate between positive
13710 // signed integers and unsigned integers. Therefore, we used
13711 // the code from the value_t::number_unsigned case here.
13712 if (j.m_value.number_unsigned < 128)
13713 {
13714 // positive fixnum
13715 write_number(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(j.m_value.number_integer));
13716 }
13717 else if (j.m_value.number_unsigned <= (std::numeric_limits<std::uint8_t>::max)())
13718 {
13719 // uint 8
13720 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0xCC));
13721 write_number(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(j.m_value.number_integer));
13722 }
13723 else if (j.m_value.number_unsigned <= (std::numeric_limits<std::uint16_t>::max)())
13724 {
13725 // uint 16
13726 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0xCD));
13727 write_number(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(j.m_value.number_integer));
13728 }
13729 else if (j.m_value.number_unsigned <= (std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max)())
13730 {
13731 // uint 32
13732 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0xCE));
13733 write_number(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(j.m_value.number_integer));
13734 }
13735 else if (j.m_value.number_unsigned <= (std::numeric_limits<std::uint64_t>::max)())
13736 {
13737 // uint 64
13738 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0xCF));
13739 write_number(static_cast<std::uint64_t>(j.m_value.number_integer));
13740 }
13741 }
13742 else
13743 {
13744 if (j.m_value.number_integer >= -32)
13745 {
13746 // negative fixnum
13747 write_number(static_cast<std::int8_t>(j.m_value.number_integer));
13748 }
13749 else if (j.m_value.number_integer >= (std::numeric_limits<std::int8_t>::min)() &&
13750 j.m_value.number_integer <= (std::numeric_limits<std::int8_t>::max)())
13751 {
13752 // int 8
13753 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0xD0));
13754 write_number(static_cast<std::int8_t>(j.m_value.number_integer));
13755 }
13756 else if (j.m_value.number_integer >= (std::numeric_limits<std::int16_t>::min)() &&
13757 j.m_value.number_integer <= (std::numeric_limits<std::int16_t>::max)())
13758 {
13759 // int 16
13760 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0xD1));
13761 write_number(static_cast<std::int16_t>(j.m_value.number_integer));
13762 }
13763 else if (j.m_value.number_integer >= (std::numeric_limits<std::int32_t>::min)() &&
13764 j.m_value.number_integer <= (std::numeric_limits<std::int32_t>::max)())
13765 {
13766 // int 32
13767 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0xD2));
13768 write_number(static_cast<std::int32_t>(j.m_value.number_integer));
13769 }
13770 else if (j.m_value.number_integer >= (std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::min)() &&
13771 j.m_value.number_integer <= (std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max)())
13772 {
13773 // int 64
13774 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0xD3));
13775 write_number(static_cast<std::int64_t>(j.m_value.number_integer));
13776 }
13777 }
13778 break;
13779 }
13780
13781 case value_t::number_unsigned:
13782 {
13783 if (j.m_value.number_unsigned < 128)
13784 {
13785 // positive fixnum
13786 write_number(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(j.m_value.number_integer));
13787 }
13788 else if (j.m_value.number_unsigned <= (std::numeric_limits<std::uint8_t>::max)())
13789 {
13790 // uint 8
13791 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0xCC));
13792 write_number(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(j.m_value.number_integer));
13793 }
13794 else if (j.m_value.number_unsigned <= (std::numeric_limits<std::uint16_t>::max)())
13795 {
13796 // uint 16
13797 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0xCD));
13798 write_number(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(j.m_value.number_integer));
13799 }
13800 else if (j.m_value.number_unsigned <= (std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max)())
13801 {
13802 // uint 32
13803 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0xCE));
13804 write_number(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(j.m_value.number_integer));
13805 }
13806 else if (j.m_value.number_unsigned <= (std::numeric_limits<std::uint64_t>::max)())
13807 {
13808 // uint 64
13809 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0xCF));
13810 write_number(static_cast<std::uint64_t>(j.m_value.number_integer));
13811 }
13812 break;
13813 }
13814
13815 case value_t::number_float:
13816 {
13817 write_compact_float(j.m_value.number_float, detail::input_format_t::msgpack);
13818 break;
13819 }
13820
13821 case value_t::string:
13822 {
13823 // step 1: write control byte and the string length
13824 const auto N = j.m_value.string->size();
13825 if (N <= 31)
13826 {
13827 // fixstr
13828 write_number(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(0xA0 | N));
13829 }
13830 else if (N <= (std::numeric_limits<std::uint8_t>::max)())
13831 {
13832 // str 8
13833 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0xD9));
13834 write_number(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(N));
13835 }
13836 else if (N <= (std::numeric_limits<std::uint16_t>::max)())
13837 {
13838 // str 16
13839 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0xDA));
13840 write_number(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(N));
13841 }
13842 else if (N <= (std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max)())
13843 {
13844 // str 32
13845 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0xDB));
13846 write_number(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(N));
13847 }
13848
13849 // step 2: write the string
13850 oa->write_characters(
13851 reinterpret_cast<const CharType*>(j.m_value.string->c_str()),
13852 j.m_value.string->size());
13853 break;
13854 }
13855
13856 case value_t::array:
13857 {
13858 // step 1: write control byte and the array size
13859 const auto N = j.m_value.array->size();
13860 if (N <= 15)
13861 {
13862 // fixarray
13863 write_number(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(0x90 | N));
13864 }
13865 else if (N <= (std::numeric_limits<std::uint16_t>::max)())
13866 {
13867 // array 16
13868 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0xDC));
13869 write_number(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(N));
13870 }
13871 else if (N <= (std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max)())
13872 {
13873 // array 32
13874 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0xDD));
13875 write_number(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(N));
13876 }
13877
13878 // step 2: write each element
13879 for (const auto& el : *j.m_value.array)
13880 {
13881 write_msgpack(el);
13882 }
13883 break;
13884 }
13885
13886 case value_t::binary:
13887 {
13888 // step 0: determine if the binary type has a set subtype to
13889 // determine whether or not to use the ext or fixext types
13890 const bool use_ext = j.m_value.binary->has_subtype();
13891
13892 // step 1: write control byte and the byte string length
13893 const auto N = j.m_value.binary->size();
13894 if (N <= (std::numeric_limits<std::uint8_t>::max)())
13895 {
13896 std::uint8_t output_type{};
13897 bool fixed = true;
13898 if (use_ext)
13899 {
13900 switch (N)
13901 {
13902 case 1:
13903 output_type = 0xD4; // fixext 1
13904 break;
13905 case 2:
13906 output_type = 0xD5; // fixext 2
13907 break;
13908 case 4:
13909 output_type = 0xD6; // fixext 4
13910 break;
13911 case 8:
13912 output_type = 0xD7; // fixext 8
13913 break;
13914 case 16:
13915 output_type = 0xD8; // fixext 16
13916 break;
13917 default:
13918 output_type = 0xC7; // ext 8
13919 fixed = false;
13920 break;
13921 }
13922
13923 }
13924 else
13925 {
13926 output_type = 0xC4; // bin 8
13927 fixed = false;
13928 }
13929
13930 oa->write_character(to_char_type(output_type));
13931 if (!fixed)
13932 {
13933 write_number(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(N));
13934 }
13935 }
13936 else if (N <= (std::numeric_limits<std::uint16_t>::max)())
13937 {
13938 std::uint8_t output_type = use_ext
13939 ? 0xC8 // ext 16
13940 : 0xC5; // bin 16
13941
13942 oa->write_character(to_char_type(output_type));
13943 write_number(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(N));
13944 }
13945 else if (N <= (std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max)())
13946 {
13947 std::uint8_t output_type = use_ext
13948 ? 0xC9 // ext 32
13949 : 0xC6; // bin 32
13950
13951 oa->write_character(to_char_type(output_type));
13952 write_number(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(N));
13953 }
13954
13955 // step 1.5: if this is an ext type, write the subtype
13956 if (use_ext)
13957 {
13958 write_number(static_cast<std::int8_t>(j.m_value.binary->subtype()));
13959 }
13960
13961 // step 2: write the byte string
13962 oa->write_characters(
13963 reinterpret_cast<const CharType*>(j.m_value.binary->data()),
13964 N);
13965
13966 break;
13967 }
13968
13969 case value_t::object:
13970 {
13971 // step 1: write control byte and the object size
13972 const auto N = j.m_value.object->size();
13973 if (N <= 15)
13974 {
13975 // fixmap
13976 write_number(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(0x80 | (N & 0xF)));
13977 }
13978 else if (N <= (std::numeric_limits<std::uint16_t>::max)())
13979 {
13980 // map 16
13981 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0xDE));
13982 write_number(static_cast<std::uint16_t>(N));
13983 }
13984 else if (N <= (std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max)())
13985 {
13986 // map 32
13987 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0xDF));
13988 write_number(static_cast<std::uint32_t>(N));
13989 }
13990
13991 // step 2: write each element
13992 for (const auto& el : *j.m_value.object)
13993 {
13994 write_msgpack(el.first);
13995 write_msgpack(el.second);
13996 }
13997 break;
13998 }
13999
14000 case value_t::discarded:
14001 default:
14002 break;
14003 }
14004 }
14005
14012 void write_ubjson(const BasicJsonType& j, const bool use_count,
14013 const bool use_type, const bool add_prefix = true)
14014 {
14015 switch (j.type())
14016 {
14017 case value_t::null:
14018 {
14019 if (add_prefix)
14020 {
14021 oa->write_character(to_char_type('Z'));
14022 }
14023 break;
14024 }
14025
14026 case value_t::boolean:
14027 {
14028 if (add_prefix)
14029 {
14030 oa->write_character(j.m_value.boolean
14031 ? to_char_type('T')
14032 : to_char_type('F'));
14033 }
14034 break;
14035 }
14036
14037 case value_t::number_integer:
14038 {
14039 write_number_with_ubjson_prefix(j.m_value.number_integer, add_prefix);
14040 break;
14041 }
14042
14043 case value_t::number_unsigned:
14044 {
14045 write_number_with_ubjson_prefix(j.m_value.number_unsigned, add_prefix);
14046 break;
14047 }
14048
14049 case value_t::number_float:
14050 {
14051 write_number_with_ubjson_prefix(j.m_value.number_float, add_prefix);
14052 break;
14053 }
14054
14055 case value_t::string:
14056 {
14057 if (add_prefix)
14058 {
14059 oa->write_character(to_char_type('S'));
14060 }
14061 write_number_with_ubjson_prefix(j.m_value.string->size(), true);
14062 oa->write_characters(
14063 reinterpret_cast<const CharType*>(j.m_value.string->c_str()),
14064 j.m_value.string->size());
14065 break;
14066 }
14067
14068 case value_t::array:
14069 {
14070 if (add_prefix)
14071 {
14072 oa->write_character(to_char_type('['));
14073 }
14074
14075 bool prefix_required = true;
14076 if (use_type && !j.m_value.array->empty())
14077 {
14078 JSON_ASSERT(use_count);
14079 const CharType first_prefix = ubjson_prefix(j.front());
14080 const bool same_prefix = std::all_of(j.begin() + 1, j.end(),
14081 [this, first_prefix](const BasicJsonType & v)
14082 {
14083 return ubjson_prefix(v) == first_prefix;
14084 });
14085
14086 if (same_prefix)
14087 {
14088 prefix_required = false;
14089 oa->write_character(to_char_type('$'));
14090 oa->write_character(first_prefix);
14091 }
14092 }
14093
14094 if (use_count)
14095 {
14096 oa->write_character(to_char_type('#'));
14097 write_number_with_ubjson_prefix(j.m_value.array->size(), true);
14098 }
14099
14100 for (const auto& el : *j.m_value.array)
14101 {
14102 write_ubjson(el, use_count, use_type, prefix_required);
14103 }
14104
14105 if (!use_count)
14106 {
14107 oa->write_character(to_char_type(']'));
14108 }
14109
14110 break;
14111 }
14112
14113 case value_t::binary:
14114 {
14115 if (add_prefix)
14116 {
14117 oa->write_character(to_char_type('['));
14118 }
14119
14120 if (use_type && !j.m_value.binary->empty())
14121 {
14122 JSON_ASSERT(use_count);
14123 oa->write_character(to_char_type('$'));
14124 oa->write_character('U');
14125 }
14126
14127 if (use_count)
14128 {
14129 oa->write_character(to_char_type('#'));
14130 write_number_with_ubjson_prefix(j.m_value.binary->size(), true);
14131 }
14132
14133 if (use_type)
14134 {
14135 oa->write_characters(
14136 reinterpret_cast<const CharType*>(j.m_value.binary->data()),
14137 j.m_value.binary->size());
14138 }
14139 else
14140 {
14141 for (size_t i = 0; i < j.m_value.binary->size(); ++i)
14142 {
14143 oa->write_character(to_char_type('U'));
14144 oa->write_character(j.m_value.binary->data()[i]);
14145 }
14146 }
14147
14148 if (!use_count)
14149 {
14150 oa->write_character(to_char_type(']'));
14151 }
14152
14153 break;
14154 }
14155
14156 case value_t::object:
14157 {
14158 if (add_prefix)
14159 {
14160 oa->write_character(to_char_type('{'));
14161 }
14162
14163 bool prefix_required = true;
14164 if (use_type && !j.m_value.object->empty())
14165 {
14166 JSON_ASSERT(use_count);
14167 const CharType first_prefix = ubjson_prefix(j.front());
14168 const bool same_prefix = std::all_of(j.begin(), j.end(),
14169 [this, first_prefix](const BasicJsonType & v)
14170 {
14171 return ubjson_prefix(v) == first_prefix;
14172 });
14173
14174 if (same_prefix)
14175 {
14176 prefix_required = false;
14177 oa->write_character(to_char_type('$'));
14178 oa->write_character(first_prefix);
14179 }
14180 }
14181
14182 if (use_count)
14183 {
14184 oa->write_character(to_char_type('#'));
14185 write_number_with_ubjson_prefix(j.m_value.object->size(), true);
14186 }
14187
14188 for (const auto& el : *j.m_value.object)
14189 {
14190 write_number_with_ubjson_prefix(el.first.size(), true);
14191 oa->write_characters(
14192 reinterpret_cast<const CharType*>(el.first.c_str()),
14193 el.first.size());
14194 write_ubjson(el.second, use_count, use_type, prefix_required);
14195 }
14196
14197 if (!use_count)
14198 {
14199 oa->write_character(to_char_type('}'));
14200 }
14201
14202 break;
14203 }
14204
14205 case value_t::discarded:
14206 default:
14207 break;
14208 }
14209 }
14210
14211 private:
14213 // BSON //
14215
14220 static std::size_t calc_bson_entry_header_size(const string_t& name, const BasicJsonType& j)
14221 {
14222 const auto it = name.find(static_cast<typename string_t::value_type>(0));
14223 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(it != BasicJsonType::string_t::npos))
14224 {
14225 JSON_THROW(out_of_range::create(409, "BSON key cannot contain code point U+0000 (at byte " + std::to_string(it) + ")", j));
14226 static_cast<void>(j);
14227 }
14228
14229 return /*id*/ 1ul + name.size() + /*zero-terminator*/1u;
14230 }
14231
14235 void write_bson_entry_header(const string_t& name,
14236 const std::uint8_t element_type)
14237 {
14238 oa->write_character(to_char_type(element_type)); // boolean
14239 oa->write_characters(
14240 reinterpret_cast<const CharType*>(name.c_str()),
14241 name.size() + 1u);
14242 }
14243
14247 void write_bson_boolean(const string_t& name,
14248 const bool value)
14249 {
14250 write_bson_entry_header(name, 0x08);
14251 oa->write_character(value ? to_char_type(0x01) : to_char_type(0x00));
14252 }
14253
14257 void write_bson_double(const string_t& name,
14258 const double value)
14259 {
14260 write_bson_entry_header(name, 0x01);
14261 write_number<double, true>(value);
14262 }
14263
14267 static std::size_t calc_bson_string_size(const string_t& value)
14268 {
14269 return sizeof(std::int32_t) + value.size() + 1ul;
14270 }
14271
14275 void write_bson_string(const string_t& name,
14276 const string_t& value)
14277 {
14278 write_bson_entry_header(name, 0x02);
14279
14280 write_number<std::int32_t, true>(static_cast<std::int32_t>(value.size() + 1ul));
14281 oa->write_characters(
14282 reinterpret_cast<const CharType*>(value.c_str()),
14283 value.size() + 1);
14284 }
14285
14289 void write_bson_null(const string_t& name)
14290 {
14291 write_bson_entry_header(name, 0x0A);
14292 }

14297 static std::size_t calc_bson_integer_size(const std::int64_t value)
14298 {
14299 return (std::numeric_limits<std::int32_t>::min)() <= value && value <= (std::numeric_limits<std::int32_t>::max)()
14300 ? sizeof(std::int32_t)
14301 : sizeof(std::int64_t);
14302 }
14303
14307 void write_bson_integer(const string_t& name,
14308 const std::int64_t value)
14309 {
14310 if ((std::numeric_limits<std::int32_t>::min)() <= value && value <= (std::numeric_limits<std::int32_t>::max)())
14311 {
14312 write_bson_entry_header(name, 0x10); // int32
14313 write_number<std::int32_t, true>(static_cast<std::int32_t>(value));
14314 }
14315 else
14316 {
14317 write_bson_entry_header(name, 0x12); // int64
14318 write_number<std::int64_t, true>(static_cast<std::int64_t>(value));
14319 }
14320 }
14321
14325 static constexpr std::size_t calc_bson_unsigned_size(const std::uint64_t value) noexcept
14326 {
14327 return (value <= static_cast<std::uint64_t>((std::numeric_limits<std::int32_t>::max)()))
14328 ? sizeof(std::int32_t)
14329 : sizeof(std::int64_t);
14330 }
14331
14335 void write_bson_unsigned(const string_t& name,
14336 const BasicJsonType& j)
14337 {
14338 if (j.m_value.number_unsigned <= static_cast<std::uint64_t>((std::numeric_limits<std::int32_t>::max)()))
14339 {
14340 write_bson_entry_header(name, 0x10 /* int32 */);
14341 write_number<std::int32_t, true>(static_cast<std::int32_t>(j.m_value.number_unsigned));
14342 }
14343 else if (j.m_value.number_unsigned <= static_cast<std::uint64_t>((std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max)()))
14344 {
14345 write_bson_entry_header(name, 0x12 /* int64 */);
14346 write_number<std::int64_t, true>(static_cast<std::int64_t>(j.m_value.number_unsigned));
14347 }
14348 else
14349 {
14350 JSON_THROW(out_of_range::create(407, "integer number " + std::to_string(j.m_value.number_unsigned) + " cannot be represented by BSON as it does not fit int64", j));
14351 }
14352 }
14353
14357 void write_bson_object_entry(const string_t& name,
14358 const typename BasicJsonType::object_t& value)
14359 {
14360 write_bson_entry_header(name, 0x03); // object
14361 write_bson_object(value);
14362 }
14363
14367 static std::size_t calc_bson_array_size(const typename BasicJsonType::array_t& value)
14368 {
14369 std::size_t array_index = 0ul;
14370
14371 const std::size_t embedded_document_size = std::accumulate(std::begin(value), std::end(value), static_cast<std::size_t>(0), [&array_index](std::size_t result, const typename BasicJsonType::array_t::value_type & el)
14372 {
14373 return result + calc_bson_element_size(std::to_string(array_index++), el);
14374 });
14375
14376 return sizeof(std::int32_t) + embedded_document_size + 1ul;
14377 }
14378
14382 static std::size_t calc_bson_binary_size(const typename BasicJsonType::binary_t& value)
14383 {
14384 return sizeof(std::int32_t) + value.size() + 1ul;
14385 }
14386
14390 void write_bson_array(const string_t& name,
14391 const typename BasicJsonType::array_t& value)
14392 {
14393 write_bson_entry_header(name, 0x04); // array
14394 write_number<std::int32_t, true>(static_cast<std::int32_t>(calc_bson_array_size(value)));
14395
14396 std::size_t array_index = 0ul;
14397
14398 for (const auto& el : value)
14399 {
14400 write_bson_element(std::to_string(array_index++), el);
14401 }
14402
14403 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0x00));
14404 }
14405
14409 void write_bson_binary(const string_t& name,
14410 const binary_t& value)
14411 {
14412 write_bson_entry_header(name, 0x05);
14413
14414 write_number<std::int32_t, true>(static_cast<std::int32_t>(value.size()));
14415 write_number(value.has_subtype() ? static_cast<std::uint8_t>(value.subtype()) : static_cast<std::uint8_t>(0x00));
14416
14417 oa->write_characters(reinterpret_cast<const CharType*>(value.data()), value.size());
14418 }
14419
14424 static std::size_t calc_bson_element_size(const string_t& name,
14425 const BasicJsonType& j)
14426 {
14427 const auto header_size = calc_bson_entry_header_size(name, j);
14428 switch (j.type())
14429 {
14430 case value_t::object:
14431 return header_size + calc_bson_object_size(*j.m_value.object);
14432
14433 case value_t::array:
14434 return header_size + calc_bson_array_size(*j.m_value.array);
14435
14436 case value_t::binary:
14437 return header_size + calc_bson_binary_size(*j.m_value.binary);
14438
14439 case value_t::boolean:
14440 return header_size + 1ul;
14441
14442 case value_t::number_float:
14443 return header_size + 8ul;
14444
14445 case value_t::number_integer:
14446 return header_size + calc_bson_integer_size(j.m_value.number_integer);
14447
14448 case value_t::number_unsigned:
14449 return header_size + calc_bson_unsigned_size(j.m_value.number_unsigned);
14450
14451 case value_t::string:
14452 return header_size + calc_bson_string_size(*j.m_value.string);
14453
14454 case value_t::null:
14455 return header_size + 0ul;
14456
14457 // LCOV_EXCL_START
14458 case value_t::discarded:
14459 default:
14460 JSON_ASSERT(false); // NOLINT(cert-dcl03-c,hicpp-static-assert,misc-static-assert)
14461 return 0ul;
14462 // LCOV_EXCL_STOP
14463 }
14464 }
14465
14472 void write_bson_element(const string_t& name,
14473 const BasicJsonType& j)
14474 {
14475 switch (j.type())
14476 {
14477 case value_t::object:
14478 return write_bson_object_entry(name, *j.m_value.object);
14479
14480 case value_t::array:
14481 return write_bson_array(name, *j.m_value.array);
14482
14483 case value_t::binary:
14484 return write_bson_binary(name, *j.m_value.binary);
14485
14486 case value_t::boolean:
14487 return write_bson_boolean(name, j.m_value.boolean);
14488
14489 case value_t::number_float:
14490 return write_bson_double(name, j.m_value.number_float);
14491
14492 case value_t::number_integer:
14493 return write_bson_integer(name, j.m_value.number_integer);
14494
14495 case value_t::number_unsigned:
14496 return write_bson_unsigned(name, j);
14497
14498 case value_t::string:
14499 return write_bson_string(name, *j.m_value.string);
14500
14501 case value_t::null:
14502 return write_bson_null(name);
14503
14504 // LCOV_EXCL_START
14505 case value_t::discarded:
14506 default:
14507 JSON_ASSERT(false); // NOLINT(cert-dcl03-c,hicpp-static-assert,misc-static-assert)
14508 return;
14509 // LCOV_EXCL_STOP
14510 }
14511 }
14512
14519 static std::size_t calc_bson_object_size(const typename BasicJsonType::object_t& value)
14520 {
14521 std::size_t document_size = std::accumulate(value.begin(), value.end(), static_cast<std::size_t>(0),
14522 [](size_t result, const typename BasicJsonType::object_t::value_type & el)
14523 {
14524 return result += calc_bson_element_size(el.first, el.second);
14525 });
14526
14527 return sizeof(std::int32_t) + document_size + 1ul;
14528 }
14529
14534 void write_bson_object(const typename BasicJsonType::object_t& value)
14535 {
14536 write_number<std::int32_t, true>(static_cast<std::int32_t>(calc_bson_object_size(value)));
14537
14538 for (const auto& el : value)
14539 {
14540 write_bson_element(el.first, el.second);
14541 }
14542
14543 oa->write_character(to_char_type(0x00));
14544 }

14575 // UBJSON //
14577
14578 // UBJSON: write number (floating point)
14579 template<typename NumberType, typename std::enable_if<
14580 std::is_floating_point<NumberType>::value, int>::type = 0>
14581 void write_number_with_ubjson_prefix(const NumberType n,
14582 const bool add_prefix)
14583 {
14584 if (add_prefix)
14585 {
14586 oa->write_character(get_ubjson_float_prefix(n));
14587 }
14588 write_number(n);
14589 }
14590
14591 // UBJSON: write number (unsigned integer)
14592 template<typename NumberType, typename std::enable_if<
14593 std::is_unsigned<NumberType>::value, int>::type = 0>
14594 void write_number_with_ubjson_prefix(const NumberType n,
14595 const bool add_prefix)
14596 {
14597 if (n <= static_cast<std::uint64_t>((std::numeric_limits<std::int8_t>::max)()))
14598 {
14599 if (add_prefix)
14600 {
14601 oa->write_character(to_char_type('i')); // int8
14602 }
14603 write_number(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(n));
14604 }
14605 else if (n <= (std::numeric_limits<std::uint8_t>::max)())
14606 {
14607 if (add_prefix)
14608 {
14609 oa->write_character(to_char_type('U')); // uint8
14610 }
14611 write_number(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(n));
14612 }
14613 else if (n <= static_cast<std::uint64_t>((std::numeric_limits<std::int16_t>::max)()))
14614 {
14615 if (add_prefix)
14616 {
14617 oa->write_character(to_char_type('I')); // int16
14618 }
14619 write_number(static_cast<std::int16_t>(n));
14620 }
14621 else if (n <= static_cast<std::uint64_t>((std::numeric_limits<std::int32_t>::max)()))
14622 {
14623 if (add_prefix)
14624 {
14625 oa->write_character(to_char_type('l')); // int32
14626 }
14627 write_number(static_cast<std::int32_t>(n));
14628 }
14629 else if (n <= static_cast<std::uint64_t>((std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max)()))
14630 {
14631 if (add_prefix)
14632 {
14633 oa->write_character(to_char_type('L')); // int64
14634 }
14635 write_number(static_cast<std::int64_t>(n));
14636 }
14637 else
14638 {
14639 if (add_prefix)
14640 {
14641 oa->write_character(to_char_type('H')); // high-precision number
14642 }
14643
14644 const auto number = BasicJsonType(n).dump();
14645 write_number_with_ubjson_prefix(number.size(), true);
14646 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < number.size(); ++i)
14647 {
14648 oa->write_character(to_char_type(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(number[i])));
14649 }
14650 }
14651 }
14652
14653 // UBJSON: write number (signed integer)
14654 template < typename NumberType, typename std::enable_if <
14655 std::is_signed<NumberType>::value&&
14656 !std::is_floating_point<NumberType>::value, int >::type = 0 >
14657 void write_number_with_ubjson_prefix(const NumberType n,
14658 const bool add_prefix)
14659 {
14660 if ((std::numeric_limits<std::int8_t>::min)() <= n && n <= (std::numeric_limits<std::int8_t>::max)())
14661 {
14662 if (add_prefix)
14663 {
14664 oa->write_character(to_char_type('i')); // int8
14665 }
14666 write_number(static_cast<std::int8_t>(n));
14667 }
14668 else if (static_cast<std::int64_t>((std::numeric_limits<std::uint8_t>::min)()) <= n && n <= static_cast<std::int64_t>((std::numeric_limits<std::uint8_t>::max)()))
14669 {
14670 if (add_prefix)
14671 {
14672 oa->write_character(to_char_type('U')); // uint8
14673 }
14674 write_number(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(n));
14675 }
14676 else if ((std::numeric_limits<std::int16_t>::min)() <= n && n <= (std::numeric_limits<std::int16_t>::max)())
14677 {
14678 if (add_prefix)
14679 {
14680 oa->write_character(to_char_type('I')); // int16
14681 }
14682 write_number(static_cast<std::int16_t>(n));
14683 }
14684 else if ((std::numeric_limits<std::int32_t>::min)() <= n && n <= (std::numeric_limits<std::int32_t>::max)())
14685 {
14686 if (add_prefix)
14687 {
14688 oa->write_character(to_char_type('l')); // int32
14689 }
14690 write_number(static_cast<std::int32_t>(n));
14691 }
14692 else if ((std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::min)() <= n && n <= (std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max)())
14693 {
14694 if (add_prefix)
14695 {
14696 oa->write_character(to_char_type('L')); // int64
14697 }
14698 write_number(static_cast<std::int64_t>(n));
14699 }
14700 // LCOV_EXCL_START
14701 else
14702 {
14703 if (add_prefix)
14704 {
14705 oa->write_character(to_char_type('H')); // high-precision number
14706 }
14707
14708 const auto number = BasicJsonType(n).dump();
14709 write_number_with_ubjson_prefix(number.size(), true);
14710 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < number.size(); ++i)
14711 {
14712 oa->write_character(to_char_type(static_cast<std::uint8_t>(number[i])));
14713 }
14714 }
14715 // LCOV_EXCL_STOP
14716 }
14717
14721 CharType ubjson_prefix(const BasicJsonType& j) const noexcept
14722 {
14723 switch (j.type())
14724 {
14725 case value_t::null:
14726 return 'Z';
14727
14728 case value_t::boolean:
14729 return j.m_value.boolean ? 'T' : 'F';
14730
14731 case value_t::number_integer:
14732 {
14733 if ((std::numeric_limits<std::int8_t>::min)() <= j.m_value.number_integer && j.m_value.number_integer <= (std::numeric_limits<std::int8_t>::max)())
14734 {
14735 return 'i';
14736 }
14737 if ((std::numeric_limits<std::uint8_t>::min)() <= j.m_value.number_integer && j.m_value.number_integer <= (std::numeric_limits<std::uint8_t>::max)())
14738 {
14739 return 'U';
14740 }
14741 if ((std::numeric_limits<std::int16_t>::min)() <= j.m_value.number_integer && j.m_value.number_integer <= (std::numeric_limits<std::int16_t>::max)())
14742 {
14743 return 'I';
14744 }
14745 if ((std::numeric_limits<std::int32_t>::min)() <= j.m_value.number_integer && j.m_value.number_integer <= (std::numeric_limits<std::int32_t>::max)())
14746 {
14747 return 'l';
14748 }
14749 if ((std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::min)() <= j.m_value.number_integer && j.m_value.number_integer <= (std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max)())
14750 {
14751 return 'L';
14752 }
14753 // anything else is treated as high-precision number
14754 return 'H'; // LCOV_EXCL_LINE
14755 }
14756
14757 case value_t::number_unsigned:
14758 {
14759 if (j.m_value.number_unsigned <= static_cast<std::uint64_t>((std::numeric_limits<std::int8_t>::max)()))
14760 {
14761 return 'i';
14762 }
14763 if (j.m_value.number_unsigned <= static_cast<std::uint64_t>((std::numeric_limits<std::uint8_t>::max)()))
14764 {
14765 return 'U';
14766 }
14767 if (j.m_value.number_unsigned <= static_cast<std::uint64_t>((std::numeric_limits<std::int16_t>::max)()))
14768 {
14769 return 'I';
14770 }
14771 if (j.m_value.number_unsigned <= static_cast<std::uint64_t>((std::numeric_limits<std::int32_t>::max)()))
14772 {
14773 return 'l';
14774 }
14775 if (j.m_value.number_unsigned <= static_cast<std::uint64_t>((std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max)()))
14776 {
14777 return 'L';
14778 }
14779 // anything else is treated as high-precision number
14780 return 'H'; // LCOV_EXCL_LINE
14781 }
14782
14783 case value_t::number_float:
14784 return get_ubjson_float_prefix(j.m_value.number_float);
14785
14786 case value_t::string:
14787 return 'S';
14788
14789 case value_t::array: // fallthrough
14790 case value_t::binary:
14791 return '[';
14792
14793 case value_t::object:
14794 return '{';
14795
14796 case value_t::discarded:
14797 default: // discarded values
14798 return 'N';
14799 }
14800 }
14801
14802 static constexpr CharType get_ubjson_float_prefix(float /*unused*/)
14803 {
14804 return 'd'; // float 32
14805 }
14806
14807 static constexpr CharType get_ubjson_float_prefix(double /*unused*/)
14808 {
14809 return 'D'; // float 64
14810 }

14813 // Utility functions //
14815
14816 /*
14817 @brief write a number to output input
14818 @param[in] n number of type @a NumberType
14819 @tparam NumberType the type of the number
14820 @tparam OutputIsLittleEndian Set to true if output data is
14821 required to be little endian
14822
14823 @note This function needs to respect the system's endianness, because bytes
14824 in CBOR, MessagePack, and UBJSON are stored in network order (big
14825 endian) and therefore need reordering on little endian systems.
14826 */
14827 template<typename NumberType, bool OutputIsLittleEndian = false>
14828 void write_number(const NumberType n)
14829 {
14830 // step 1: write number to array of length NumberType
14831 std::array<CharType, sizeof(NumberType)> vec{};
14832 std::memcpy(vec.data(), &n, sizeof(NumberType));
14833
14834 // step 2: write array to output (with possible reordering)
14835 if (is_little_endian != OutputIsLittleEndian)
14836 {
14837 // reverse byte order prior to conversion if necessary
14838 std::reverse(vec.begin(), vec.end());
14839 }
14840
14841 oa->write_characters(vec.data(), sizeof(NumberType));
14842 }
14843
14844 void write_compact_float(const number_float_t n, detail::input_format_t format)
14845 {
14846#ifdef __GNUC__
14847#pragma GCC diagnostic push
14848#pragma GCC diagnostic ignored "-Wfloat-equal"
14849#endif
14850 if (static_cast<double>(n) >= static_cast<double>(std::numeric_limits<float>::lowest()) &&
14851 static_cast<double>(n) <= static_cast<double>((std::numeric_limits<float>::max)()) &&
14852 static_cast<double>(static_cast<float>(n)) == static_cast<double>(n))
14853 {
14854 oa->write_character(format == detail::input_format_t::cbor
14855 ? get_cbor_float_prefix(static_cast<float>(n))
14856 : get_msgpack_float_prefix(static_cast<float>(n)));
14857 write_number(static_cast<float>(n));
14858 }
14859 else
14860 {
14861 oa->write_character(format == detail::input_format_t::cbor
14862 ? get_cbor_float_prefix(n)
14863 : get_msgpack_float_prefix(n));
14864 write_number(n);
14865 }
14866#ifdef __GNUC__
14867#pragma GCC diagnostic pop
14868#endif
14869 }
14870
14871 public:
14872 // The following to_char_type functions are implement the conversion
14873 // between uint8_t and CharType. In case CharType is not unsigned,
14874 // such a conversion is required to allow values greater than 128.
14875 // See <https://github.com/nlohmann/json/issues/1286> for a discussion.
14876 template < typename C = CharType,
14877 enable_if_t < std::is_signed<C>::value && std::is_signed<char>::value > * = nullptr >
14878 static constexpr CharType to_char_type(std::uint8_t x) noexcept
14879 {
14880 return *reinterpret_cast<char*>(&x);
14881 }
14882
14883 template < typename C = CharType,
14884 enable_if_t < std::is_signed<C>::value && std::is_unsigned<char>::value > * = nullptr >
14885 static CharType to_char_type(std::uint8_t x) noexcept
14886 {
14887 static_assert(sizeof(std::uint8_t) == sizeof(CharType), "size of CharType must be equal to std::uint8_t");
14888 static_assert(std::is_trivial<CharType>::value, "CharType must be trivial");
14889 CharType result;
14890 std::memcpy(&result, &x, sizeof(x));
14891 return result;
14892 }

14894 template<typename C = CharType,
14895 enable_if_t<std::is_unsigned<C>::value>* = nullptr>
14896 static constexpr CharType to_char_type(std::uint8_t x) noexcept
14897 {
14898 return x;
14899 }

14901 template < typename InputCharType, typename C = CharType,
14902 enable_if_t <
14903 std::is_signed<C>::value &&
14904 std::is_signed<char>::value &&
14905 std::is_same<char, typename std::remove_cv<InputCharType>::type>::value
14906 > * = nullptr >
14907 static constexpr CharType to_char_type(InputCharType x) noexcept
14908 {
14909 return x;
14910 }

14912 private:
14914 const bool is_little_endian = little_endianness();
14915
14917 output_adapter_t<CharType> oa = nullptr;
14918};

14981template<typename Target, typename Source>
14982Target reinterpret_bits(const Source source)
14983{
14984 static_assert(sizeof(Target) == sizeof(Source), "size mismatch");
14985
14986 Target target;
14987 std::memcpy(&target, &source, sizeof(Source));
14988 return target;

14990
14991struct diyfp // f * 2^e
14992{
14993 static constexpr int kPrecision = 64; // = q
14994
14995 std::uint64_t f = 0;
14996 int e = 0;
14997
14998 constexpr diyfp(std::uint64_t f_, int e_) noexcept : f(f_), e(e_) {}
14999
15004 static diyfp sub(const diyfp& x, const diyfp& y) noexcept
15005 {
15006 JSON_ASSERT(x.e == y.e);
15007 JSON_ASSERT(x.f >= y.f);
15008
15009 return {x.f - y.f, x.e};
15010 }
15011
15016 static diyfp mul(const diyfp& x, const diyfp& y) noexcept
15017 {
15018 static_assert(kPrecision == 64, "internal error");
15019
15020 // Computes:
15021 // f = round((x.f * y.f) / 2^q)
15022 // e = x.e + y.e + q
15023
15024 // Emulate the 64-bit * 64-bit multiplication:
15025 //
15026 // p = u * v
15027 // = (u_lo + 2^32 u_hi) (v_lo + 2^32 v_hi)
15028 // = (u_lo v_lo ) + 2^32 ((u_lo v_hi ) + (u_hi v_lo )) + 2^64 (u_hi v_hi )
15029 // = (p0 ) + 2^32 ((p1 ) + (p2 )) + 2^64 (p3 )
15030 // = (p0_lo + 2^32 p0_hi) + 2^32 ((p1_lo + 2^32 p1_hi) + (p2_lo + 2^32 p2_hi)) + 2^64 (p3 )
15031 // = (p0_lo ) + 2^32 (p0_hi + p1_lo + p2_lo ) + 2^64 (p1_hi + p2_hi + p3)
15032 // = (p0_lo ) + 2^32 (Q ) + 2^64 (H )
15033 // = (p0_lo ) + 2^32 (Q_lo + 2^32 Q_hi ) + 2^64 (H )
15034 //
15035 // (Since Q might be larger than 2^32 - 1)
15036 //
15037 // = (p0_lo + 2^32 Q_lo) + 2^64 (Q_hi + H)
15038 //
15039 // (Q_hi + H does not overflow a 64-bit int)
15040 //
15041 // = p_lo + 2^64 p_hi
15042
15043 const std::uint64_t u_lo = x.f & 0xFFFFFFFFu;
15044 const std::uint64_t u_hi = x.f >> 32u;
15045 const std::uint64_t v_lo = y.f & 0xFFFFFFFFu;
15046 const std::uint64_t v_hi = y.f >> 32u;
15047
15048 const std::uint64_t p0 = u_lo * v_lo;
15049 const std::uint64_t p1 = u_lo * v_hi;
15050 const std::uint64_t p2 = u_hi * v_lo;
15051 const std::uint64_t p3 = u_hi * v_hi;
15052
15053 const std::uint64_t p0_hi = p0 >> 32u;
15054 const std::uint64_t p1_lo = p1 & 0xFFFFFFFFu;
15055 const std::uint64_t p1_hi = p1 >> 32u;
15056 const std::uint64_t p2_lo = p2 & 0xFFFFFFFFu;
15057 const std::uint64_t p2_hi = p2 >> 32u;
15058
15059 std::uint64_t Q = p0_hi + p1_lo + p2_lo;
15060
15061 // The full product might now be computed as
15062 //
15063 // p_hi = p3 + p2_hi + p1_hi + (Q >> 32)
15064 // p_lo = p0_lo + (Q << 32)
15065 //
15066 // But in this particular case here, the full p_lo is not required.
15067 // Effectively we only need to add the highest bit in p_lo to p_hi (and
15068 // Q_hi + 1 does not overflow).
15069
15070 Q += std::uint64_t{1} << (64u - 32u - 1u); // round, ties up
15071
15072 const std::uint64_t h = p3 + p2_hi + p1_hi + (Q >> 32u);
15073
15074 return {h, x.e + y.e + 64};
15075 }
15076
15081 static diyfp normalize(diyfp x) noexcept
15082 {
15083 JSON_ASSERT(x.f != 0);
15084
15085 while ((x.f >> 63u) == 0)
15086 {
15087 x.f <<= 1u;
15088 x.e--;
15089 }
15090
15091 return x;
15092 }
15093
15098 static diyfp normalize_to(const diyfp& x, const int target_exponent) noexcept
15099 {
15100 const int delta = x.e - target_exponent;
15101
15102 JSON_ASSERT(delta >= 0);
15103 JSON_ASSERT(((x.f << delta) >> delta) == x.f);
15104
15105 return {x.f << delta, target_exponent};
15106 }
15107};
15108
15109struct boundaries
15110{
15111 diyfp w;
15112 diyfp minus;
15113 diyfp plus;
15114};
15115
15122template<typename FloatType>
15123boundaries compute_boundaries(FloatType value)
15124{
15125 JSON_ASSERT(std::isfinite(value));
15126 JSON_ASSERT(value > 0);
15127
15128 // Convert the IEEE representation into a diyfp.
15129 //
15130 // If v is denormal:
15131 // value = 0.F * 2^(1 - bias) = ( F) * 2^(1 - bias - (p-1))
15132 // If v is normalized:
15133 // value = 1.F * 2^(E - bias) = (2^(p-1) + F) * 2^(E - bias - (p-1))
15134
15135 static_assert(std::numeric_limits<FloatType>::is_iec559,
15136 "internal error: dtoa_short requires an IEEE-754 floating-point implementation");
15137
15138 constexpr int kPrecision = std::numeric_limits<FloatType>::digits; // = p (includes the hidden bit)
15139 constexpr int kBias = std::numeric_limits<FloatType>::max_exponent - 1 + (kPrecision - 1);
15140 constexpr int kMinExp = 1 - kBias;
15141 constexpr std::uint64_t kHiddenBit = std::uint64_t{1} << (kPrecision - 1); // = 2^(p-1)
15142
15143 using bits_type = typename std::conditional<kPrecision == 24, std::uint32_t, std::uint64_t >::type;
15144
15145 const auto bits = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(reinterpret_bits<bits_type>(value));
15146 const std::uint64_t E = bits >> (kPrecision - 1);
15147 const std::uint64_t F = bits & (kHiddenBit - 1);
15148
15149 const bool is_denormal = E == 0;
15150 const diyfp v = is_denormal
15151 ? diyfp(F, kMinExp)
15152 : diyfp(F + kHiddenBit, static_cast<int>(E) - kBias);
15153
15154 // Compute the boundaries m- and m+ of the floating-point value
15155 // v = f * 2^e.
15156 //
15157 // Determine v- and v+, the floating-point predecessor and successor if v,
15158 // respectively.
15159 //
15160 // v- = v - 2^e if f != 2^(p-1) or e == e_min (A)
15161 // = v - 2^(e-1) if f == 2^(p-1) and e > e_min (B)
15162 //
15163 // v+ = v + 2^e
15164 //
15165 // Let m- = (v- + v) / 2 and m+ = (v + v+) / 2. All real numbers _strictly_
15166 // between m- and m+ round to v, regardless of how the input rounding
15167 // algorithm breaks ties.
15168 //
15169 // ---+-------------+-------------+-------------+-------------+--- (A)
15170 // v- m- v m+ v+
15171 //
15172 // -----------------+------+------+-------------+-------------+--- (B)
15173 // v- m- v m+ v+
15174
15175 const bool lower_boundary_is_closer = F == 0 && E > 1;
15176 const diyfp m_plus = diyfp(2 * v.f + 1, v.e - 1);
15177 const diyfp m_minus = lower_boundary_is_closer
15178 ? diyfp(4 * v.f - 1, v.e - 2) // (B)
15179 : diyfp(2 * v.f - 1, v.e - 1); // (A)
15180
15181 // Determine the normalized w+ = m+.
15182 const diyfp w_plus = diyfp::normalize(m_plus);
15183
15184 // Determine w- = m- such that e_(w-) = e_(w+).
15185 const diyfp w_minus = diyfp::normalize_to(m_minus, w_plus.e);
15186
15187 return {diyfp::normalize(v), w_minus, w_plus};
15188}
15189
15190// Given normalized diyfp w, Grisu needs to find a (normalized) cached
15191// power-of-ten c, such that the exponent of the product c * w = f * 2^e lies
15192// within a certain range [alpha, gamma] (Definition 3.2 from [1])
15193//
15194// alpha <= e = e_c + e_w + q <= gamma
15195//
15196// or
15197//
15198// f_c * f_w * 2^alpha <= f_c 2^(e_c) * f_w 2^(e_w) * 2^q
15199// <= f_c * f_w * 2^gamma
15200//
15201// Since c and w are normalized, i.e. 2^(q-1) <= f < 2^q, this implies
15202//
15203// 2^(q-1) * 2^(q-1) * 2^alpha <= c * w * 2^q < 2^q * 2^q * 2^gamma
15204//
15205// or
15206//
15207// 2^(q - 2 + alpha) <= c * w < 2^(q + gamma)
15208//
15209// The choice of (alpha,gamma) determines the size of the table and the form of
15210// the digit generation procedure. Using (alpha,gamma)=(-60,-32) works out well
15211// in practice:
15212//
15213// The idea is to cut the number c * w = f * 2^e into two parts, which can be
15214// processed independently: An integral part p1, and a fractional part p2:
15215//
15216// f * 2^e = ( (f div 2^-e) * 2^-e + (f mod 2^-e) ) * 2^e
15217// = (f div 2^-e) + (f mod 2^-e) * 2^e
15218// = p1 + p2 * 2^e
15219//
15220// The conversion of p1 into decimal form requires a series of divisions and
15221// modulos by (a power of) 10. These operations are faster for 32-bit than for
15222// 64-bit integers, so p1 should ideally fit into a 32-bit integer. This can be
15223// achieved by choosing
15224//
15225// -e >= 32 or e <= -32 := gamma
15226//
15227// In order to convert the fractional part
15228//
15229// p2 * 2^e = p2 / 2^-e = d[-1] / 10^1 + d[-2] / 10^2 + ...
15230//
15231// into decimal form, the fraction is repeatedly multiplied by 10 and the digits
15232// d[-i] are extracted in order:
15233//
15234// (10 * p2) div 2^-e = d[-1]
15235// (10 * p2) mod 2^-e = d[-2] / 10^1 + ...
15236//
15237// The multiplication by 10 must not overflow. It is sufficient to choose
15238//
15239// 10 * p2 < 16 * p2 = 2^4 * p2 <= 2^64.
15240//
15241// Since p2 = f mod 2^-e < 2^-e,
15242//
15243// -e <= 60 or e >= -60 := alpha
15244
15245constexpr int kAlpha = -60;
15246constexpr int kGamma = -32;
15247
15248struct cached_power // c = f * 2^e ~= 10^k
15249{
15250 std::uint64_t f;
15251 int e;
15252 int k;
15253};
15254
15262inline cached_power get_cached_power_for_binary_exponent(int e)
15263{
15264 // Now
15265 //
15266 // alpha <= e_c + e + q <= gamma (1)
15267 // ==> f_c * 2^alpha <= c * 2^e * 2^q
15268 //
15269 // and since the c's are normalized, 2^(q-1) <= f_c,
15270 //
15271 // ==> 2^(q - 1 + alpha) <= c * 2^(e + q)
15272 // ==> 2^(alpha - e - 1) <= c
15273 //
15274 // If c were an exact power of ten, i.e. c = 10^k, one may determine k as
15275 //
15276 // k = ceil( log_10( 2^(alpha - e - 1) ) )
15277 // = ceil( (alpha - e - 1) * log_10(2) )
15278 //
15279 // From the paper:
15280 // "In theory the result of the procedure could be wrong since c is rounded,
15281 // and the computation itself is approximated [...]. In practice, however,
15282 // this simple function is sufficient."
15283 //
15284 // For IEEE double precision floating-point numbers converted into
15285 // normalized diyfp's w = f * 2^e, with q = 64,
15286 //
15287 // e >= -1022 (min IEEE exponent)
15288 // -52 (p - 1)
15289 // -52 (p - 1, possibly normalize denormal IEEE numbers)
15290 // -11 (normalize the diyfp)
15291 // = -1137
15292 //
15293 // and
15294 //
15295 // e <= +1023 (max IEEE exponent)
15296 // -52 (p - 1)
15297 // -11 (normalize the diyfp)
15298 // = 960
15299 //
15300 // This binary exponent range [-1137,960] results in a decimal exponent
15301 // range [-307,324]. One does not need to store a cached power for each
15302 // k in this range. For each such k it suffices to find a cached power
15303 // such that the exponent of the product lies in [alpha,gamma].
15304 // This implies that the difference of the decimal exponents of adjacent
15305 // table entries must be less than or equal to
15306 //
15307 // floor( (gamma - alpha) * log_10(2) ) = 8.
15308 //
15309 // (A smaller distance gamma-alpha would require a larger table.)
15310
15311 // NB:
15312 // Actually this function returns c, such that -60 <= e_c + e + 64 <= -34.
15313
15314 constexpr int kCachedPowersMinDecExp = -300;
15315 constexpr int kCachedPowersDecStep = 8;
15316
15317 static constexpr std::array<cached_power, 79> kCachedPowers =
15318 {
15319 {
15320 { 0xAB70FE17C79AC6CA, -1060, -300 },
15321 { 0xFF77B1FCBEBCDC4F, -1034, -292 },

15333 { 0xEF340A98172AACE5, -715, -196 },
15334 { 0xB23867FB2A35B28E, -688, -188 },
15335 { 0x84C8D4DFD2C63F3B, -661, -180 },
15336 { 0xC5DD44271AD3CDBA, -635, -172 },
15337 { 0x936B9FCEBB25C996, -608, -164 },
15338 { 0xDBAC6C247D62A584, -582, -156 },
15339 { 0xA3AB66580D5FDAF6, -555, -148 },
15340 { 0xF3E2F893DEC3F126, -529, -140 },
15341 { 0xB5B5ADA8AAFF80B8, -502, -132 },

15343 { 0xC9BCFF6034C13053, -449, -116 },

15402 // This computation gives exactly the same results for k as
15403 // k = ceil((kAlpha - e - 1) * 0.30102999566398114)
15404 // for |e| <= 1500, but doesn't require floating-point operations.
15405 // NB: log_10(2) ~= 78913 / 2^18
15406 JSON_ASSERT(e >= -1500);
15407 JSON_ASSERT(e <= 1500);
15408 const int f = kAlpha - e - 1;
15409 const int k = (f * 78913) / (1 << 18) + static_cast<int>(f > 0);
15410
15411 const int index = (-kCachedPowersMinDecExp + k + (kCachedPowersDecStep - 1)) / kCachedPowersDecStep;
15412 JSON_ASSERT(index >= 0);
15413 JSON_ASSERT(static_cast<std::size_t>(index) < kCachedPowers.size());
15414
15415 const cached_power cached = kCachedPowers[static_cast<std::size_t>(index)];
15416 JSON_ASSERT(kAlpha <= cached.e + e + 64);
15417 JSON_ASSERT(kGamma >= cached.e + e + 64);
15418
15419 return cached;
15420}

15426inline int find_largest_pow10(const std::uint32_t n, std::uint32_t& pow10)
15427{
15428 // LCOV_EXCL_START
15429 if (n >= 1000000000)
15430 {
15431 pow10 = 1000000000;
15432 return 10;
15433 }
15434 // LCOV_EXCL_STOP
15435 if (n >= 100000000)
15436 {
15437 pow10 = 100000000;
15438 return 9;
15439 }
15440 if (n >= 10000000)
15441 {
15442 pow10 = 10000000;
15443 return 8;
15444 }
15445 if (n >= 1000000)
15446 {
15447 pow10 = 1000000;
15448 return 7;
15449 }
15450 if (n >= 100000)
15451 {
15452 pow10 = 100000;
15453 return 6;
15454 }
15455 if (n >= 10000)
15456 {
15457 pow10 = 10000;
15458 return 5;
15459 }
15460 if (n >= 1000)
15461 {
15462 pow10 = 1000;
15463 return 4;
15464 }
15465 if (n >= 100)
15466 {
15467 pow10 = 100;
15468 return 3;
15469 }
15470 if (n >= 10)
15471 {
15472 pow10 = 10;
15473 return 2;
15474 }
15475
15476 pow10 = 1;
15477 return 1;
15478}
