20772 friend std::ostream& operator<<(std::ostream& o, const basic_json& j)
20773 {
20774 // read width member and use it as indentation parameter if nonzero
20775 const bool pretty_print = o.width() > 0;
20776 const auto indentation = pretty_print ? o.width() : 0;
20777
20778 // reset width to 0 for subsequent calls to this stream
20779 o.width(0);
20780
20781 // do the actual serialization
20782 serializer s(detail::output_adapter<char>(o), o.fill());
20783 s.dump(j, pretty_print, false, static_cast<unsigned int>(indentation));
20784 return o;
20785 }

21377
21379 // JSON Patch functions //
21381
21384
21387 basic_json patch(const basic_json& json_patch) const
21388 {
21389 // make a working copy to apply the patch to
21390 basic_json result = *this;
21391
21392 // the valid JSON Patch operations
21393 enum class patch_operations {add, remove, replace, move, copy, test, invalid};
21394
21395 const auto get_op = [](const std::string & op)
21396 {
21397 if (op == "add")
21398 {
21399 return patch_operations::add;
21400 }
21401 if (op == "remove")
21402 {
21403 return patch_operations::remove;
21404 }
21405 if (op == "replace")
21406 {
21407 return patch_operations::replace;
21408 }
21409 if (op == "move")
21410 {
21411 return patch_operations::move;
21412 }
21413 if (op == "copy")
21414 {
21415 return patch_operations::copy;
21416 }
21417 if (op == "test")
21418 {
21419 return patch_operations::test;
21420 }
21421
21422 return patch_operations::invalid;
21423 };
21424
21425 // wrapper for "add" operation; add value at ptr
21426 const auto operation_add = [&result](json_pointer & ptr, basic_json val)
21427 {
21428 // adding to the root of the target document means replacing it
21429 if (ptr.empty())
21430 {
21431 result = val;
21432 return;
21433 }
21434
21435 // make sure the top element of the pointer exists
21436 json_pointer top_pointer = ptr.top();
21437 if (top_pointer != ptr)
21438 {
21439 result.at(top_pointer);
21440 }
21441
21442 // get reference to parent of JSON pointer ptr
21443 const auto last_path = ptr.back();
21444 ptr.pop_back();
21445 basic_json& parent = result[ptr];
21446
21447 switch (parent.m_type)
21448 {
21449 case value_t::null:
21450 case value_t::object:
21451 {
21452 // use operator[] to add value
21453 parent[last_path] = val;
21454 break;
21455 }
21456
21457 case value_t::array:
21458 {
21459 if (last_path == "-")
21460 {
21461 // special case: append to back
21462 parent.push_back(val);
21463 }
21464 else
21465 {
21466 const auto idx = json_pointer::array_index(last_path);
21467 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(idx > parent.size()))
21468 {
21469 // avoid undefined behavior
21470 JSON_THROW(out_of_range::create(401, "array index " + std::to_string(idx) + " is out of range", parent));
21471 }
21472
21473 // default case: insert add offset
21474 parent.insert(parent.begin() + static_cast<difference_type>(idx), val);
21475 }
21476 break;
21477 }
21478
21479 // if there exists a parent it cannot be primitive
21480 case value_t::string: // LCOV_EXCL_LINE
21481 case value_t::boolean: // LCOV_EXCL_LINE
21482 case value_t::number_integer: // LCOV_EXCL_LINE
21483 case value_t::number_unsigned: // LCOV_EXCL_LINE
21484 case value_t::number_float: // LCOV_EXCL_LINE
21485 case value_t::binary: // LCOV_EXCL_LINE
21486 case value_t::discarded: // LCOV_EXCL_LINE
21487 default: // LCOV_EXCL_LINE
21488 JSON_ASSERT(false); // NOLINT(cert-dcl03-c,hicpp-static-assert,misc-static-assert) LCOV_EXCL_LINE
21489 }
21490 };
21491
21492 // wrapper for "remove" operation; remove value at ptr
21493 const auto operation_remove = [this, &result](json_pointer & ptr)
21494 {
21495 // get reference to parent of JSON pointer ptr
21496 const auto last_path = ptr.back();
21497 ptr.pop_back();
21498 basic_json& parent = result.at(ptr);
21499
21500 // remove child
21501 if (parent.is_object())
21502 {
21503 // perform range check
21504 auto it = parent.find(last_path);
21505 if (JSON_HEDLEY_LIKELY(it != parent.end()))
21506 {
21507 parent.erase(it);
21508 }
21509 else
21510 {
21511 JSON_THROW(out_of_range::create(403, "key '" + last_path + "' not found", *this));
21512 }
21513 }
21514 else if (parent.is_array())
21515 {
21516 // note erase performs range check
21517 parent.erase(json_pointer::array_index(last_path));
21518 }
21519 };
21520
21521 // type check: top level value must be an array
21522 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!json_patch.is_array()))
21523 {
21524 JSON_THROW(parse_error::create(104, 0, "JSON patch must be an array of objects", json_patch));
21525 }
21526
21527 // iterate and apply the operations
21528 for (const auto& val : json_patch)
21529 {
21530 // wrapper to get a value for an operation
21531 const auto get_value = [&val](const std::string & op,
21532 const std::string & member,
21533 bool string_type) -> basic_json &
21534 {
21535 // find value
21536 auto it = val.m_value.object->find(member);
21537
21538 // context-sensitive error message
21539 const auto error_msg = (op == "op") ? "operation" : "operation '" + op + "'";
21540
21541 // check if desired value is present
21542 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(it == val.m_value.object->end()))
21543 {
21544 // NOLINTNEXTLINE(performance-inefficient-string-concatenation)
21545 JSON_THROW(parse_error::create(105, 0, error_msg + " must have member '" + member + "'", val));
21546 }
21547
21548 // check if result is of type string
21549 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(string_type && !it->second.is_string()))
21550 {
21551 // NOLINTNEXTLINE(performance-inefficient-string-concatenation)
21552 JSON_THROW(parse_error::create(105, 0, error_msg + " must have string member '" + member + "'", val));
21553 }
21554
21555 // no error: return value
21556 return it->second;
21557 };
21558
21559 // type check: every element of the array must be an object
21560 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!val.is_object()))
21561 {
21562 JSON_THROW(parse_error::create(104, 0, "JSON patch must be an array of objects", val));
21563 }
21564
21565 // collect mandatory members
21566 const auto op = get_value("op", "op", true).template get<std::string>();
21567 const auto path = get_value(op, "path", true).template get<std::string>();
21568 json_pointer ptr(path);
21569
21570 switch (get_op(op))
21571 {
21572 case patch_operations::add:
21573 {
21574 operation_add(ptr, get_value("add", "value", false));
21575 break;
21576 }
21577
21578 case patch_operations::remove:
21579 {
21580 operation_remove(ptr);
21581 break;
21582 }
21583
21584 case patch_operations::replace:
21585 {
21586 // the "path" location must exist - use at()
21587 result.at(ptr) = get_value("replace", "value", false);
21588 break;
21589 }
21590
21591 case patch_operations::move:
21592 {
21593 const auto from_path = get_value("move", "from", true).template get<std::string>();
21594 json_pointer from_ptr(from_path);
21595
21596 // the "from" location must exist - use at()
21597 basic_json v = result.at(from_ptr);
21598
21599 // The move operation is functionally identical to a
21600 // "remove" operation on the "from" location, followed
21601 // immediately by an "add" operation at the target
21602 // location with the value that was just removed.
21603 operation_remove(from_ptr);
21604 operation_add(ptr, v);
21605 break;
21606 }
21607
21608 case patch_operations::copy:
21609 {
21610 const auto from_path = get_value("copy", "from", true).template get<std::string>();
21611 const json_pointer from_ptr(from_path);
21612
21613 // the "from" location must exist - use at()
21614 basic_json v = result.at(from_ptr);
21615
21616 // The copy is functionally identical to an "add"
21617 // operation at the target location using the value
21618 // specified in the "from" member.
21619 operation_add(ptr, v);
21620 break;
21621 }
21622
21623 case patch_operations::test:
21624 {
21625 bool success = false;
21626 JSON_TRY
21627 {
21628 // check if "value" matches the one at "path"
21629 // the "path" location must exist - use at()
21630 success = (result.at(ptr) == get_value("test", "value", false));
21631 }
21632 JSON_INTERNAL_CATCH (out_of_range&)
21633 {
21634 // ignore out of range errors: success remains false
21635 }
21636
21637 // throw an exception if test fails
21638 if (JSON_HEDLEY_UNLIKELY(!success))
21639 {
21640 JSON_THROW(other_error::create(501, "unsuccessful: " + val.dump(), val));
21641 }
21642
21643 break;
21644 }
21645
21646 case patch_operations::invalid:
21647 default:
21648 {
21649 // op must be "add", "remove", "replace", "move", "copy", or
21650 // "test"
21651 JSON_THROW(parse_error::create(105, 0, "operation value '" + op + "' is invalid", val));
21652 }
21653 }
21654 }
21655
21656 return result;
21657 }
21658
21661 JSON_HEDLEY_WARN_UNUSED_RESULT
21662 static basic_json diff(const basic_json& source, const basic_json& target,
21663 const std::string& path = "")
21664 {
21665 // the patch
21666 basic_json result(value_t::array);
21667
21668 // if the values are the same, return empty patch
21669 if (source == target)
21670 {
21671 return result;
21672 }
21673
21674 if (source.type() != target.type())
21675 {
21676 // different types: replace value
21677 result.push_back(
21678 {
21679 {"op", "replace"}, {"path", path}, {"value", target}
21680 });
21681 return result;
21682 }
21683
21684 switch (source.type())
21685 {
21686 case value_t::array:
21687 {
21688 // first pass: traverse common elements
21689 std::size_t i = 0;
21690 while (i < source.size() && i < target.size())
21691 {
21692 // recursive call to compare array values at index i
21693 auto temp_diff = diff(source[i], target[i], path + "/" + std::to_string(i));
21694 result.insert(result.end(), temp_diff.begin(), temp_diff.end());
21695 ++i;
21696 }
21697
21698 // We now reached the end of at least one array
21699 // in a second pass, traverse the remaining elements
21700
21701 // remove my remaining elements
21702 const auto end_index = static_cast<difference_type>(result.size());
21703 while (i < source.size())
21704 {
21705 // add operations in reverse order to avoid invalid
21706 // indices
21707 result.insert(result.begin() + end_index, object(
21708 {
21709 {"op", "remove"},
21710 {"path", path + "/" + std::to_string(i)}
21711 }));
21712 ++i;
21713 }
21714
21715 // add other remaining elements
21716 while (i < target.size())
21717 {
21718 result.push_back(
21719 {
21720 {"op", "add"},
21721 {"path", path + "/-"},
21722 {"value", target[i]}
21723 });
21724 ++i;
21725 }
21726
21727 break;
21728 }
21729
21730 case value_t::object:
21731 {
21732 // first pass: traverse this object's elements
21733 for (auto it = source.cbegin(); it != source.cend(); ++it)
21734 {
21735 // escape the key name to be used in a JSON patch
21736 const auto path_key = path + "/" + detail::escape(it.key());
21737
21738 if (target.find(it.key()) != target.end())
21739 {
21740 // recursive call to compare object values at key it
21741 auto temp_diff = diff(it.value(), target[it.key()], path_key);
21742 result.insert(result.end(), temp_diff.begin(), temp_diff.end());
21743 }
21744 else
21745 {
21746 // found a key that is not in o -> remove it
21747 result.push_back(object(
21748 {
21749 {"op", "remove"}, {"path", path_key}
21750 }));
21751 }
21752 }
21753
21754 // second pass: traverse other object's elements
21755 for (auto it = target.cbegin(); it != target.cend(); ++it)
21756 {
21757 if (source.find(it.key()) == source.end())
21758 {
21759 // found a key that is not in this -> add it
21760 const auto path_key = path + "/" + detail::escape(it.key());
21761 result.push_back(
21762 {
21763 {"op", "add"}, {"path", path_key},
21764 {"value", it.value()}
21765 });
21766 }
21767 }
21768
21769 break;
21770 }
21771
21772 case value_t::null:
21773 case value_t::string:
21774 case value_t::boolean:
21775 case value_t::number_integer:
21776 case value_t::number_unsigned:
21777 case value_t::number_float:
21778 case value_t::binary:
21779 case value_t::discarded:
21780 default:
21781 {
21782 // both primitive type: replace value
21783 result.push_back(
21784 {
21785 {"op", "replace"}, {"path", path}, {"value", target}
21786 });
21787 break;
21788 }
21789 }
21790
21791 return result;
21792 }
21793
21795
21797 // JSON Merge Patch functions //
21799
21802
21805 void merge_patch(const basic_json& apply_patch)
21806 {
21807 if (apply_patch.is_object())
21808 {
21809 if (!is_object())
21810 {
21811 *this = object();
21812 }
21813 for (auto it = apply_patch.begin(); it != apply_patch.end(); ++it)
21814 {
21815 if (it.value().is_null())
21816 {
21817 erase(it.key());
21818 }
21819 else
21820 {
21821 operator[](it.key()).merge_patch(it.value());
21822 }
21823 }
21824 }
21825 else
21826 {
21827 *this = apply_patch;
21828 }
21829 }
21830
21832};
